Wir freuen uns auf deine vollständige online Bewerbung (Motivationsschreiben, Lebenslauf, Schulzeugnisse und Multicheck) . Herr Erzinger. Für weitere Auskünfte steht dir Frau Schreiber, unter 058 400 44 26, zur Verfügung. jpidd061d2fjm jit0833jm jiy26jm

Vertriebsmitarbeiter im Außendienst (m/w/d) für die Schweiz, remote  
Über uns:

jobs.title: IT Consultant: Netwerk Engineer
jobs.description:
Locatie: Bij de klant (thuiswerk te bespreken bij klant)

Dienstverband: Fulltime

Ervaring: Medior / Senior (3–7 jaar)

Over de functie

Als Netwerk Engineer ben jij verantwoordelijk voor het ontwerp, beheer en onderhoud van de netwerk- en securityinfrastructuur van onze klanten. Jij zorgt ervoor dat verbindingen betrouwbaar, veilig en optimaal presteren — zowel on-premise als in de cloud.

In jouw consultancy-rol werk je bij één van onze klanten, vaak voor een langere periode. Zo bouw je mee aan hun IT-omgeving en leer je de organisatie goed kennen. Tegelijkertijd houd je de afwisseling en groeikansen van consultancy — nieuwe klanten, nieuwe omgevingen, nieuwe uitdagingen.

 

Wat ga je doen?

  • Beheren, configureren en optimaliseren van netwerkcomponenten (routers, switches, firewalls, VPN’s)
  • Implementeren van netwerkverbeteringen en securitymaatregelen
  • Analyseren en oplossen van netwerkincidenten en -storingen
  • Uitvoeren van netwerkmonitoring, capacity management en performance tuning
  • Meewerken aan migraties, upgrades en nieuwe netwerkprojecten
  • Documenteren van wijzigingen en adviseren over optimalisaties

 

Wie ben jij?

Jij bent een ervaren netwerkprofessional die denkt in verbindingen — letterlijk én figuurlijk. Je hebt oog voor details, werkt gestructureerd en vindt het leuk om te sparren over verbeteringen en innovaties binnen de infrastructuur.

Jij hebt:

  • Minimaal 3 jaar ervaring als netwerkbeheerder of netwerk engineer
  • Genoten van een IT-gerelateerde opleiding
  • Kennis van routing & switching, LAN/WAN, VPN, Wi-Fi en firewalls
  • Ervaring met merken als Cisco, HP/Aruba, Fortinet, of Palo Alto
  • Ervaring met netwerkmonitoringtools (bijv. PRTG, SolarWinds, Zabbix)
  • Basiskennis van security, cloud networking (Azure, AWS) of SD-WAN
  • Certificeringen zoals CCNA, CCNP, CompTIA Network+, Fortinet NSE, of Aruba Certified zijn een plus
  • Goede beheersing van de Nederlandse en Engelse taal (Frans is een plus)
  • Rijbewijs B

 

Locatie

Als consultant word je uitgestuurd op opdrachten bij klanten over heel Vlaanderen. We kijken wel naar klanten in jouw regio. Onze consultancy opdrachten zijn voor langere termijn, bij één vaste klant.

  • Routing

  • Switching

  • LAN/WAN

  • VPN

  • WI-FI

  • Firewall

  • CIsco

  • HP/Aruba

  • Fortinet

  • Palo Alto

  • Cloud netwerken (Azure, AWS)

  • SD-WAN

  • Security

De auto is al uitgelezen. Er zijn onderdelen vervangen. De storing is er nog steeds.
Voor een Diagnosetechnicus begint het interessante werk vaak juist op het moment dat de voor de hand liggende oplossing niet werkt. Je verzamelt informatie, kijkt naar meetwaarden en bepaalt welke controle nodig is om verder te komen.

Daarom kijken we verder dan je functietitel en bespreken we vooral welke storingen je nu zelfstandig onderzoekt en hoeveel technische ruimte je in je werk krijgt. 2. WAT GA JE DOEN?
Je onderzoekt technische storingen aan personenauto's. Een foutcode, klachtomschrijving of eerdere reparatie kan richting geven, maar je trekt pas een conclusie wanneer de technische informatie daarbij aansluit.
Dat betekent meten, controleren en soms opnieuw beginnen wanneer een eerste aanname niet blijkt te kloppen. Je bepaalt welke technische vervolgstap logisch is en legt je bevindingen zo vast dat duidelijk is wat je hebt onderzocht en waarop je conclusie is gebaseerd.
Afhankelijk van de werkplaats kan diagnose een groot deel van je werk zijn of gecombineerd worden met complexere reparaties en andere technische werkzaamheden. Autotarget bespreekt vooraf welk type werkaanbod en technisch niveau bij jou past. 3. WAT NEEM JE MEE?
Je hebt ruime ervaring in de autotechniek en voert zelfstandig diagnosewerk uit. Welke opleiding of functietitel daarbij op je cv staat, zegt niet altijd genoeg. We zijn vooral benieuwd naar het technische niveau waarop je nu werkt.

Job Description
Als CNC-operator in Schiedam werk je zelfstandig en precies aan moderne CNC-machines. Je stelt machines in, bedient ze en controleert producten op maatvoering en kwaliteit. Je vertaalt technische tekeningen naar productie-instellingen en voert klein onderhoud uit. Storingen signaleer je direct en je werkt samen met logistiek, planning en verkoop om levertijden te halen. We zoeken iemand met affiniteit voor techniek, een praktische, leergierige houding en oog voor veiligheid en orde. Ervaring met CNC en het lezen van technische tekeningen is gewenst; bekendheid met AutoCAD en taalvaardigheid in Engels of Pools is een pré. Je komt terecht in een compact team waar korte lijnen en samenwerken belangrijk zijn. Functie-inhoud Instellen, bedienen en controleren van CNC-machines volgens productie- en kwaliteitsvoorschriften. Lezen van technische tekeningen en vertalen naar machine-instellingen en productieparameters. Controleren van onderdelen op maatvoering en kwaliteit en afwijkingen direct rapporteren. Uitvoeren van klein onderhoud en storingsdiagnose, en verbeteringen in het proces voorstellen. Functie-eisen MBO werk- en denkniveau, bij voorkeur richting metaal, techniek of productie. Aantoonbare ervaring met CNC-machines en het veilig omzetten van tekeningen naar productie. Proactieve, betrouwbare en zelfstandige werkhouding met oog voor veiligheid, kwaliteit en orde. Bekendheid met AutoCAD en beheersing van Engels of Pools is een duidelijke pré. Wij bieden Reiskostenvergoeding en een heldere secundaire arbeidsvoorwaardenregeling voor medewerkers. Pensioenregeling en vakantiegeld zodat je toekomst en vrije tijd goed geregeld zijn. Werken in een compact, collegiaal team met korte lijnen en directe samenwerking. Kans op een vast contract bij goed functioneren en betrokkenheid bij verbeterprojecten.

jobs.description:
Please note that this is a hybrid position based in Cardiff, requiring 3 days onsite each week, with the option for remote work on the remaining days.

Atomic Theory is a multinational team of seasoned AAA veterans with roots at studios like Blizzard, PUBG, Epic Games, and Unity. We’re passionate about building player-first experiences with strong engineering foundations, performance excellence, and accessibility baked in from day one.

With offices in Albany, NY; Austin, TX; Cardiff, UK; and Brighton, UK, we operate globally with one mindset: Get Sh!t Done.

ABOUT THE ROLE:


As an Mid-Level UI/UX Designer, you are a fully capable, independent contributor who handles complex UI tasks and systems within your domain.


You take ownership of mid-scope UI features and solve complex design or technical challenges. You are expected to work autonomously, unblock peers when necessary, and ensure your work is high-quality, stable, and integrated into the project pipeline.


At this level, you are not leading the team, but you are a key contributor whose technical and design expertise keeps features moving forward efficiently.

WHAT YOU'LL DO:

  • Design, implement, and optimise complex UI features and systems (menus, HUD modules, dynamic flows, procedural elements).

  • Develop and maintain UI libraries, reusable components, and critical systems to support your feature domain.

  • Implement and optimise or have knowledge of custom UI shaders, materials, or advanced animations to achieve specific visual or functional goals.

  • Debug and solve technical UI issues (engine, blueprint, middleware) to unblock your feature work.

  • Validate UI functionality and appearance across resolutions, aspect ratios, and gameplay contexts.

  • Improve personal and small-team workflows to increase efficiency and reliability.

  • Contribute to UX flows, usability, and interface consistency within your domain.

  • Maintain documentation for tools, systems, and components to ensure clarity and reproducibility.

  • Collaborate with engineers, designers, and producers to integrate features smoothly.

WHAT WE VALUE:

  • 3+ years of experience in UI/UX design (games or interactive products).

  • Proven ability to deliver mid-scope UI features independently, including complex interactions or procedural systems.

  • Proficiency with design tools (Figma, Photoshop, Illustrator) and engine implementation (Unreal, Unity).

  • Strong understanding of UI technical fundamentals, including layout, anchoring, slicing, optimisation, and Blueprint/scripting basics.

  • Ability to debug and resolve complex technical and design challenges within your feature domain.

  • Experience developing or optimising UI systems or libraries that improve efficiency and consistency.

  • Clear communication skills, including the ability to flag blockers and propose practical solutions.

  • Strong grasp of UI/UX fundamentals, usability, readability, and accessibility.

  • Passion for polished, performant, and intuitive player experiences.


WHAT YOU MAY ALSO HAVE:

  • Experience with dynamic HUDs, procedural UI, or live-service UI elements.

  • Familiarity with UI middleware or advanced engine pipelines.

  • Experience building shader-based UI, advanced materials, or complex animations.

  • Exposure to UX metrics, usability testing, or iterative optimisation.


WHAT WE CAN OFFER:

Competitive Salary and Benefits Package: Your health and wellbeing is important to us, so we offer a variety of benefits including:

  • Hybrid Working Arrangement: Our office in Brighton is located centrally. As a member of our team, you’ll have the flexibility to work at home and collaborate with your fellow team members in person.

  • Private Pension via Salary Sacrifice

  • Optional Private Medical, Dental, and Vision coverage

_________________________________________________
Director of Communications – International Shows (Touring & Resident)
Sales, Marketing and Communications
Full-Time Position


Reports to: SVP Communications

Scope: All international shows outside the Americas (Europe, UK, Middle East, Africa, Asia-Pacific & Oceania) + Public Affairs
 
Teams: Touring show PR teams (embedded on tour) + Resident show PR teams, and their respective agency rosters
 
 
Role Purpose
 
The Director of Communications – International Shows (Touring & Resident) is responsible for driving demand, building anticipation, and ensuring cultural relevance for Cirque du Soleil’s shows across all markets outside the Americas.
 
This role elevates show communications into a strategic growth engine, integrating PR, earned media, and public affairs to create urgency, unlock market opportunities, and support commercial performance across every international production.
 
Based in London, this role acts as the central show communications and public affairs lead for international markets, ensuring alignment between show storytelling, market-level marketing plans, and cross-functional execution across multiple time zones, languages, and regulatory environments.
 
 
Core Mission
  • Drive anticipation, urgency, and sustained demand for international touring and resident shows
  • Make communications a core lever of the show marketing mix, fully integrated with paid, CRM, and ticketing
  • Lead, develop, and set standards for the touring and resident show PR teams and the agencies that support them
  • Own the strategy and governance of show-specific social media channels as an earned and owned demand driver
  • Leverage public affairs as a growth enabler to unlock market access, market entry, and partnerships
  • Ensure communications is a core driver of ticket revenue and brand equity outside the Americas
  • Orchestrate cross-functional alignment to deliver cohesive show launches across diverse international markets
Key Responsibilities
 
1. Show Communications Strategy – International Touring, Resident Shows & Public Affairs
  • Lead and oversee an international show communications strategy spanning touring productions, resident shows, and public affairs
  • Embed communications within the end-to-end demand engine (onsale → launch → sustain), in lockstep with market marketing plans
  • Integrate public affairs into market entry and growth strategies for new territories
  • Lead communications strategy in support of sponsorships and business development, including building relationships with key stakeholders, and developing joint communication plans with partners
2. Show Communications Leadership (Europe, UK, Middle East, Africa, APAC & Oceania)
  • Own communications strategy and performance across all international touring and resident productions
  • Ensure each show delivers:
    • Clear, differentiated narrative
    • Strong local and cultural relevance, adapted per market and language
    • Full lifecycle comms (pre-onsale → launch → sustain)
  • Implement standards, playbooks, and governance that scale across markets and local agency partners
  • Act as spokesperson for international shows and manage show-level issues in market, escalating to corporate communications at HQ where required
3. Show-Specific Social Media Ownership
  • Ensure each show PR team owns the strategy, management, and community engagement for its show-specific social media channels
  • Set the content, tone, and publishing standards that keep show channels distinctive while consistent with the masterbrand
  • Align show channel activity to the onsale, launch, and sustain calendar in each market
  • Drive creator, influencer, and talent-led content through show channels to build cultural relevance and organic reach
  • Set and track channel performance measures (growth, engagement, referral to ticketing) alongside earned media KPIs
  • Ensure coordination with central brand and social teams on shared assets, escalation paths, and community management protocols
4. Public Affairs & Stakeholder Engagement
  • Leverage public affairs as a strategic growth enabler by building relationships with:
    • Government and public sector stakeholders across international markets
    • Tourism boards, city partners, venues, and cultural institutions
  • Unlock opportunities to:
    • Support market entry for touring and resident shows
    • Facilitate partnerships and local integration
    • Strengthen Cirque du Soleil’s institutional influence outside the Americas
  • Coordinate closely with internal stakeholders to align on regulatory, reputational, and market access considerations, including visas, work permits, and cross-border touring requirements
5. Cross-Functional Orchestration
  • Own coordination across non-marketing functions to ensure aligned execution and messaging around shows, including:
    • Legal
    • HR (incl. talent mobility, immigration)
    • Sustainability
    • Operations
    • Sponsorship & partnerships
  • Act as the central orchestrator ensuring communications supports and amplifies show and market decisions
  • Ensure consistency between internal decisions, external messaging, and market execution, and act as the two-way bridge between international markets and HQ
6. Cultural Relevance & Media Impact
  • Position Cirque du Soleil’s shows as culturally relevant and premium in international markets
  • Build relationships with Tier 1 media, creators, and influencers across the UK, Europe, the Middle East, and Asia-Pacific
  • Activate cultural moments and partnerships tied to international show launches and runs
7. Team Leadership, Agency Governance & Performance
  • Lead and develop the PR teams embedded with the touring shows and the PR teams responsible for the resident shows, across multiple markets, time zones, and languages
  • Build a consistent operating model, capability plan, and career path across both team groups, including onboarding for new tours and openings
  • Approve and sign off on all agency appointments, scopes, and budgets proposed by the touring and resident show PR teams
  • Define and manage the international agency ecosystem, setting selection criteria, performance standards, and review cadence
  • Set KPIs tied to business impact (demand, awareness, launch momentum, ticket sales, social channel performance)
  • Partner with marketing and analytics to link comms and social to revenue outcomes
Profile & Experience
 
Required
  • 10+ years in communications/PR with multi-market, international leadership experience
  • Proven ability to operate communications as a growth and demand lever tied to sales outcomes
  • Strong experience in consumer, brand, or entertainment PR, ideally with campaign or launch ownership
  • Experience working with government or public sector stakeholders in international markets
  • Deep media relationships across the UK and Europe, with demonstrated reach into additional international markets
  • Experience directly leading distributed, multi-time-zone in-house teams, including teams embedded with touring operations
  • Proven track record appointing, contracting, and managing PR agencies across multiple markets
  • Strong command of organic social media strategy and community management for consumer or entertainment brands
  • Ability to operate in a matrixed, cross-functional environment with a North America–based headquarters
  • Fluent in English (mandatory); willingness to travel frequently across international markets
Preferred
  • Additional language(s) relevant to key international markets (e.g. French, Spanish, German, Arabic, Japanese, Mandarin)
  • Experience in entertainment, touring productions, live events, or premium brands
  • Strong understanding of how communications integrates with marketing, CRM, and revenue generation

jobs.title: Senior Product Marketing Manager
jobs.description:
SoSafe is shifting from a broad-market approach to a deliberate, segment-led GTM model. This role is central to that transition. As Manager of Segment & Solutions Marketing, you will own the positioning, messaging, and solution architecture for SoSafe's priority segments. These can be defined by geography, industry vertical, customer lifecycle stage, or Human Risk maturity.

We have a foundation to build from: a defined maturity model that maps how organisations progress in their Human Risk journey, a growing understanding of how customer needs differ across lifecycle stages and a set of priority markets and geographies. What we don't yet have is the messaging, the plays, and the product experience layer that makes those segments feel served

Your role is to and translate that work into measurable improvements in win rates, market penetration, and net revenue retention. This is a newly created role in Product Marketing that you’ll have influence to shape and will work in close partnership with GTM, Product, Sales, CS, and the Commercial Centre of Excellence.

Location: This role can be fully remote from anywhere in Germany, or hybrid from one of our offices in Cologne, Munich or Berlin.

Segmented Messaging

  • Own messaging for defined priority segments — including lifecycle stage (new business, upsell, cross-sell, retention), maturity tier, geography, and industry vertical (e.g. financial services, manufacturing)

  • Develop segment-specific value propositions written in buyer language: the situation they face, the consequence of inaction, how SoSafe solves it, and why SoSafe over alternatives without jargon, no feature lists

  • Use AI tools to accelerate research, messaging iteration, persona development, and competitive synthesis as a standard part of your workflow

  • Maintain and evolve messaging as product capabilities, customer insights, and the competitive landscape shift — keeping SoSafe's market fit current and differentiated

  • Monitor industry trends, regulatory developments, and competitive dynamics to proactively inform segment strategy and portfolio planning

Solution Development

  • Define solution sets for priority segments: which SoSafe capabilities address their most pressing needs, framed around business outcomes rather than product features

  • Process voice-of-customer research, win/loss data, competitive intelligence, and regulatory context into compelling segment narratives and solution architectures

  • Partner with the Commercial CoE to inform pricing, packaging, bundling, and programme decisions — contributing market and segment evidence to commercial recommendations that drive share within defined segments

GTM Readiness

  • Develop SPICED-aligned talk tracks for each priority segment, grounding rep conversations in the buyer's situation before working back to solution language

  • Build and maintain a library of scalable, reusable field assets e.g. solution briefs, demo scripts, battle cards, objection-handling guides, buyer and implementation guides — leveraging AI to produce, iterate, and personalise at speed

  • Validate messaging and demo content before market release through structured rep feedback sessions, customer interviews, and early cohort exposure

  • Input into coordinated multi-touch plays across Marketing, Sales, and CS that drive upsell and cross-sell into the install base — with clear pipeline and NRR impact metrics tied to each play

  • Track asset utilisation, field feedback, and segment performance data (win rates, pipeline velocity, NRR contribution) to continuously improve GTM effectiveness and demonstrate commercial impact


What you will bring

  • 5+ years in B2B SaaS in product marketing, solutions marketing or segment marketing with a proven track record of producing segment-specific or lifecycle-specific positioning

  • Demonstrated ability to write in buyer language: situation, problem, solution, outcome - not functional feature lists

  • Proficiency with competitive intelligence tools and a bias towards activating insight into sales & field-facing content, enriching the quality of their conversations

  • Proven AI fluency: you use AI tools daily to compress research cycles, pressure-test messaging, generate content variations, and move from insight to asset faster than a traditional workflow allows

  • Strong cross-functional operating skills, able to align Product, Sales, CS, and Commercial stakeholders around a segment strategy and drive execution

Preferred

  • Experience in cybersecurity, HR tech or a similarly technical B2B environment

  • Experience defining or contributing to solution sets and commercial packaging, not just messaging deliverables.

  • Background in structured pre-launch validation: rep councils, messaging test sessions, early cohort feedback

What we offer*

  • Work/Life balance: Flexible hours, 33 vacation days, and parental leave support

  • Wellbeing and financial support: Access to Open Up, Corporate Discounts, Wellbeing & Fitness Benefits

  • Connection & community: Virtual events, collaborative team activities, and opportunities for local meet-ups

  • And the list goes on: Tech equipment, referral bonuses, an individual development budget, dog-friendly HQ

*Perks and benefits listed above are for full-time employees and may vary slightly by office location. These are just a sample — you'll learn more during the interview process.

About Us

At SoSafe, we’re on a mission to make the digital world safer by addressing the human factor in cybersecurity. As one of the fastest-growing security awareness scale-ups worldwide, we leverage behavioural science and data-driven learning to empower people against cyber threats. Our Human Risk Management approach helps organisations turn their employees into their strongest line of defence.

Backed by leading VCs like Highland Europe and Global Founders Capital, we’re rapidly expanding across the globe. We’re looking for team players who want to drive meaningful change in cybersecurity, take ownership of their work, and grow with us.

If you thrive in a vibrant, purpose-driven environment that values innovation, diversity, and collaboration, then this is the place for you!

jobs.title: Operator Kwaliteit
jobs.description:
Als Operator binnen onze Quality & Cold End afdeling speel jij een essentiële rol in de eindfase van ons productieproces. Hier worden glazen flessen langzaam afgekoeld, gecontroleerd op afwijkingen en voorzien van een beschermende coating; allemaal onder jouw waakzaam oog.

Na de opleidingsperiode in dagdienst, word je tewerkgesteld in een 6 ploegenstelsel, waarin werk en privé in evenwicht blijven.

Verantwoordelijkheden & Belangrijkste Taken

Binnen elk van de operatorfuncties ligt de nadruk van de verantwoordelijkheden en belangrijkste taken wat anders. Hieronder meer informatie over wat je kan verwachten binnen onze Quality & Cold End afdeling:

Deze afdeling opereert onafhankelijk van alle andere afdelingen om zo de objectiviteit inzake kwaliteit te garanderen. De Quality-afdeling (kwaliteitsafdeling) speelt een cruciale rol in het waarborgen van de kwaliteit en veiligheid van de geproduceerde glazen flessen. Binnen het Cold End deel wordt het gevormde glas afgekoeld, geïnspecteerd, behandeld en verpakt — dus alles wat ná het vormen en gloeien (annealing) van het glas gebeurt.

  • Je voert kwaliteitscontroles uit tijdens de productie regelmatige controles op producten tijdens de productie (bijv. flesdikte, gewicht, vorm, barsten of luchtinsluitingen) alsook het controleren of producten voldoen aan specificaties en normen (zoals ISO-normen of klantspecificaties)

  • Je draagt zorg voor de visuele inspectie en automatische kwaliteitsdetectie met behulp van automatische inspectiesystemen die fouten detecteren zoals scheurtjes, vervormingen of vervuiling

  • Je beoordeelt afgekeurde producten en bepaalt of het om echte fouten gaat of valse meldingen

  • Je staat in voor het analyseren van afkeur en defecten om de oorzaak te vinden (bijv. verkeerde temperatuur, verkeerde malinstelling) en koppelt terug naar productie om processen te verbeteren

  • Het uitvoeren van fysieke (handmatige) tests op glas zoals drukproeven, thermische schokbestendigheid en chemische bestendigheid, alsook kleurmetingen of tests op coatings (zoals barrièrelagen of decoratie) behoren tot je takenpakket

  • Je volgt de flow rond het aanbrengen van coating (het glas krasbestendiger maken, wrijving tussen flessen verminderen, bescherming bieden bij verdere verwerking)

  • Je registreert de meetresultaten en afwijkingen in het kader van probleemoplossing, analyses en traceerbaarheid

  • Je lost de eerste lijnstoringen zelfstandig op

  • Bij een ander type product pas je de productielijn aan, stel je camera standpunten in en verzorg je de nodige parametrisatie in de diverse toestellen

  • Je voorziet ploegenoverdracht op het einde van je shift aan je opkomende ploeg

  • Je hebt ervaring binnen een productieomgeving of bent gemotiveerd om hierin ervaring op te doen

  • Je staat open om trainingen in dagdienst te volgen, waar flexibiliteit belangrijk is naar inhoud toe

  • Je kan met een computer werken

  • Je spreekt zeer goed Nederlands (Engels is een pluspunt)

jobs.title: Ratkaisuomistaja, Automaatio
jobs.description: Automaatio-tiimin ratkaisuomistaja. Siinä on energiaa - Tule meille näyttämään kykysi ja rakentamaan puhtaampaa energiajärjestelmää! Me Helenissä tarjoamme helpompaa ja mutkattomampaa arkea kaikkialla Suomessa. Lämmön, jäähdytyksen ja sähkön lisäksi tarjoamme ratkaisuja alueelliseen ja uusiutuvaan energiaan sekä sähköiseen liikenteeseen. Kehitämme fiksumpaa ja puhtaampaa energiajärjestelmää, jonka avulla pidämme huolta, että asiakkaamme voivat tuottaa, käyttää ja säästää energiaa ympäristöä kunnioittaen. Vähennämme suunnitelmallisesti päästöjämme ja tavoitteemme on irtautua polttamiseen perustuvasta energiantuotannosta vuoteen 2040 mennessä. Etsimme nyt ratkaisuomistajaa uuteen Automaatio-tiimiin. Tässä uudessa roolissa pääset varmistamaan, että Helenin energiajärjestelmän operoinnin kannalta keskeiset integraatiot toimivat luotettavasti, turvallisesti ja ennakoitavasti. Työsuhde on vakituinen. Automaatiotiimi vastaa siitä, että IT/OT-rajapintojen tietovirrat laitosten, verkkojen ja valvomojärjestelmien välillä toimivat keskeytyksettä. Tiimi toimii useiden IT- ja automaatiokumppaneiden kanssa ja varmistaa omalta osaltaan huoltovarmuuskriittisen toimintavarmuuden 24/7. Automaatiokerroksen tietoturva on yksi tiimin keskeisistä vastuualueista. Roolissasi Johdat Automaatio-tiimin työtä ja sen omistamia digitaalisia ratkaisuja.Vastaat IT/OT-rajapintojen arkkitehtuurista ja elinkaaren hallinnasta.Varmistat ratkaisujen jatkuvuutta, teknisten riskien hallintaa ja palveluiden palauttamista poikkeustilanteissa.Johdat tiimiä tukevien kumppaneiden työtä.Vastaat tiimin talouden suunnittelusta, seurannasta ja tavoitteiden mukaisesta ohjauksesta.Uudistat toimintamalleja yhdessä liiketoimintojen kanssa Helen-tasoista tehokkuutta tavoitellen.Vastaat pidemmän aikavälin suunnittelusta, priorisoinnista ja roadmap-työstä.Vastaat työn, nykytilan, päätösten ja kehityssuunnan läpinäkyvyydestä sidosryhmille.Teet tiivistä yhteistyötä liiketoiminnan automaatioasiantuntijoiden, SCADA-tiimin, tietoturvatiimin, kumppaneiden sekä Digitaalisten ratkaisujen johdon kanssa.Toivomme sinulta Vähintään 3 vuoden kokemusta kriittisten automaatiojärjestelmien tiedonhallinnasta, teollisuusautomaatiojärjestelmien periaatteista ja tiedonsiirtoprotokollista.Kokemusta teknisenä johtajana toimimisesta ja sidosryhmien johtamisesta.Ymmärrystä järjestelmäarkkitehtuureista, tietovirroista ja laajoista end-to-end-kokonaisuuksista.Kykyä arvioida teknisten ratkaisujen kustannuksia, hyötyjä ja liiketoiminta-arvoa.Kokemusta ketterien menetelmien ja työkalujen hyödyntämisestä käytännön työssä.Huolellista, jämäkkää ja innostavaa työotetta myös tilanteissa, joissa pienillä muutoksilla voi olla laajoja vaikutuksia.Erinomaisia kirjallisia ja suullisia viestintätaitoja suomeksi ja englanniksi.Aiempi kokemus energiatoimialalta ei ole välttämätöntä, mutta siitä on tehtävässä hyötyä.Tarjoamme sinulle Tarjoamme sinulle merkityksellisen roolin Helenin energiajärjestelmän ytimessä. Pääset vaikuttamaan liiketoiminnalle kriittisiin kokonaisuuksiin, joiden toimivuus näkyy suoraan operoinnin sujuvuudessa, muutosten ennakoitavuudessa ja päätöksenteon luotettavuudessa. Pääset rakentamaan uutta tiimiä ja sen käytänteitä, kehittämään IT/OT-rajapintojen arkkitehtuuria ja vahvistamaan Helenin kykyä johtaa energiajärjestelmää datan, automaation ja kumppaniverkoston avulla. Lisäksi pääset nauttimaan henkilöstöeduistamme, kuten henkilöstösähköstä, hyväntekeväisyystyöpäivästä, mahdollisuudesta etätyöhön ulkomailla sekä hyvinvointiedusta. Toimistomme sijaitsee Ruoholahden We Landissa, ja työskentelemme joustavasti hybridimallilla. Tehtävän palkka määräytyy tehtävän vaativuuden sekä osaamisesi ja kokemuksesi perusteella. Voit kysyä meillä työskentelystä tai tehtävästä tarkemmin tulevalta esihenkilöltäsi (Henri Ihalainen / etunimi.sukunimi@helen.fi) ja ratkaisualueen päälliköltä (Janne Piispanen / etunimi.sukunimi@helen.fi). He ovat parhaiten tavoitettavissa sähköpostitse toimistoaikoina (klo 8-16). Kiinnostuitko? Mahtavaa! Voit hakea rekryjärjestelmämme kautta viimeistään 30.8.2026. Huomioithan, että käsittelemme hakemuksia jo hakuaikana. Toivottavasti kuulemme sinusta pian!

jobs.title: Oliver James Associates - Senior React Developer
jobs.description:
We are looking for an experienced Senior React Developer to join an established development team working on a large-scale enterprise application. This is a long-term freelance opportunity for professionals who enjoy building robust frontend solutions while collaborating closely with backend engineers in a mature, monolithic technology environment.

Working model

  • Location: Brussels, Belgium
  • Onsite Requirement: 50% onsite presence is mandatory. Candidates must be comfortable working from the client's offices on a regular basis
  • Contract Type: Freelance

What you'll do

  • Develop and maintain complex React-based frontend applications
  • Work closely with Java backend developers to design and implement new features
  • Contribute to technical discussions and solution design
  • Deliver high-quality, maintainable, and scalable code
  • Participate in code reviews and promote engineering best practices

If you are a senior React developer who thrives in enterprise environments, enjoys close collaboration with backend teams, and is looking for a long-term freelance opportunity in Brussels, we'd love to hear from you. We are looking for someone who:
  • Has at least 5 years of professional experience in frontend development
  • Has strong, hands-on experience with React and modern JavaScript/TypeScript
  • Has experience working within monolithic application architectures and understands the challenges and advantages of enterprise environments
  • Enjoys collaborating closely with Java backend developers to deliver high-quality end-to-end solutions
  • Is capable of working independently, taking ownership of tasks from analysis through delivery
  • Communicates fluently in English (written and spoken). English is the only working language for this role

jobs.title: International Car Transport Driver
jobs.description:
Are you an experienced CE Driver with a passion for cars and international transport? As an International Car Transport Driver, you will ensure the safe and timely delivery of vehicles across Germany, the Benelux, France, and Austria, while representing the company with professionalism at every customer location.

Your responsibilities?

  • Transport passenger vehicles safely and efficiently across Germany, the Benelux, France, and Austria, ensuring timely pick-up and delivery;
  • Load and unload vehicles in accordance with safety procedures and quality standards;
  • Carry out a thorough visual inspection of every vehicle before collection and upon delivery, reporting any damage accurately;
  • Follow transport instructions, customer requirements and operational procedures with great attention to detail;
  • Provide customers with a professional and customer-focused service throughout every assignment;
  • Represent the company as a reliable ambassador through safe driving, clear communication and a professional attitude.

What makes you the ideal candidate?

  • Valid CE driving licence with Code 95;
  • Experience as an international CE driver is an advantage, while experience in car transport is a strong asset;
  • Excellent knowledge of traffic regulations and a safe, defensive driving style;
  • Good command of English and/or German to communicate effectively with customers and colleagues;
  • Solid knowledge of the European road network and the ability to organise international transport efficiently;
  • Flexible, punctual and customer-oriented approach with respect for procedures and quality standards;
  • Sharp eye for vehicle inspections and a strong sense of responsibility when loading, transporting and delivering vehicles.

jobs.title: Resepsjonist i 100 % stilling ved Nermo Hotell
jobs.description:
Ønsker du å være en del av et historisk hotell der du kan bidra til å skape uforglemmelige opplevelser for gjestene? På Nermo Hotell søker vi nå en resepsjonist i 100% fast stilling.

Hva vi ser etter

  • Erfaring fra hotellresepsjon eller relevant servicebransje er en fordel

  • Du behersker norsk (eller annet skandinavisk språk) og engelsk godt, muntlig og skriftlig

  • God teknisk forståelse og komfort med bookingsystemer og digitale verktøy

  • Modenhet og evne til å ta ansvar når det skjer mye på en gang

  • Fagbrev som resepsjonist eller utdanning innen reiseliv/hospitality er positivt, men ikke et krav, vi legger stor vekt på personlig egnethet.

Arbeidsoppgaver

  • Daglige resepsjonsoppgaver fra innsjekk til utsjekk

  • Håndtere bookinger, betalinger og forespørsler på e-post, telefon og over skranke

  • Koordinere med restaurant, husøkonomi og øvrige avdelinger for å oppfylle gjestenes ønsker

  • Aktivt salg og mersalg av rom, pakker og aktiviteter

  • Kassehåndtering og daglige oppgjør/rutiner

  • Bidra til at resepsjon og fellesområder alltid fremstår ryddige, inviterende og profesjonelle

Vi tilbyr

  • Fast 100% stilling i et familiedrevet, historisk hotell med lange tradisjoner

  • Turnus med dag-, kveld- og helgevakter

  • Kort vei mellom beslutning og handling -- du blir sett og hørt

  • Inkluderende arbeidsmiljø med høyt fokus på vertskap og gjesteopplevelser

  • Muligheter til å utvikle deg videre innen resepsjon og hotellfaget

  • Konkurransedyktig lønn og fordeler

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Nermo Hotell ligger ved Hafjell, rett nord for Lillehammer, og er kjent for personlig vertskap, gode måltider, stabburssuiter og golfbane på tunet.

Her møter du gjester som kommer for både jobb og fritid -- fra konferansegjester til barnefamilier, par og stamgjester.

jobs.title: Personlig assistent i unik BPA-ordning
jobs.description:
BPA i 1-til-1 for mann på 38 år med Downs syndrom. Eier sin egen leilighet (ikke bofellesskap eller omsorgsbolig). Stor frihet og fleksibilitet i arbeidet. Langvakter, kun 7 dager pr måned - 77% stilling (evt mindre kan avtales). Vikariat - foreløpig til 31.12.2026, kan bli forlenget.

Hva vi ser etter

Du må være trygg på deg selv. Du må være omsorgsfull og kunne jobbe selvstendig, husk du er alene på jobb sammen med bistandsmottaker! Du må kunne skape et trygt og godt liv for bistandsmottaker. Du må like fysisk aktivitet.

Et absolutt krav er at du MÅ snakke godt norsk østlandsdialekt.

Personlig egnethet betyr mer enn faglige kvalifikasjoner.

Du MÅ disponere egen bil som du kan bruke i jobben (kjøregodtgjørelse er inkludert).

Arbeidsoppgaver

Praktisk bistand i daglige gjøremål, f.eks. matlaging, renhold, klesvask, handling. Kjøring og henting til arbeidssenter, fritidsaktiviteter, butikker, osv

Bistandsmottaker er i stor grad selvhjulpen, har god helse, spiser sunt og går gjerne lange turer i skogen. Han forstår det meste som blir sagt, har eget talespråk og kan lese litt.

Ditt hovedansvar er å sørge for at bistandsmottaker kan leve et fritt og selvstendig liv.

Vi tilbyr

Unik mulighet til å bidra til god livskvalitet for bistandsmottaker, i tett samarbeid med 3 andre assistenter og med foreldre.

Vi er også interesserte i kandidater som ikke kan fylle hele stillingen, vi kan planlegge for enkeltvakter en måned eller mer i forveien.

Lønn på linje med kommunalt ansatte i bofellesskap og samlokaliserte boliger.

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Vi har hatt avtale med Halden kommune om drift av BPA-ordningen siden 2012. Erikbo eies i sin helhet av bistandsmottakers foreldre. Vårt prinsipp er så få ansatte og så lange vakter som mulig innenfor arbeidsmiljølovens bestemmelser.

Vi gjør vårt ytterste for at alle skal ha det bra - bistandsmottaker, assistenter og foreldre.

https://bip.rumia.pl/a,46241,rk210182026-nabor-na-wolne-stanowisko-pracy-inspektor-glowny-specjalista-km-w-referacie-ds-energetyk.html
Zakres wykonywanych zadań na stanowisku, w szczególności:
1) monitorowanie zmian w prawie oraz w politykach wyższego szczebla dotyczących polityki niskoemisyjnej i energetyki,
2) współpraca z różnymi podmiotami, w tym innymi jednostkami miejskimi w zakresie właściwości Referatu,
3) planowanie, prowadzenie oraz promowanie działań związanych z prowadzoną polityką niskoemisyjną i energetyczną w Gminie,
4) realizacja projektów/programów z energetyki,
5) prowadzenie spraw w zakresie oświetlenia dróg i miejsc publicznych, w tym:
a) kontrola nad utrzymaniem i eksploatacją infrastruktury oświetleniowej miasta,
b) inwentaryzacja majątku oświetleniowego,
c) uzgadnianie dokumentacji technicznej dotyczącej sieci oświetleniowych,
d) analizowanie stanu majątku oświetleniowego i opracowywanie planów zabiegów inwestycyjnych, eksploatacyjnych, modernizacyjnych,
e) realizacja remontów i inwestycji oświetleniowych,
f)  analiza i kontrola zgłoszeń awarii sieci oświetleniowej oraz kontrola nad ich usuwaniem,
6) zakup, montaż, remonty oświetleniowych ozdób świątecznych,
7) prowadzenie spraw w zakresie odnawialnych źródeł energii (OZE  m.in. fotowoltaika, pompy ciepła),

jobs.description:
About the team

SumUp is best known for helping small businesses get paid — our Consumer tribe builds the other half of that story. We make SumUp Consumer, the wallet app that lets everyday consumers pay SumUp merchants on a tap, send money to friends, track their spending, and earn loyalty rewards along the way. As we grow SumUp Consumer across new markets and features, we need sharp, reliable insight into how people actually use it. As the tribe scales, so does the need for sharp, reliable insight into how people actually use what we build.

We're looking for a Product Analyst to join the Consumer tribe and become the analytical partner for SumUp Consumer — working closely with Product Managers, Designers, and Engineers, and alongside our Analytics Engineering team, to understand customer behaviour, shape product strategy, and measure what matters.

If you're motivated by meaningful analytical work, enjoy translating complexity into clarity, and want to see your insights directly influence product decisions — this role is for you.

What you'll do

  • Analyse customer behaviour and product performance for SumUp Consumer using funnel analysis, cohort analysis, segmentation, and behavioural analytics to identify opportunities and drive improvements
  • Support Product Managers in understanding customer journeys, engagement, conversion, and retention — helping to shape product strategy and priorities
  • Conduct exploratory analysis to answer product and business questions, translating complex data into clear, actionable recommendations
  • Define, monitor, and communicate core SumUp Consumer KPIs — covering activation, engagement, and retention — and evaluate the impact of product changes for stakeholders
  • Design, execute, and analyse A/B tests and product experiments, helping to embed a culture of experimentation across the Consumer tribe
  • Build and maintain dashboards and reporting, proactively surfacing trends, anomalies, and growth opportunities before they're asked for
  • Partner with Analytics Engineering to ensure KPI definitions, business logic, and product instrumentation are accurate, scalable, and trusted
  • Bring a curious eye to AI and machine learning techniques, including LLM-assisted analysis, to speed up insight generation and product measurement
  • Collaborate closely with Product Managers, Designers, Engineers, and Data teams to ground decisions in robust analysis and customer insight

You'll be great for this role if…

  • You have strong SQL skills and are comfortable querying, analysing, and validating data in a cloud data warehouse (Snowflake, BigQuery, or similar)
  • You have hands-on experience with product analytics techniques such as funnel analysis, cohort analysis, and segmentation
  • You've worked on A/B tests or product experiments, with a solid grounding in the statistics behind them
  • You're proficient in a visualisation tool such as Looker, Tableau, or Power BI, with a track record of building dashboards that stakeholders actually use
  • You can translate ambiguous business questions into structured analysis, and explain findings clearly to technical and non-technical audiences alike
  • You're curious about how AI and emerging techniques can improve product measurement, experimentation, and customer understanding
  • You're comfortable managing multiple workstreams and stakeholders, with strong prioritisation and a proactive communication style

Why you should join SumUp

🌎 Opportunity to work in a truly global, multicultural team from our open, vibrant Cologne office, located in the heart of the city. This involves an office-first setup

🌈 Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion: be part of a workplace that values and promotes diversity, fostering an inclusive environment where everyone's perspectives are respected and embraced

🚀 Enrolment onto our Virtual Stock Option programme: you will own a stake in SumUp's future success

📚 A dedicated annual L&D budget of €2000 for your individual development, which can be used to attend conferences and/or advance your career through further education

🏖 Generous time off: enjoy 28 days of paid leave plus public holidays and special leave days

🚗 Commute made easy: subsidised mobility options like discounted transport tickets or bike leasing

💪 Stay active: access to fitness via Urban Sports Club, mostly covered by SumUp

💰 Financial health: a corporate pension scheme with SumUp contributing an extra 20% on top of your contribution

🎁 Employee perks: get discounts across products and services via our Corporate Benefits platform

🌴 Break4me: 1-month sabbatical after 3 years of service

🔗 Referral Bonus: earn additional rewards by referring talented individuals to join the SumUp team

About SumUp

Be empowered to do more that matters.

At SumUp, we're on a mission to empower small businesses across the globe by providing simple and affordable tools that allow them to thrive. Today, over 4 million businesses in 37 markets rely on SumUp as their financial partner to manage payments, finance and customer relationships.

Our commitment to small businesses is reflected in our diverse team of over 3,000 SumUppers from over 90 nationalities, united by global collaboration and an innovative mindset. Our core values lay the foundation for who we are and what we stand for, shaping our work culture and driving our success. We foster inclusivity and a continuous learning culture, providing a safe space for personal and professional growth. Our differences make us unique and strong as we strive to create an environment where everyone belongs and feels supported, no matter how they identify.

SumUp is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity employer, actively seeking and embracing diversity in our workforce. We don't make hiring or employment decisions based on race, colour, religion or religious belief, ethnic or national origin, nationality, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, disability, age or any other basis protected by applicable laws or prohibited by company policy. Our commitment extends beyond recruitment to creating a safe and respectful workplace where harassment of any form is strictly prohibited. Discover more about our culture and opportunities on our careers website, and follow our journey on LinkedIn, Instagram, and TikTok.

Job Application Tip

We recognise that candidates feel they need to meet 100% of the job criteria in order to apply for a job. Please note that this is only a guide. If you don't tick every box, it's ok too because it means you have room to learn and develop your career at SumUp.

jobs.title: Head of Privacy
jobs.description:
About Us

Perk (formerly TravelPerk) is the intelligent platform for travel and spend management. Built to tackle the time-consuming, manual work that gets in the way of real work, our tools automate everything from travel bookings to expenses, invoice processing, and more. By eliminating this shadow work that wastes hours, erodes morale, and saps innovation, we’re on a mission to power real work, with real impact.

We’re trusted by more than 10,000 companies worldwide, including Wise, On Running, Breitling, and Fabletics, and we’re tackling the 7 hours of lost productivity per employee each week, a $1.7 trillion problem.

Founded in 2015, Perk has grown into a global company of more than 1,800 people across 12 offices globally, with headquarters in London and Boston. We combine innovation, control, and simplicity to transform how businesses work and how people feel at work.

At Perk, we’re driven by our values, like being an owner, delivering a 7-star experience, and working as one team. We value curiosity, purpose, and mindset, not just knowledge, to unlock the power in your potential. Our talent team brings together leading minds from the travel and SaaS industries, representing over 70 countries. If you’re excited about having a real impact and shaping how millions of people experience work, we’d love you on the team.

Visit www.perk.com to learn more.

Head of Privacy
Perk is the intelligent platform for travel and spend - bringing travel bookings, events, expense management, and invoice payments together in one AI-powered platform. We serve thousands of businesses globally, from high-growth start-ups to major enterprises, and we’re backed by world-class investors.

We’re a SaaS and AI technology scale-up, with hubs across Europe and the US. We’re building a company where AI isn’t just the backbone of the product - it’s in how every team works. Across Perk, we use tools like Claude and Gemini to move faster, think bigger, and deliver at a scale that would be impossible without them.

We rebranded from TravelPerk to Perk in March 2025 to reflect the breadth of what we’ve become, and what we’re going to be. If you want to do the most impactful work of your career, in a team that’s genuinely reimagining what in-house privacy looks like, we’d love to hear from you.


What’s the role?
You’re a leader (or a person looking to lead) with around seven years’ experience developing their specialism in Privacy. Perhaps you’re frustrated at your lack of autonomy? Perhaps you have radical ideas as to how a modern privacy team functions, but you don’t have the platform to execute those ideas? Great: you may be what we’re looking for.

You will help to build and scale our customer trust program, and you’ll drive our privacy operations strategy. To help Perk win, you will simplify the increasingly complex regulatory landscape of privacy, AI, cybersecurity, and data governance into outcomes that our customers can feel. You will be highly literate in (and capable of independently deploying) technology to create user-friendly automated workflows that drive innovation and maintain product development velocity, all while ensuring the best-in-class data protection standards our customers and staff expect.

What will your day-to-day look like?
This is a “doing” role - with a strong strategic component - where a strong bias to action is critical. It is not an abstract strategy role, and you won’t be reviewed on the quality of your decks or memos. Rather: you will deliver high-impact, creative, commercial solutions to improve our privacy posture and scale our privacy program; you will collaborate with and work through teams to keep integrating privacy by design into our products; you’ll also identify and manage the privacy and AI compliance risks that matter most, support key business and product choices, strengthen our culture of privacy, and help other leaders make well-informed decisions involving the responsible use of data.

You will also collaborate closely with the DPO, and build trust continually with the Security, People/HR, Procurement, Product and Engineering, Data, Revenue, and Customer Care teams to ensure alignment on company initiatives involving the processing of personal data. You’ll manage a team of two.

What will the role entail?
On taking the role, you will:

  • Own and evolve Perk’s global privacy program, setting a risk-based strategy, roadmap, policies and controls aligned with applicable laws, regulatory expectations and customer commitments.

  • Contribute to Perk’s global AI governance program, working closely with Builders, Security and Legal.

  • Advise the CLO, executive team and business leaders on material privacy risks, helping them make practical choices that protect individuals, manage compliance exposure and support Perk’s commercial objectives.

  • Maintain an accurate view of Perk’s personal data and processing activities, including the ROPA, data flows, classification, lawful bases, cross-border transfer mechanisms and subprocessor transparency.

  • Oversee operational privacy controls, including retention and deletion, cookies and tracking, consent and preference management, marketing compliance, privacy notices, and individual rights and complaints (DSR).

  • Support data governance protocols, collaborating with the Data, Engineering, and Security teams to acquire the right governance tools.

  • Oversee the risk-based review of new personal data processing initiatives, including PIAs/DPIAs, LIAs, AI inventory and classification, and AI risk and impact assessments. Ensure agreed mitigation actions are tracked through to completion.

  • Partner with Security to align on privacy requirements and coordinate the privacy workstream for personal data breaches. Work with AI governance owners on AI incidents, including assessment, escalation, notification and remediation.

  • Own privacy risk reporting and assurance, including the privacy risk register, audit-ready evidence, control testing and meaningful privacy metrics covering material risks, incidents, remediation, patterns, trends, and program performance.

  • Collaborate with Security, Engineering, and other departments to integrate privacy by design into product development, business operations, and marketing activities, and assist in the implementation and upkeep of privacy-enhancing technologies (PET).

  • Monitor regulatory and enforcement developments across Perk’s key jurisdictions, and ensure privacy guidelines, and other knowledge resources are clear, practical, up-to-date, and aligned with the latest regulatory updates.

  • Create and maintain privacy products and resources, such as our Trust Center, to effectively share privacy knowledge with both internal and external customers.

  • Oversee the privacy tooling and automation roadmap, ensuring scalable workflows, reliable data and clear evidence.

  • Oversee a risk-based third-party privacy program, including due diligence, DPAs, AI-specific terms, periodic reviews of higher-risk vendors, and clear remediation and escalation routes.

  • Support Revenue and customer-facing teams on delivering customers’ privacy expectations, due diligence and contractual commitments, helping build trust without creating disproportionate risk.

Where will the role take you?
This role will provide you with exceptional experience of working in a fast scaling, global tech (and specifically SaaS/ fintech) business. You will develop the tools and techniques to deliver internal privacy and AI compliance capability at scale which subverts the expectations of stakeholders regarding law (i.e. that it is bureaucracy) and drives tangible business outcomes - while also reflecting our company’s values of providing seven star service, being ethical and acting responsibly in how we handle personal data.

In terms of promotions, we do not expect to hire “over your head”; instead, we are looking for you to grow and scale capability in your areas of expertise.

Perk will offer you as much latitude as you want in order to deliver the best possible outcomes for your customers; and micromanagement/ layers of bureaucracy are not part of that process. We are committed to equipping you with the necessary resources to establish a world-class data privacy culture. Your efforts will contribute to the growth and prominence of your professional profile as a leading expert in the privacy field.


AI Fluency: What We Expect
At Perk, AI isn’t a nice-to-have - it’s how we work. We expect every lawyer on this team to be curious, capable, and opinionated when it comes to AI.

Specifically, we’re looking for someone who:

  • Has genuine curiosity about frontier model capability - you’ll actively follow what’s happening with LLMs, both in terms of their capabilities and risks, and have a view on where they’re heading

  • Is comfortable working in AI tools like Claude (including building skills files and workflows) as part of their daily practice

  • Has a thoughtful opinion on how the practice of law will evolve - and is excited to be part of shaping that evolution rather than watching it happen

  • Understands (or wants to understand) the regulatory landscape around AI - including the EU AI Act and emerging global frameworks

You don’t need to be an engineer on day one. But you do need to arrive with curiosity, a willingness to experiment, and the conviction that AI has changed how legal teams operate.


Essentials
In all instances, you must be able to demonstrate:

  • AI fluency (as we summarise that term above).

  • Experience driving operational outcomes.

  • Exceptional storytelling capabilities, as part of an overall package of excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to communicate and collaborate effectively at all levels of our organisation.

  • A willingness to seek growth, in your personal and professional life.

  • Experience working with fast-paced engineering/product development teams.

  • Knowledge of global privacy, cybersecurity and AI regulations, such as GDPR, CCPA, EU AI Act, NIS2, DORA, EU Data Act, and other regional laws in those fields; it helps if you understand related frameworks and standards, such as ISO 27001, 27701, 23894 and 42001, NIST Privacy and AI Risk Management frameworks, SOC 2, and Privacy by Design (PbD) principles.


On the last bullet: we are interested in your practical abilities, not how much of GDPR/ CCPA you can recite from memory. We encourage curious individuals who possess a genuine passion for learning and growth, even if they do not meet every requirement listed, to apply for this role. We firmly believe in providing opportunities for motivated individuals to expand their skills and thrive within our team.

What We Offer

  • Receive competitive compensation and equity ownership in Perk

  • Rest and recharge with 25 days of annual leave plus bank holidays

  • Take control of your physical health with private medical cover and voluntary dental insurance from Bupa, and discounted gym memberships with GymFlex

  • Plan for your future with our qualifying earnings company pension plan with Aviva

  • Know that your loved ones are protected financially through your Life Insurance if the worst were to happen

  • Rest assured that you’re covered by income protection in case you experience a long-term sickness or absence

  • Leverage tax-efficient cycle and electric car schemes with Cycle2Work & Octopus

  • Join our unforgettable Perk events, including our spectacular annual summer party

  • Always feel supported with Spring Health, our market-leading wellbeing partner, providing fast, comprehensive access to 12x therapy and 12x coaching sessions for you and your loved ones

  • Focus on your family with 12-16 weeks’ paid parental leave

  • Contribute to your community with 16 paid hours per year to spend volunteering for your dearest charitable causes

  • Broaden your horizons with up to 20 "Work from Anywhere" days per year

  • Stay savvy with access to a wide variety of discounts and rewards

  • Follow your passions and take a four-week, fully paid sabbatical once you reach 5 years

  • Let us help you move to one of our hubs with relocation support

AI at Perk
AI is embedded in how we work across every function. The tools you'll use day-to-day are AI-enabled, so you can move faster and spend more time on the work that matters. In practice, that means using AI to research and prioritise accounts, draft and refine outreach, handle customer interactions more effectively, synthesise information, and cut through shadow work - the invisible tasks that pull people away from the work only they can do - so you can focus on relationships and outcomes.

We don't expect you to be an AI expert, but we do expect you to be curious and intentional about it. The bar is judgment: knowing when AI makes your work better, when to verify what it produces, and when to rely on your own expertise instead.

We'll ask about how you use AI in your interviews, not to test tool knowledge, but to understand how you think about it. That reflects how we work every day.

How We Work

At Perk, we take an IRL-first approach to work, where our team works together in-person 3 days a week. As such, this role requires you to be based within commuting distance of our hubs. We fundamentally believe in the value of meeting in real life to improve connectivity, productivity, creativity and ultimately making us a great place to work.

For certain roles, we can help with relocation from anywhere in the world, English is the official language at the office. Please submit your resume in English if you choose to apply. Do not forget to submit an updated portfolio and/or resume.

Perk is a global company with a diverse customer base, and we want to make sure the people behind our product reflect that. We’re an equal opportunity employer, which means you’re welcome at Perk regardless of how you look, where you’re from, or anything else that makes you, well, you.

Protect Yourself from Recruitment Scams

All official communication from Perk will always come from email addresses ending in @perk.com or @externalperk.com, our verified social media channels, or recruiters listed on our official LinkedIn page. We will never ask you to pay for equipment, training, or fees, request sensitive personal information such as bank details early in the process, or communicate through unofficial apps like WhatsApp, Telegram, or Signal. If you receive a message claiming to be from Perk that seems suspicious, please do not respond. Forward it to security [at] perk .com, and we will confirm whether it is legitimate.

jobs.title: Regional prosjektleiar – Nasjonaljubileet 2029 i Møre og Romsdal
jobs.description:
Vinteren 1028-1029 flykta kong Olav Haraldsson frå sine fiendar inn Storfjorden, gjennom Valldal og vidare over fjella til Lesja på veg mot eksil.

Tusen år seinare skal denne historia løftast fram når Møre og Romsdal markerer Nasjonaljubileet i 2029 med tema folketradisjon, året før den store nasjonale markeringa på Stiklestad i 2030. Saman er vi Nasjonaljubileet 2030 -- Noreg i 1000 år.

Vi søkjer etter ein samlande og initiativrik regional prosjektleiar som ikkje berre koordinerer, men som aktivt utviklar, sett i gang og driv arbeidet framover mot markeringa i Møre og Romsdal. Du får ei sentral rolle i å samle kommunar, institusjonar, tru- og livssynsaktørar, frivillige og næringsliv til ei markering som både engasjerer regionalt og blir synleg nasjonalt.

Om stillinga

Som regional prosjektleiar får du ansvar for å planleggje og gjennomføre markeringa av Nasjonaljubileet 2029 i Møre og Romsdal.

Du skal initiere samarbeid, stimulere til aktivitetar i heile fylket og bidra til at historia og folketradisjonane i Møre og Romsdal får ein tydeleg plass i jubileet. Arbeidet skjer i tett samarbeid med prosjektgruppe, ressursgrupper, styringsgruppa, den nasjonale jubileumsorganisasjonen og ei rekkje regionale samarbeidspartnarar.

Arbeidsoppgåver

  • leie planlegging og gjennomføring av Nasjonaljubileet 2029 i Møre og Romsdal

  • initiere, utvikle og koordinere aktivitetar og arrangement som styrkar jubileet, i samarbeid med lokale og regionale aktørar

  • byggje nettverk og skape samarbeid mellom kommunar, tru- og livssynsaktørar, kulturinstitusjonar, frivillig sektor og næringsliv, som kan føre til varig verdiskaping

  • bidra til synleggjering av Møre og Romsdal si historie og kultur i jubileumsmarkeringa

  • sikre framdrift, utvida finansiering, koordinering og god forankring i arbeidet

Kven vi ser etter

Vi ser etter deg som

  • har erfaring med planlegging og gjennomføring av større prosjekt eller arrangement

  • har god samfunnsforståing og interesse for kultur, historie og samfunnsutvikling

  • trivst med å jobbe sjølvstendig, samtidig som du samarbeider godt med andre

  • er ein relasjonsbyggar som tek tydeleg initiativ og skaper framdrift i samarbeid med andre

  • arbeider strukturert og målretta

Relevant høgare utdanning er ein fordel, men ikkje eit krav. Lang og relevant erfaring kan kompensere for manglande utdanning. Personlege eigenskapar vil bli vektlagt.

Vi tilbyr

  • ei sentral rolle i eit nasjonalt jubileum med regionalt ansvar

  • moglegheit til å løfte fram Møre og Romsdal sin plass i historia

  • eit engasjert fagmiljø og samarbeid med aktørar over heile landet

  • varierte, utfordrande og meiningsfulle arbeidsoppgåver

Arbeidsstad og vilkår

Arbeidsstaden er Valldal i Fjord kommune, Møre og Romsdal, der prosjektet har si base. Valldal har ei særleg historisk tilknyting til jubileet gjennom flukta til Olav Haraldsson i 1029.

Noko reiseverksemd må påreknast, og søkjar må disponere eigen bil. Det kan leggjast til rette for noko fleksibilitet når det gjeld arbeidsstad. Stillinga er ei treårig prosjektstilling.

Lønn etter avtale og kvalifikasjonar.

Gode pensjons- og forsikringsordningar.

Søk stillinga

Vil du vere med å forme korleis Møre og Romsdal skal markere Noreg i 1000 år?

Send oss søknad og CV som fortel kven du er og kvifor denne stillinga passer for deg. Vi ser etter deg som har ideane, energien og gjennomføringskrafta til å gjere Nasjonaljubileet 2029 til ei oppleving heile fylket vil hugse. Aktuelle kandidatar vil bli kalla inn til intervju.

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Arbeidsgjevar er Fjordhagen AS, næringshagen i Fjord kommune, med kontor i eit hyggeleg kontorfellesskap i Valldal sentrum. Den som vert tilsett får Valldal som hovudarbeidsstad og vil bidra til å byggje vidare prosjektmiljøet lokalt fram mot jubileet i 2029.

Fjordhagen arbeider med næringsutvikling, gründerstøtte og ulike prosjekt, og har for tida 3 tilsette fordelt på 2 årsverk.

jobs.title: Lärare i bild och form på Estetiska programmet Västerhöjd
jobs.description:
I rollen blir du en del av Sektor barn och utbildning. Hos oss står barnens och ungdomarnas utveckling i fokus. Vi arbetar med utbildning från förskola till gymnasieskola och vi strävar efter en pedagogisk helhetssyn från 1 till 20 år. Du ser digitala verktyg som en naturlig del i av din arbetsvardag. Vi är säkra på att du nyttjar digitaliseringen för att tillgängliggöra undervisningen och att du är nyfiken på hur detta kan gagna barns och elevers lärande. Du har tillgång till digitala verktyg i undervisningen och har ett nära samarbete i ett kollegialt lärande.

Gymnasium Skövde är samlingsnamnet för kommunens två gymnasieskolor Kavelbro och Västerhöjd. Tillsammans erbjuder skolorna 16 nationella gymnasieprogram, introduktionsprogram med olika inriktningar samt anpassad gymnasieskola med tre nationella program och individuellt program. Vi erbjuder också nationella idrottsutbildningar inom handboll och fotboll. Skolorna har ett brett internationellt kontaktnät och utbyte med andra länder. Vi ingår även i Teknikcollege och Vård- och omsorgscollege. Gymnasium Skövde har idag cirka 2 300 elever och 300 anställda. Läs mer: www.gymnasiumskovde.se

1 plats(er).

ARBETSUPPGIFTER
    • Planera, genomföra och utvärdera undervisning i estetiska ämnen
    • Gemensamt driva arbetslaget och programmet

KVALIFIKATIONER
    • Vi söker dig som är legitimerad lärare med behörighet att undervisa i bild och form på gymnasiet.
    • Du har goda ämneskunskaper och ett stort intresse för bild, konst och kreativt skapande.
    • Du är trygg i din lärarroll och skapar en inspirerande och inkluderande lärmiljö där eleverna får utvecklas utifrån sina egna förutsättningar.
    • Du arbetar strukturerat och självständigt, samtidigt som du har lätt för att samarbeta med kollegor.
    • Erfarenhet av gymnasieundervisning och kunskaper inom både traditionella och digitala bildtekniker är meriterande.
    • Stor vikt läggs vid personlig lämplighet och engagemang för elevernas lärande och utveckling.

Anställningsform: Tidsbegränsad anställning.
Varaktighet: 6 månader eller längre, tillträde: 2026-09-21 eller enligt överenskommelse t o m 2027-06-16.

I Skövde kommun jobbar vi med allt från omsorg, stöd och utbildning till infrastruktur, underhåll, kulturliv och tillväxt. Hos oss finns hundratals yrken och 5500 medarbetare.

Jämställda, jämlika och inkluderande verksamheter är en självklarhet för oss.

Som medarbetare i Skövde kommun är du en viktig spelare i ett lag som varje dag, året om levererar tjänster och service till våra kunder. Det är i mötet med våra kunder som värdet av vårt arbete uppstår.

Vi satsar på dig som medarbetare och erbjuder kompetensutveckling, förmånliga pensionsvillkor, friskvårdsbidrag samt flera friskvårdsaktiviteter och erbjudanden. Och det bästa av allt, vi har plats för fler.

I Skövde kommun har vi individuell och differentierad lönesättning. Information om löneintervall för befattningar:

https://www.skovde.se/jobba-hos-oss/skovde-kommun-som-arbetsgivare/lon-och-lonesattning/

Har du skyddade personuppgifter ska du kontakta den kontaktperson som finns angiven i annonsen.

Vi tar gärna emot samtal från dig som är intresserad av jobbet men vi tackar nej till dig som säljer annonser och rekryteringstjänster.

jobs.title: Helsesenteret/legevakta har ledig 146% stilling som sjukepleiar frå 1.1.2027
jobs.description:
Det skal tilsettast i 146% stilling. Vi ønsker å tilsette 2 sjukepleiarar, kor stillingsstorleiken mellom dei to kan fordelast etter ynske/avtale i løpet av tilsettingsprosessen. Stillingane er fordela mellom legekontor og legevakt og er ledig frå 1.januar. Turnusen består av dagvakter, langvakter på natt i vekedagane og vakt kvar 4 helg. Det vert lagt vekt på personleg eignaheit og evne til både å jobbe sjølvstendig og vera ein god lagspelar. Det trengs også tilkallingsvikar til avdelingane. Dersom dette også skulle vera aktuelt, skriv dette i søknaden.

Hva vi ser etter

Du er

  • Off.godkjent sjukepleiar

  • Har erfaring frå legekontor og/eller legevakt

  • Har interesse for akuttmedisin

  • Er ein god lagspelar og kan jobbe sjølvstendig

  • Interessert i fagutvikling

Arbeidsoppgaver

Sjukepleiarane jobbar i fremste rekke med pasienthandtering, saman med lege eller sjølvstendig. Mottak av øyeblikkeleg hjelp, behandling og rådgjeving på telefon. Fleire av sjukepleiarane har dela stilling mellom legekontor og legevakt. Vi kan freiste med gode kollegaer i eit godt fagmiljø og med eit godt arbeidsmiljø. Helseavdelinga har stort fokus på fagutvikling, teamarbeid og tverrfagleg samarbeid.

Vi tilbyr

  • Løn etter Hovudtariffavtala

  • Pensjon via KLP

  • IA-bedrift

  • Godt arbeidsmiljø med gode kollegaer

  • Akuttkurs og regelmessig simulering

  • Spennande arbeidsoppgåver med fokus på samhandling, teamarbeid, fag og utvikling

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Vi er eit veldrive kommunalt helsesenter med 6 fastlegar og 2 LIS1 stillingar. Vi har både sjukepleiarar og helsesekretærar tilsett ved avdelinga. Samlokalisert med fysioterapiavdeling og helsestasjon og med avdeling for psykisk helse og rus i same eining. Legevakta er interkommunal og er plassera i på Helsesenteret, Seljord kommune. Helsesenteret er opent mellom 08-15.30 på kvardagar og legevakta er open resten av døgnet og alle helger og høgtidsdagar. Frå 1. januar 2027 er legevakta døgnopen. Sjukepleiar er stasjonera på legevakta med lege i heimevakt.

jobs.title: Vikarierande kockar & måltidsbiträden
jobs.description:
Malung-Sälens kommun har ca 10 000 invånare och ligger i natursköna Dalarna, hit kan du flyga till och från vår internationella flygplats i Sälen. Här finns Sälenfjällen som gör oss till norra Europas  största vinterturismdestination. Malung- Sälens fantastiska natur, stora evenemang och upplevelser gör att vi bland annat kan erbjuda dig livskvalitet, möjligheter till ett aktivt friluftsliv och en trygg miljö för barn att växa upp i.

Malung-Sälens medarbetare är nyckeln till framgång, därför vill vi skapa de bästa förutsättningarna för ett hållbart arbetsliv, för att du ska trivas, må bra och känna arbetsglädje. Som anställd hos oss erbjuder vi en rad förmåner bland annat:

    • Friskvårdsbidrag eller friskvårdtimme där verksamheten tillåter
    • Tillsvidareanställd och månadsavlönad personal erbjuds säsongskort till Sälenfjällens anläggningar till förmånligt pris
    • Flexibla arbetstider när det är möjligt

Välkommen till en arbetsplats där vi gör skillnad tillsammans - med respekt, omtanke och trygghet i fokus.

10 plats(er).

ARBETSUPPGIFTER
Vill du arbeta i något av våra skolkök och bidra till goda och näringsrika måltider för barn och elever? Vi söker nu vikarier till våra kök inom Barn och utbildningsförvaltningen.

Som vikarie inom kök och måltidsverksamhet blir du en viktig del av vårt köksteam. Vi söker både dig som har erfarenhet av matlagning och dig som vill arbeta med andra arbetsuppgifter i köket, exempelvis servering, disk, städning, salladsberedning och bakning.

Arbetsuppgifterna kan bland annat innebära att:

    • förbereda och/eller tillaga mat
    • servera måltider
    • tillaga och hantera specialkost utifrån barnens och elevernas behov
    • diska och utföra daglig städning
    • arbeta med egenkontroll och livsmedelshygien
    • ta emot och hantera varor
    • vid behov göra beställningar och arbeta med att minska matsvinn
    • Som vikarie behöver du kunna hoppa in vid ordinarie personals frånvaro.

KVALIFIKATIONER
Vi söker främst kockar, men även måltidsbiträden och dig som har ett intresse för matlagning och vill bidra med ditt engagemang i våra skolkök.

Som kock arbetar du bland annat med förberedelse och tillagning av måltider. Som måltidsbiträde hjälper du till med exempelvis förberedelser inför måltider, servering, disk, städning och andra vanligt förekommande arbetsuppgifter i köket.

Vi ser gärna att du har utbildning inom storkök eller restaurang, exempelvis från gymnasiet eller annan likvärdig utbildning. Erfarenhet från storkök, restaurang eller annan måltidsverksamhet är meriterande. Det är även meriterande om du har kunskap om specialkost, egenkontroll och livsmedelshygien.

Det är positivt om du har datavana och tidigare erfarenhet av varubeställningar.

Vi söker dig som:

    • tycker om att laga mat och arbeta tillsammans med andra
    • är noggrann, ansvarstagande och lösningsfokuserad
    • har ett positivt förhållningssätt och kan arbeta i ett högt tempo
    • är serviceinriktad och flexibel
    • trivs med att arbeta i en verksamhet där barn och elever står i fokus

Det allra viktigaste är att du har ett engagemang för mat och service och vill bidra till att skapa en god och trivsam måltidsupplevelse för våra barn och elever.

Vi lägger stor vikt vid personlig lämplighet.

Löneform: Timlön.
Löneintervall: Lönen för tjänsten ligger i dagsläget inom intervallet 24.900 - 31.000 kronor per månad, utifrån 2025 års lönenivå.
Anställningsform: Tidsbegränsad anställning.
Varaktighet: 11 dagar - 3 månader, tillträde: Tillträde enligt överenskommelse .

Intervjuer kommer ske löpande så tveka inte med att skicka in din ansökan.

Tjänsten omfattas av registerkontroll inom skola/förskola.

För att se alla våra pågående rekryteringar, se www.malung-salen.se/ledigajobb.

Om du har tidigare erfarenhet från arbete inom vår organisation kan interna referenser komma att tas.

Vi har inför rekryteringsprocessen beslutat om de medieval som ska göras i rekryteringen. Med anledning av detta motsäger vi oss all kontakt gällande annonsering, rekryteringshjälp och bemanningsförslag vänligen, men bestämt.

jobs.title: Erfaren kafémedarbeider med kjøkken- og vaktansvar (50–100 %)
jobs.description:
Hva vi ser etter

Vi ser etter deg som

  • Har erfaring fra kafé, restaurant, hotell eller annen serveringsvirksomhet.

  • Er trygg i rollen og trives med ansvar.

  • Har interesse for mat og er opptatt av å levere mat av høy kvalitet.

  • Har høyt fokus på renhold, hygiene og orden.

  • Er strukturert, effektiv og løsningsorientert.

  • Ser hva som må gjøres uten å bli bedt om det.

  • Har evnen til å se helheten og tar naturlig ansvar for at ting blir gjort.

  • Beholder roen og evner å prioritere når det er hektisk.

  • Er en positiv lagspiller som bidrar til et godt arbeidsmiljø.

  • Har stolthet i arbeidet ditt og ønsker å levere kvalitet -- også i de små detaljene.


Har du lyst til å sette ditt preg på Icon Retro?

Har du interesse for mat og liker å være kreativ, er det rom for å komme med egne idéer og bidra til å utvikle menyen, sesongprodukter og nye konsepter. Dette er ikke et krav, men noe vi setter stor pris på.


Icon Retro er bygget opp med stor kjærlighet til detaljer, kvalitet og gode opplevelser. Nå ønsker jeg å finne en person som vil være med å bygge videre på det vi har skapt.


Vi søker ikke bare en medarbeider -- vi søker en person som ønsker å ta ansvar, har stolthet i arbeidet sitt og som vil være med å skape gode opplevelser for både gjester og kollegaer.

Hvis du kjenner deg igjen i dette, håper jeg du sender en søknad. Jeg gleder meg til å høre fra deg!

Arbeidsoppgaver

Icon Retro er en kafé og vintagebutikk i Hamar med fokus på god mat, kvalitetskaffe og et håndplukket utvalg av interiør, klær og tilbehør.

Vi brenner for detaljer, gode opplevelser og personlig service - og ønsker å skape et sted hvor både gjester og ansatte trives.


Nå søker vi en erfaren kafémedarbeider som ønsker en sentral rolle i den daglige driften, med ansvar for kjøkken, vakt og arbeidsflyt.

Vi ser etter deg som trives med høyt tempo, liker å ta ansvar og får tilfredsstillelse av å skape struktur, kvalitet og god flyt gjennom arbeidsdagen. Du ser hva som må gjøres uten å bli bedt om det, og tar stolthet i å levere et godt resultat.

Arbeidsoppgaver

Du vil ha en sentral rolle i den daglige driften og være vaktansvarlig på dine vakter.


Du blir en viktig støtte for daglig leder og får ansvar for at den daglige driften flyter godt på dine vakter.

Arbeidsoppgavene består blant annet av:

  • Skape gode opplevelser for gjestene gjennom mat, service og et innbydende miljø.

  • Ha ansvar for god flyt og kvalitet på kjøkkenet.

  • Tilberede mat og drikke av høy kvalitet.

  • Betjene kassen og yte personlig og god service.

  • Prioritere arbeidsoppgaver når det er travelt og sørge for at arbeidsdagen flyter godt.

  • Følge opp og veilede våre yngre medarbeidere, fordele oppgaver ved behov og bidra til at rutiner blir fulgt.

  • Holde oversikt over varer, påfyll og bidra til å redusere svinn.

  • Følge rutiner for renhold, hygiene, matsikkerhet og IK-Mat.

  • Sørge for at kjøkken, arbeidsstasjoner og kafé alltid er rene, ryddige og innbydende.


    Arbeidstid


Stillingen er 50--100 %, avhengig av riktig kandidat. Vi er mer opptatt av å finne den rette personen enn å låse oss til en bestemt stillingsprosent.

Arbeidet består av dagvakter både på hverdager og i helger. Endelig turnus avtales med riktig kandidat.

Vi tilbyr

  • En variert og aktiv arbeidshverdag.

  • En sentral rolle med stor grad av tillit og ansvar.

  • Muligheten til å påvirke den daglige driften.

  • Et hyggelig og inkluderende arbeidsmiljø.

  • Arbeid på dagtid -- både på hverdager og i helger.

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Icon Retro er en kafé og vintagebutikk i Hamar med fokus på god mat, kvalitetskaffe og et håndplukket utvalg av interiør, klær og tilbehør.

Vi brenner for detaljer, gode opplevelser og personlig service - og ønsker å skape et sted hvor både gjester og ansatte trives.

Hva vi ser etter
