jobs.description:
Vill du arbeta i en affärsnära och social roll där du kombinerar uthyrning, kundkontakt och administration? Vi söker nu en uthyrare till vår kund i Södertälje.



Om rollen

Som uthyrare ansvarar du för bostadsuthyrningen i ditt förvaltningsområde som är Södertälje med omnejd. Rollen har ett tydligt säljfokus och du arbetar genom hela uthyrningsprocessen - från kontakt med bostadssökande och säljande annonser till visningar, avtal och inflyttning.

Du har daglig kontakt med hyresgäster och spekulanter via telefon, e-post och möten. Arbetet är huvudsakligen kontorsbaserat i Södertälje, men du genomför också visningar ute i beståndet. Dagarna varierar men består i huvudsak av följande arbetsuppgifter:

    Hantera uthyrningsadministration i Vitec - avtalsskrivning, uppsägningar etc
    Publicera säljande lägenhetsannonser på olika plattformar
    Ha kontakt med hyresgäster och bostadssökande samt boka och genomföra visningar
    Arbeta proaktivt för att öka uthyrningen, exempelvis genom event och öppna visningar
    Hantera delar av in- och utflyttningsprocessen samt ärenden som andrahandsuthyrning och lägenhetsbyten
    Samverka med kollegor och bidra till aktiviteter som stärker kundnöjdheten

Rollen passar dig som trivs med att växla mellan försäljning, service och administration och som kan hålla ett högt tempo med flera parallella ärenden.

Om dig

Vi söker dig som är säljdriven, ansvarstagande och initiativrik. Du tycker om kontakt med människor, är trygg i din kommunikation och har lätt för att skapa goda kundrelationer. Samtidigt är du strukturerad, serviceinriktad och bekväm med administrativa uppgifter och digitala system. Du kan snabbt ställa om när förutsättningarna förändras och du trivs med att arbeta mot uppsatta mål tillsammans med andra.

Vi ser att du har:

    Erfarenhet av uthyrning av hyresrätter, gärna ett par år
    Erfarenhet av kundbemötande och administration
    Goda kunskaper i digitala verktyg och fastighetssystem samt erfarenhet av Vitec
    Goda kunskaper i svenska och engelska i tal och skrift
    B-körkort

Meriterande för rollen:

    Relevant eftergymnasial utbildning
    Grundläggande kunskaper inom hyresjuridik
    Erfarenhet av HomeQ

jobs.title: Lärarassistent till Hultsbergsskolan
jobs.description:
Beskrivning

Hultsbergsskolan söker nu en lärarassient på ett längre vikariat som vill vara med och göra skillnad i elevernas vardag.

Här får du varje dag bidra till alla elevers utveckling mot utbildningens mål och stötta kollegor eller hela arbetslag. Här jobbar vi mest av allt för andra, men även för varandra och det gemensamma målet med vårt arbete är att skolan ska fungera så bra som möjligt för alla elever.

Hultsbergsskolan är en skola med cirka 690 elever från förskoleklass till årskurs 9. På skolan finns också en anpassad grundskola. Skolan ligger i ett villaområde mitt emellan Henstad och Hultsberg, med närhet till skog och andra grönområden. Skolans vision är: "En skola att längta till" Vi vill bygga upp en förtroendefull relation med alla. Vi ser varje möte och dialog som en förutsättning för ett aktivt lärande.

Arbetsuppgifter

I rollen som lärarassistent på Hultsbergsskolan har du en nyckelfunktion i skolans pedagogiska stödsystem. Ditt främsta uppdrag är att ansvara för beställningar, fakturahantering och IT-relaterade frågor.

Du bidrar till att säkerställa en effektiv och välfungerande skolvardag genom att ta ett helhetsansvar för en rad administrativa och praktiska processer. I uppdraget ingår bland annat att ansvara för administration kopplad till elever samt att ge stöd till elever och personal i frågor som rör den digitala lärmiljön. Det innebär exempelvis hantering, utlämning och support av elevernas IT-utrustning såsom datorer och iPads samt att bidra till att dessa fungerar som ett stöd i undervisningen.

Du samarbetar med skolans personal och relevanta stödfunktioner för att säkerställa att den digitala utrustningen är tillgänglig och fungerar väl i det dagliga arbetet. Du kommer även att stödja verksamheten med andra arbetsuppgifter utifrån verksamhetens behov.

Kvalifikationer

Tjänsten kräver avslutad gymnasieutbildning samt dokumenterad erfarenhet av administrativa arbetsuppgifter. Du har god kunskap om skolans struktur och regelverk. Erfarenhet av schemaläggning och arbete inom högstadieverksamhet är meriterande.

Vi söker dig som trivs i en föränderlig skolmiljö och som arbetar självständigt, självgående och strukturerat. Du har god samarbetsförmåga, är flexibel och kan anpassa dig när förutsättningarna förändras. Rollen innebär många kontaktytor, vilket ställer krav på god muntlig kommunikation och ett professionellt bemötande.

Det här är en roll med stor variation där ingen dag är den andra lik. Arbetet innebär periodvis ett högt tempo och intensiva arbetstoppar, exempelvis vid terminsstarter, betygsperioder och andra verksamhetsövergripande händelser. Därför är det viktigt att du har god förmåga att behålla struktur och kvalitet även när arbetsbelastningen ökar.

Vi erbjuder

Läs mer om våra förmåner och hur det är att jobba i Karlstads kommun på karlstad.se/jobbahososs

Information om lönenivåer hittar du här (välj "Se lönestatistik"). Den här rekryteringen rör AID-kod 403015.

Varmt välkommen med din ansökan!

När du söker jobb hos oss kommer du att få ange ditt CV samt svara på ett antal frågor där vi ber dig beskriva din kompetens inom efterfrågat område. Det innebär att du inte ska bifoga ett personligt brev som en del av din ansökan.

Om Karlstads kommun

Barn- och ungdomsförvaltningen ansvarar för förskola och skola för cirka 13 200 barn och elever och är kommunens största förvaltning med drygt 2 400 medarbetare. Vi har förskolor, familjedaghem, öppna förskolor, förskoleklasser, grundskolor, anpassad grundskola, fritidshem och kulturskola och arbetar även med barn- och elevhälsofrågor. Vi rustar barnen för framtiden.

Vill du vara med och skapa framtidens Karlstad? Hos oss i koncernen Karlstads kommun kan du göra skillnad på riktigt. Här är varje medarbetare en viktig del i helheten och tillsammans hjälps vi åt att förverkliga vår vision om "Ett bättre liv i Solstaden". Kom och väx med oss!

Övrig information

För att kvalitetssäkra rekryteringsprocessen och förenkla kommunikationen med våra sökande ber vi dig skicka in din ansökan via våra rekryteringssystemoch inte via e-post eller pappersformat. Vi undanber oss alla erbjudanden om annonserings- och rekryteringshjälp i samband med denna annons.

Har du skyddade personuppgifter ska du inte registrera dina ansökningshandlingar i vårt rekryteringssystem och inte heller skicka in dem via e-post. Vänd dig istället till kommunens växel 054-540 00 00 för vidare hantering.

jobs.title: IT driftsansvarlig
jobs.description:
Litt om stillingen

I Remikskonsernet hjelper vi hver dag våre kunder, både innbyggere og virksomheter, med å omstille seg til en mer bærekraftig fremtid. Digitalisering og effektive arbeidsverktøy er en viktig del av strategien vår, både for effektiv drift og gode tjenester.

Nå søker vi en IT-driftsansvarlig som blir en viktig ressurs i arbeidet med å nå våre mål. Stillingen inngår i avdeling for Innovasjon og Utvikling, og du får gode muligheter til å bidra i en av verdens mest spennende bransjer – samtidig som du får driftsansvar for infrastruktur og daglige IT-tjenester.

Du vil jobbe på tvers av alle selskapene i konsernet, ha ansvar for brukerstøtte, og bidra til at IT-sikkerhet holdes høyt i hele organisasjonen. Du vil også sørge for kjøp og forvaltning av IT-utstyr og eksterne tjenester, samtidig som du vil være en viktig rådgiver i valg og videreutvikling av IT-systemer.


Hva vil du jobbe med?

Hverdagen din vil ha et hovedfokus på support og drift, men også gode muligheter for å bidra til videreutvikling av tjenestene våre i samarbeid med vår digitaliseringsansvarlige og andre kollegaer. Du får en viktig rolle i driftsorganisasjonen og muligheten til å spille kollegaene dine gode.

Her er noe av det du vil jobbe med hos oss:

  • Drift, vedlikehold og videreutvikling av skyløsninger, lokal serverpark, nettverk og øvrig infrastruktur
  • Sikre at IT-systemer og maskiner er operative og driftes sikkert, i henhold til rutiner og lovverk
  • Brukerstøtte for alle ansatte i konsernet
  • Bidra i implementering og automatisering via Intune
  • Være bindeledd mellom fagsystemer og leverandører når det gjelder support
  • Sentral rolle i anskaffelser av IT-utstyr
  • Bidra aktivt i planlegging og videreutvikling av systemer og IT-tjenester, sammen med digitaliseringsansvarlig

Hva ser vi etter hos deg?

Vi ser etter deg som har god teknisk forståelse, gjerne erfaring fra lignende arbeid og relevant utdanning. Konkret mener vi disse kvalifikasjonene er viktige:

  • Erfaring innen IT drift, blant annet IT-sikkerhet, nettverk, server- og klientdrift (Microsoft), virtualisering, Azure, Microsoft 365, lagringssystemer, samarbeids- og kommunikasjonssystemer, websystemer og skyløsninger
  • Relevant utdanning er en fordel, men ikke et krav
  • Gode kommunikasjonsferdigheter, muntlig og skriftlig, på norsk og engelsk
  • Gode formidlingsevner
  • Et brennende engasjement for miljøet

Hvis du kjenner deg i dette, håper vi du søker – også om du ikke treffer på alt.


Vi tilbyr

Remiks er en inkluderende arbeidsgiver, hvor du får gode muligheter for faglig og personlig utvikling – og mange hyggelige kollegaer. Du vil få mulighet til å utvikle deg gjennom kurs, opplæring og videreutdanning. I tillegg tilbyr vi:

  • Ryddige arbeidsforhold og god pensjonsordning
  • Konkurransedyktige betingelser
  • Tilgang til treningsrom og trening i arbeidstiden
  • Kantineordning
  • Gode velferdsordninger
  • En spennende og variert arbeidshverdag

Lønn vil fastsettes etter avtale, basert på blant annet utdanning og din erfaring. For denne stillingen ser vi for oss avlønning på mellom 600.000,- og 700.000,- kroner per år.

Remiks er en IA-bedrift og medlem av offentlig godkjent bedriftshelsetjeneste. Vi vil tilrettelegge arbeidshverdagen og arbeidsplassen for medarbeidere som har behov for det. Aktuell tilrettelegging kan for eksempel være tekniske hjelpemidler, tilpasning av møbler eller endring av rutiner, arbeidsoppgaver og arbeidstid.

Remiks ønsker i størst mulig grad å speile mangfoldet i samfunnet rundt oss. Vi tror at et arbeidsliv med mennesker med ulik bakgrunn, erfaring, kultur, alder, funksjonsevne og perspektiver gjør oss bedre. Hos oss kan du være åpen om hvem du er, og hva du har med deg.

Vi har et godt arbeidsmiljø og trives sammen på jobb. Det håper vi du også vil gjøre.


Om arbeidsgiveren:

Remiks er et avfallsselskap som samler inn, håndterer og behandler avfall i Nord-Norge. Vi tilbyr avfallsløsninger for næringslivet og utfører lovpålagte oppgaver gjennom innsamling av husholdningsavfall i Tromsø og Karlsøy kommune. Vi jobber med utgangspunkt i våre verdier: miljøbevisst, pålitelig, nyskapende og tilgjengelig. Disse verdiene er forankret i alt vi gjør, og våre ansatte er våre fremste ambassadører for dem.

Remiks er et aksjeselskap som eies i sin helhet av Tromsø og Karlsøy kommune. Konsernet har rundt 150 ansatte, og vi holder til i flotte og moderne lokaler ved Miljøparken på nordspissen av Tromsøya.

Remiks Miljøpark AS er underlagt offentlighetsloven, og vi gjør oppmerksom på at du som søker kan føres opp på offentlig søkerliste. CV kan også bli benyttet til utvidet søkerliste. Du kan i søknadsprosessen anmode om å ikke bli oppført i søkerlisten, og må da angi en begrunnelse.

I henhold til offentlighetsloven § 25, 2. ledd kan opplysninger om søkeren bli offentliggjort selv om søkeren har anmodet om ikke å bli oppført på søkerlisten. Du vil bli varslet om anmodningen ikke tas til følge.

Engagerat ledarskap och kunskapsutbyte

jobs.title: Directeur(trice) de Village Vacances (H/F)
jobs.description:
Descriptif du poste
Dans le cadre du développement de son organisation, le Groupe recrute un(e) Directeur(trice) de Village Vacances chargé(e) de la direction de deux établissements sur un contrat unique à l'année, selon un calendrier saisonnier défini :
- De mai à septembre : direction du village Les Cimes (Habère-Poche)
- De mi-décembre à mi-avril : direction du village La Lauza (Valmeinier, 180 lits)
Un(e) adjoint(e) unique accompagne le/la titulaire du poste sur les deux sites, assurant la continuité managériale et la transmission opérationnelle d'une saison à l'autre.
MISSIONS PRINCIPALES
Relation client et satisfaction : Garantir la promesse de service sur les deux établissements ; coordonner les activités, animations et séjours conformément aux standards de qualité du Groupe.
Management et ressources humaines : Assurer le recrutement, la formation et l'évaluation des collaborateurs des équipes saisonnières ; encadrer les services restauration, hébergement, technique et animation ; garantir le respect des procédures qualité, RH et administratives ; assurer la gestion prévisionnelle des emplois et des compétences ; veiller au maintien d'un climat social serein.
Gestion opérationnelle et supervision : Superviser l'ensemble des activités des deux villages ; assurer le suivi de la comptabilité et de la trésorerie ; organiser la passation budgétaire et opérationnelle en fin de saison (clôtures, inventaires, transmission des dossiers) ; produire les tableaux de bord de pilotage ; gérer les situations de crise ; veiller au respect des normes d'hygiène et de sécurité ; assurer la liaison avec les partenaires locaux de chaque territoire

Profil recherché :
Formation : Bac+2 à Bac+5 (management hôtelier, tourisme, commerce ou gestion d'entreprise) ou expérience équivalente.
Expérience confirmée en qualité de Directeur(trice) ou Adjoint(e) de village vacances sur plusieurs saisons ; connaissance approfondie de la restauration collective (normes HACCP, gestion des flux et des achats) ; expérience réussie du management d'équipes pluridisciplinaires en contexte saisonnier.
Compétences : maîtrise de la gestion budgétaire et du contrôle de gestion ; connaissance du droit du travail et de la réglementation applicable aux ERP ; maîtrise des outils bureautiques et des logiciels hôteliers.
Qualités requises : rigueur, sens de l'organisation, leadership, capacité d'adaptation à la double saisonnalité, disponibilité géographique.

Entreprise
Acteur du tourisme associatif depuis 1949, la marque Neaclub est née en 2018 de la fusion de deux associations du tourisme social et familial : Les Carrefours de l'Amitié et Chemins.
Aujourd'hui, Neaclub gère 5 villages-club labellisés 3 étoiles Atout-France, ainsi qu'un chalet-refuge en Haute-Savoie, Savoie et en Drôme Provençale :
- Les Balcons du lac d'Annecy situé à Sevrier (74) ;
- Les Cîmes du Léman situé à Habère-Poche (74) ;
- La Pulka situé à Valloire (73) ;
- La Lauza situé à Valmeinier (73) ;
- Les Lavandes situé à Rémuzat (26) ;
- Le Chalet-refuge de Coutarse situé à Jarsy (dans le massif des Bauges - 73).

jobs.title: HSE Specialist
jobs.description:
At Grid & Power Quality Solutions and Service business at Hitachi Energy in Europe (HBUEU), Inclusion drives our culture of innovation and collaboration. Our leading technology and strong market position enable us to achieve growth targets in the energy transition across current and growing market segments such as data centers, hydrogen and e-mobility.

Join Our Team!

We are looking for a HSE Specialist to join our HSE Team in Vaasa, Finland. In this role, you will support our Finnish projects in the Nordic Operation Unit (OU) and focus on the HSE tasks in the HSE department and throughout the projects life cycle. You will be ensuring that the highest standards of health, safety and environmental performance are documented, monitored and maintained. You will also be driving continuous improvement in all areas of HSE.

The Nordic OU HSE Team is a network of experienced health, safety and environmental professionals supporting the delivery of complex construction, energy and industrial projects across Finland, Sweden and Denmark. We support highly skilled site teams in delivering world-class projects through professionalism, quality and operational excellence, creating environments where safety is the natural outcome of doing the job right. Working closely with project management, customers and contractors, we provide expertise and practical support throughout the project lifecycle. Our focus is on enabling disciplined planning, effective risk management and high-quality execution that protects people, enhances performance and strengthens project outcomes.

Our strength lies in our people. We bring together talented professionals with experience from the energy sector, industrial construction and major infrastructure projects. We value expertise, integrity and a willingness to take initiative. We are a team that shares knowledge openly, learns from each other and works together to solve challenges in demanding project environments. We welcome individuals from diverse professional backgrounds who are motivated by continuous development and a desire to make a meaningful impact.

We believe that excellence comes from combining technical competence with personal accountability. We encourage constructive challenge, transparent communication and the confidence to speak up when improvements can be made. By maintaining high professional standards and supporting one another, we help project teams achieve results while protecting people, the environment and the long-term success of our projects.

We challenge established practices and continuously look for better ways to manage risk, support project teams and improve performance. Through innovation, digitalization and intelligent use of technology, we advance how decisions are made and how projects are executed. We do not simply adapt to change; we actively shape the future of HSE by turning new ideas into practical solutions that enable safer, smarter and more efficient project delivery.

If you are motivated by complex projects, enjoy working with skilled professionals and want to help shape the future of HSE in the energy and construction industries, you will fit right in with our team.

**How you'll make an impact**

- Implement and work with continuous improvement of Hitachi Energy operating unit management system and local requirements in Finland for the operating unit of the Nordic OU.

- Prepare and update HSE documentation in accordance with the internal process. Submit all preliminary HSE plans to the customer in accordance with the tender submission dates.

- Attend clarification meetings and workshops with the customer (both in person and remotely).

- Prepare the Project HSE Plan as well as other HSE-related documentation such as the Emergency Preparedness and Response Plan.

- Ensure activities under the scope of Hitachi Energy are in compliance with legal and contractual HSE requirements as well as internal HSE requirements.

- Produce reports for Project Reviews, both internal and customer, and attend the Project Review meetings to ensure the Hitachi Energy HSE Operating System remains suitable, adequate, and effective.

- Review HSE documentation from all Hitachi Energy subcontractors and support subcontractors to meet internal and Project HSE requirements.


**Your background**

- Previous experience of HSE tasks in projects

- Professional HSE certification is seen as a plus

- Knowledge of ISO 45001 and ISO 14001 certifications

- Strong organizational and communication skills with the ability to operate within global teams

- Self-driven and persistent attitude towards challenges. You work actively and professionally both independently and as a part of a team.

- Excellent written and spoken communication skills in English and Finnish. Swedish is seen as a plus.

jobs.title: Senior Engineer
jobs.description:
About the position

Position as Senior Engineer available at the Department of Physics, University of Oslo.

The position is for a period of 2 years. 

Starting date as soon as possible and no later than 15.10.2026.


Job / project description

The position is associated with the European Union funded COMBAT project. The details about the project can be found here: https://combatdengue.hemsida.eu/

The senior engineer will be associated with the work package 2 – DEVELOP high-throughput and super-resolution tools for virus research. The role of the engineer will be to develop, support and work on the photonic-chip based multimodal TIRF optical microscopy set-up. In addition, the engineer should support the design and build advanced optical diffraction tomography (ODT). The photonic-chip based TIRF microscopy and ODT will be used for imaging organoids and a correlative fluorescence microscopy. A close co-operation with COMBAT partners associated with WP 2, i.e. both the academic institutions, Karolinska Institute Sweden, Stichting Amsterdam UMC (UMC), The Netherlands, Justus Liebig University (JLU), Germany; and the industrial partners, React4life Spa (R4L), Italy is anticipated. 

The successful candidate is anticipated to have experimental optical instrumentation background working with optical waveguide (photonic-chip) based microscopy platform. The candidate should have exposure to trouble shoot, adapt and build next generation waveguide chip based TIRF microscopy platform. In addition, the engineer is anticipated to support the automation (hardware control) of the different systems linked with the COMBAT and other similar projects. The chip based super-resolution microscopy will be used for imaging thin sections from organoids. The engineer is anticipated to strengthen and support the existing team members involved in this project. It is preferred that the candidate has working experience of approximately five years post master degree in the relevant field. 

The engineer will get an opportunity to travel within the COMBAT consortium and to collaborate with both the biologists and the technology drivers and will contribute to multi disciplinary research at the cross-roads of biology and physics.


What skills are important in this role?

Required qualifications:

  • A degree equivalent to a Norwegian master’s degree in physics/engineering
  • Background in waveguide-chip based optical microscopy, waveguide chip design and characterization 
  • Good exposure with optical instrumentation and automation of hardware 
  • Exposure with the mechanical and optical design, and exposure with the opto electrical and opto-mechanical components. It is anticipated that the candidate will be able to maintain and upgrade existing optical microscopy units, such as waveguide chip based optical microscopy and optical diffraction tomography. 
  • Fluent oral and written communication skills in English

Desired qualifications:

  • A good background in automation of the optical instrumentation via LabView, Micro manager, Python or similar software tools. 
  • 5 years or longer working exposure within the optical microscopy development and design 
  • Exposure on fluorescence based photonic chip based super-resolution optical microscopy such as, TIRF, single-molecule localization microscopy, and intensity fluctuation microscopy 
  • Experience working with biological samples and the candidate should be open to work with biological samples 
  • Familiarity with image analysis tools such as MATLAB, Phython, ImageJ, and basic AI tools 
  • Exposure on SolidWorks and or Zemax

All candidates and projects will have to undergo a check versus national export, sanctions and security regulations. Candidates may be excluded based on these checks. Primary checkpoints are the Export Control regulation, the Sanctions regulation, and the national security regulation.


What are we looking for in you?

Personal skills:

  • Ability to work both independently and as part of a team
  • Ability to work precise in a structured manner and swiftly adapts to new tasks
  • Good communication and collaboration skills
  • Positive attitude and the ability to handle hectic periods

Employment in the position is based on a comprehensive assessment of all qualification requirements applicable to the position, including personal skills.


We can offer you
  • A pleasant and stimulating work environment
  • Good welfare schemes
  • Opportunity of up to 1.5 hours a week of exercise during working hours.  A workplace with good development and career opportunities
  • Membership in the Statens Pensjonskasse, which is one of Norway's best pension schemes with beneficial mortgages and good insurance schemes
  • Oslo’s family-friendly surroundings with their rich opportunities for culture and outdoor activities
  • Salary in position as Senior Engineer, position code 1181 in salary range NOK 725 000 – 780 000, depending on competence and experience. From the salary, 2% is deducted in statutory contributions to the State Pension Fund

Inclusive work life and diversity at UiO

Inclusion and diversity are a strength. The University of Oslo has a personnel policy objective of achieving a balanced gender composition. Furthermore, we want employees with diverse professional expertise, life experience and perspectives.

If there are qualified applicants with disabilities, employment gaps or immigrant background, we will invite at least one applicant from each of these categories to an interview.

We hope that you will apply for the position.

More information about gender equality initiatives at UiO can be found here.  


How to apply

The application must include:

  • Cover letter with statement of motivation
  • CV (complete overview of education and work experience)
  • Copies of educational certificates, transcript of records and letters for recommendation
  • Names and contact details of 2-3 references (names, relation to candidate and telephone number)

Application with attachments must be submitted via our recruitment system Jobbnorge, click "Apply for this job".

When applying for the position, we ask you to retrieve your education results from Vitnemålsportalen.no. If your education results are not available through Vitnemålsportalen, we ask you to upload copies of your transcripts or grades. Please note that all documentation must be in English or a Scandinavian language.


General information

Applicants may be called in for an interview.

Applicant lists can be published in accordance with Norwegian Freedom of Information Act § 25. When you apply for a position with us, your name will appear on the public applicant list. It is possible to request to be excluded from this list. You must justify why you want an exemption from publication and we will then decide whether we can grant your request. If we can't, you will hear from us.

The University of Oslo is Norway’s oldest and highest rated institution of research and education with 26 500 students and 7 200 employees. Its broad range of academic disciplines and internationally esteemed research communities make UiO an important contributor to society.

Hitachi Energy is looking for a Senior Project Planner to join our Project Controls team within the Nordic Operating Unit of our Grid Integration business. The position is based in Vaasa, Finland or Västerås, Sweden, with hybrid working possibilities.

As a Senior Project Planner, you will play a critical role throughout the entire lifecycle of our most complex electrical substation projects, from tendering to project handover in the field of planning and scheduling. Your expertise and proactive approach will ensure consistency and alignment of scope, time, cost, and progress, ultimately contributing to the success and satisfaction of our customers.

In this role, you will be in the driving seat, ensuring projects have robust, dynamic, and well-structured schedules that meet contractual objectives and provide clear roadmaps for the execution phase.

In this role, you will be responsible for developing and maintaining robust, dynamic project schedules that align with contractual commitments and provide a clear framework for successful project execution.

You will work closely with various stakeholders making sure the project schedules are used for work coordination, predictable forecasting, proactive schedule risk management, cost management, resource management, and of course, team alignment. You will also conduct schedule and resource analysis and prepare schedule progress reporting materials both for external and internal purposes.

At Hitachi Energy, we know that great results are achieved together. As a Senior Project Planner, you will collaborate closely with Project Managers, Project Controllers, Lead Engineers, Project SCMs, Logistic Specialists, Site and Commissioning Managers and with our Customers. You will also become part of a highly experienced and supportive community of Project Planners. Together, we share knowledge, solve challenges, and support one another in delivering excellence in every project.

**How you'll make an impact**

· Take a leading role in planning and scheduling activities in complex projects and support project teams with schedule governance, analysis and decision making

· Develop, maintain, and analyze integrated project schedules in close collaboration with project teams

· Support predictable schedule forecasting by aligning time, cost, resources and progress

· Identify schedule deviations, risks, and opportunities early, and communicate them clearly to project stakeholders

· Prepare schedule reports and analyses, including S-curves, critical path analyses, resource histograms and On-Time-Delivery (OTD) milestones

· Actively communicate schedule information to stakeholders to keep everyone informed

· Support and prepare What-if schedule scenarios, delay mitigation plans and Extension of Time (EoT) claims together with the project team

· Promote planning and scheduling best practices across the organization, act as a role model and support less experienced planners

· Drive the use and continuous improvement of planning and scheduling methodologies and tools

**Your background**

· M.Sc. or B.Sc. in Electrical engineering or another relevant field

· Proven experience in planning and scheduling complex projects

· Strong collaboration and communication skills, with the ability to engage, motivate, and inspire stakeholders across the project organization

· Advanced proficiency in Primavera P6 and good knowledge of schedule management theory

· The ability to prepare and maintain high quality, dynamic project schedules together with the project team

· A proactive and self-driven mindset, with a strong sense of ownership and accountability

· A structured and goal-oriented approach to your work, with a focus on delivering results

· Project Management Certificate (PMP® and/or PMI-SP®) is considered an advantage

· Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English; knowledge of Finnish and/or Swedish is considered a plus

jobs.title: Early Childhood Education Teacher, Daycare Aurinkokello, North Sámi-speaking group, Keski-Pasila
jobs.description:
We are looking for an Early Childhood Education Teacher for Aurinkokellos North Sámi-speaking group!

A wonderful new daycare centre, Aurinkokello, has been completed in Keski-Pasila, and operations began in August 2025. Early childhood education and pre-primary education services are being introduced gradually in the new unit. The position can also be performed on a part-time basis.

Suotnjarat is a sibling group for children aged 2-6 with a teacher and a carer working as a team. The group follows both the Helsinki Early Childhood Education Plan and the Sámi Early Childhood Education Plan. The goal of Sámi-language early childhood education is to support the childs growth into an independent, responsible, and social individual, as well as to foster the development of their language skills.

A childs proficiency in both languages becomes strong when they follow the immersion path throughout their entire educational journey up to the end of basic education. The group collaborates regularly with both a Finnish-language pre-primary education group and the Sámi class at Pasila Comprehensive School, providing pre-primary-aged children with opportunities to meet and engage in shared activities with children from other pre-primary groups.

Aurinkokello operates in the same building as Pasila Comprehensive School, enabling excellent cooperation along the childs educational path and the natural shared use of facilities. The daycare centre is very easy to reach, with excellent tram, bus, train and cycling connections.


What do we expect from you?

We hope that your work demonstrates strong basic pedagogical skills in everyday practice and a sensitive approach to meeting children. We expect you to understand the importance of play in a childs development and learning. You recognize that play is part of the adults responsibilities, you are a playful adult, and you make use of playfulness in various everyday situations. The facilities and learning materials at Aurinkokello are designed to invite play, so we expect you, as an adult, to take responsibility for continuously shaping and developing the play environment.

At Aurinkokello, you will work as part of a multidisciplinary team. We hope you have the motivation and attitude to develop practices in a new environment and within an evolving operational culture. You are open to experimenting with your team and suggesting changes that support a smooth and positive everyday experience for both children and adults. The daycare centre director and assistant director provide strong pedagogical support to the staff and are committed to creating the conditions that enable employees to succeed in their work.

Interested? If Aurinkokello sounds like your next workplace, don't wait - send us your application today. We will personally contact all candidates selected for an interview.

Hitta även denna platsannons på svenska och finska.
Löydät tämän työpaikkailmoituksen myös suomeksi ja ruotsiksi.

As an Early Childhood Education Teacher, you will be responsible for building the operational culture and learning environment of your child group, as well as planning, implementing, developing, and evaluating pedagogical activities. You will also support each childs individual learning in accordance with the Helsinki Early Childhood Education and Pre-primary Education Curriculum, the units operational plan, and the childs individual early childhood education plan.

Why Join Us?

It is important to us that you are able to do meaningful work that contributes to a good life for everyone in Helsinki. We want you to succeed and feel inspired in your work. We offer a wide range of opportunities for professional growth and development. According to our latest staff survey, our employees enjoy working here and find their work meaningful.

You will have access to the employee benefits offered by Finlands largest employer, including support for commuting costs and up to 550 euros in annual benefits for culture, sports, and well-being. Read more about our employee benefits and learn about the City of Helsinki as an employer at: hel.fi/en/open-jobs/why-work-for-the-city.
Staff housing: Staff housing units located across the city that you can apply for.

If you begin a permanent employment as as a teacher in Sámi-language early childhood education with the City of Helsinki in 2026, we will offer you a 3000 € recruitment incentive bonus. The bonus is paid only once per person. For further information, please contact the recruiting Daycare Centre Director.


Qualification requirements:

We require that you hold the qualification required under the Finnish Early Childhood Education and Care Act (540/2018), or, in accordance with the transitional provision (Section 75), a Bachelor's degree in Education qualifying you as an early childhood education teacher, a relevant University of Applied Sciences degree, or a corresponding former college-level qualification, such as a kindergarten teacher or social educator qualification (Act 272/2005 and Decree 608/2005). Eligibility may also be demonstrated through a recognition decision issued by the Finnish National Agency for Education, confirming that your foreign qualification provides eligibility for the position.

The main working language of the position is North Sámi. Good spoken proficiency in North Sámi is required. In addition, applicants must have good spoken and written proficiency in either Finnish, Swedish, or English. Proficiency in Finnish is considered an asset. In the absence of qualified applicants, candidates with developing North Sámi language skills will also be considered.

A person hired must submit an extract from the criminal record as referred to in the Act on Checking the Criminal Background of Persons Working with Children (504/2002).

Proof that you do not have respiratory tuberculosis (Section 55 of the Communicable Diseases Act).

jobs.title: Postdoctor in carbon partitioning in trees
jobs.description:
Department of Forest Genetics and Plant Physiology

The Department of forest genetics and plant physiology is part of Umeå Plant Science Centre (UPSC, https://www.upsc.se/) which is a centre of excellence for experimental plant research and forest biotechnology in Northern Sweden. Our mission is to perform excellent and innovative basic research and generate knowledge that benefits forestry, agriculture, environment and society. We work across a wide range of disciplines in plant science reaching from cell biology to ecophysiology and from basic research to industrial applications. Our common goal is to understand the plants’ ability to grow, adapt and acclimate to a changing world and how we can breed better plants.

A postdoctor position is available in the http://www.upsc.se/totte_niittyla at the Umeå Plant Science Center, Sweden to study carbon partitioning in trees using hybrid aspen as the model system.

About the position

Trees represent the single most important carbon sink on the planet. An incomplete mechanistic understanding of carbon sequestration to wood limits our ability of predict the capacity of trees to assimilate CO2 and optimise the production of sustainable wood derived materials and fuels. This project will adress this problem by investigating metabolic fluxes leading to biomass formation using innovative metabolomics and isotope techniques.

Your profile

Applicants should have a PhD in plant molecular biology, plant biochemistry or plant physiology and a genuine interest to carry out experimental plant research. Molecular biology lab skills are important and previous experience on metabolomics and plant primary metabolism are highly desirable. English fluency and publication of the PhD work in peer-reviewed high-quality journal(s) is required.

About us

UPSC belongs to two universities, the Swedish University of Agricultural Sciences and Umeå University. About 200 people from more than 40 different nationalities work here. We host some 30 principal investigators, and our researchers have access to state-of-the-art analytical platforms, unique tree germplasm resources and plant growth facilities. We strive for a collaborative work environment and support our scientists throughout all career stages by providing professional training opportunities and individual career mentoring.

Read more about our benefits and working at SLU by visiting: https://www.slu.se/en/about-slu/work-at-slu/

Location:

Department of Forest Genetics and Plant Physiology, SLU, Umeå.

Form of employment:

Fixed-term employment 6 months.

Scope:

100%

Start date:

1st of October 2026 or as agreed.

Application:

Please submit your application before deadline 28 August 2026. You can submit your application by clicking the button below.

Union representatives:

https://internt.slu.se/en/my-employment/employee-associations/kontaktpersoner-vid-rekrytering/





The Swedish University of Agricultural Sciences (SLU) has a key role in the development for sustainable life, based on science and education. Through our focus on the interaction between humans, animals and ecosystems and the responsible use of natural resources, we contribute to sustainable societal development and good living conditions on our planet. Our main campuses are located in Alnarp, Umeå and Uppsala, however, the university also operates at research stations, experimental forests and teaching sites throughout Sweden. SLU has around 4,000 employees, 6,000 students and doctoral students and a turnover of over SEK 4,5 billion. We are investing in attractive environments on all of our campuses. We strive to provide a work environment characterised by inclusivity and gender equality, where different experiences generate conversations between people and pave the way for science, creativity and development. Therefore, we welcome applications from people with diverse backgrounds and perspectives.

jobs.title: Autolakerer til opstart af ny afdeling i Silkeborg
jobs.description:
Vil du være med helt fra starten og sætte dit præg på en ny afdeling?

Byens Bilpleje.com søger en dygtig og engageret autolakerer, som har lyst til at være med til at åbne og opbygge vores nye afdeling i Silkeborg.
Her får du ikke bare et almindeligt job som autolakerer. Du bliver en vigtig del af opstarten og får mulighed for at være med til at skabe gode arbejdsgange, høj kvalitet og den rette kultur i afdelingen fra første dag.

Om Byens Bilpleje.com

Byens Bilpleje.com er en af Danmarks største aktører inden for kosmetisk klargøring, autolakering, buleopretning, rustbeskyttelse og udskiftning af autoglas.
Vi behandler mere end 200.000 biler om året og beskæftiger mere end 450 medarbejdere i Danmark.
Den første afdeling blev grundlagt i Vejle i 1997, og i dag har vi mere end 50 afdelinger i Danmark.
Vores ambition er at være bilejerens foretrukne samarbejdspartner. Det gør vi ved at skabe værdi for vores kunder gennem effektivitet, kvalitet og fleksibilitet.

Om jobbet

Som autolakerer i vores nye afdeling i Silkeborg bliver du en central del af opstarten.
Du kommer til at arbejde med autolakering i den daglige produktion og får samtidig mulighed for at bidrage til, hvordan afdelingen skal fungere i praksis. Vi leder derfor efter dig, der både har faglig stolthed og lyst til at tage ansvar.
Du klargør bilerne til lakering ved at spartle, slibe og afdække, inden du sprøjtelakerer dem med fokus på et flot og ensartet resultat. Du er med hele vejen i processen og sikrer den sidste finish, så bilen står skarpt og ser ud som ny.

Dine opgaver vil blandt andet være:

  • Sikre topkvalitet på det udførte arbejde 
  • Selvom du styrer dine egen opgaver, er du en del af et stærkt team, der hjælper hinanden, når der er brug for det 
  • Alt det andet: Fordi ingen arbejdsdag er helt ens 
  • Sikring af høj og ensartet kvalitet
  • Bidrage til effektive arbejdsgange og processer
  • Overholde aftalte deadlines
  • Samarbejde tæt med kolleger og ledelse
  • Være med til at skabe struktur og gode rutiner i den nye afdeling
  • Bidrage aktivt til opbygningen og udviklingen af afdelingen

Om dig

Vi forestiller os, at du er uddannet autolakerer og har erfaring fra faget.
Det vigtigste er, at du går op i dit håndværk og afleverer et resultat, du kan være stolt af. Samtidig skal du have lyst til at være en del af en ny afdeling, hvor ikke alt nødvendigvis er fastlagt på forhånd.
Du ser muligheder frem for begrænsninger og har lyst til at være med til at bygge noget op sammen med dine nye kolleger.

Vi lægger vægt på, at du

  • Er uddannet autolakerer og har relevant erfaring
  • Har høj faglig stolthed og sans for kvalitet
  • Kan arbejde selvstændigt og struktureret
  • Er løsningsorienteret og tager ansvar
  • Trives i en travl og ordreproducerende hverdag
  • Er en holdspiller og bidrager til et godt arbejdsmiljø
  • Er fleksibel og klar på de opgaver, der følger med opstarten af en ny afdeling
  • Har lyst til at udvikle dig sammen med virksomheden

Vi tilbyder

Du får en særlig mulighed for at komme med helt fra begyndelsen og være med til at sætte dit præg på vores nye afdeling i Silkeborg.
Samtidig bliver du en del af en stor organisation med erfarne kolleger og masser af faglig sparring. Selvom afdelingen er ny, står du derfor ikke alene.

Vi tilbyder blandt andet:

  • En central rolle i opstarten af en helt ny afdeling
  • Mulighed for at præge arbejdsgange og den daglige drift
  • Et stærkt fagligt fællesskab på tværs af Byens Bilpleje.com
  • Gode muligheder for faglig og personlig udvikling
  • En arbejdsplads med højt til loftet og godt humør
  • Grundig introduktion til virksomheden og vores processer
  • Konkurrencedygtig løn og pension
  • Mulighed for at vokse med afdelingen i takt med, at forretningen udvikler sig

Ansøg nu – før en anden snupper din plads!

Lyder det som noget for dig?

Så send din ansøgning hurtigst muligt. Vi afholder samtaler løbende og ønsker stillingen besat snarest muligt – men vi venter gerne på den rette kollega.

Ansøgningen skal sendes elektronisk via vores hjemmeside www.byensbilpleje.com.

Grundet GDPR modtager vi ikke ansøgninger via e-mail, og ansøgninger fremsendt på mail vil derfor ikke blive taget i betragtning.

Har du spørgsmål til stillingen, er du velkommen til at kontakte Leon Clausen på 22 43 31 76.

Bliv en del af Byens Bilpleje.com – og vær med til at bygge vores nye afdeling i Allerød op fra bunden.

Our kitchen is based on planned production and pre-arranged menus for our hotel guests. We serve between approximately 100 and 200 guests every day.

During the day, we prepare and serve lunches, while dinner consists of pre-booked and predetermined two-course menus.

Our dinner concept follows a fixed rotation of four different two-course menus. After the fourth menu, the rotation starts again on day five.

This means that our kitchen operation is highly structured, allowing the team to focus on good preparation, consistency, quality and efficient service.

We are therefore looking for an experienced chef who is comfortable preparing food in larger quantities and who understands the importance of planning, organisation and consistency when serving many guests.

The primary working language in our kitchen is Spanish, while English is the common language throughout the rest of the hotel.

Your main responsibilities

  • Preparing lunches and evening meals for our hotel guests

  • Preparing and cooking food for approximately 100–200 guests per day

  • Working with our fixed rotation of pre-planned two-course dinner menus

  • Taking responsibility for your own tasks and preparation

  • Working closely with our team of five evening chefs

  • Ensuring consistent quality, taste and presentation

  • Planning and organising preparation efficiently

  • Contributing to a smooth and well-organised dinner service

  • Maintaining high standards of cleanliness and hygiene

  • Following Danish food safety and hygiene regulations

  • Supporting your colleagues and contributing to a professional and positive working environment

We are looking for someone who

  • Has solid professional experience working as a chef

  • Is experienced in preparing food for larger groups of guests

  • Is comfortable with high-volume food production

  • Is able to work independently and take responsibility

  • Understands the importance of planning, preparation and consistency

  • Works efficiently and remains organised during busy periods

  • Speaks Spanish and is able to communicate in English

  • Is reliable, responsible and flexible

  • Takes pride in food quality and presentation

  • Enjoys working as part of a professional kitchen team

  • Has EU/EEA citizenship or another valid right to work in Denmark

Previous professional experience as a chef is essential for this position.

Salary and employment conditions

Salary: DKK 180 per hour before tax.

Holiday allowance is paid in addition to the hourly salary in accordance with Danish regulations.

We offer attractive working hours and the opportunity to become part of an established and experienced kitchen team.

Start date: As soon as possible

Location: Ærø Hotel, Marstal, Denmark

Staff accommodation

If needed, we can offer staff accommodation close to the hotel.

The current accommodation consists of private bedrooms with shared kitchen and bathroom facilities.

Rent is DKK 750 per week and includes:

  • Electricity

  • Water

  • Heating

  • Internet

During the coming winter, the staff accommodation will undergo a complete renovation. After the renovation, each room will have its own private bathroom and small kitchen.

Accommodation is optional and paid by the employee.

About Ærø Hotel

Ærø Hotel is a well-established hotel located in Marstal on the island of Ærø in southern Denmark.

We welcome guests from Denmark and abroad and have an international team of employees from several different countries.

Our kitchen is an important part of the hotel experience. Because most of our guests stay with us as part of organised hotel packages, we know in advance how many guests we are cooking for and which menus will be served.

This gives us a structured way of working, where good preparation, teamwork and consistency are essential.

You will become part of an experienced kitchen team where everyone works together to ensure that between 100 and 200 guests receive a good dining experience every day.

Life on Ærø

Ærø is one of Denmark’s most beautiful and distinctive islands.

The island is known for its beautiful coastline, beaches, historic towns, colourful houses, maritime atmosphere and relaxed way of life.

Marstal has a strong maritime tradition and is a lively small town with shops, cafés and the everyday facilities needed when living on the island. At the same time, the sea and nature are always close by.

Working at Ærø Hotel gives you the opportunity to combine a professional job with life in a safe, peaceful and welcoming island community.

For the right person, Ærø offers much more than just a workplace. It is an opportunity to become part of an international team while experiencing a very special part of Denmark.

If you are an experienced chef and would like to become part of our team at Ærø Hotel, we would be very pleased to hear from you.

Please send us your CV together with a short introduction about yourself, your professional kitchen experience and when you would be available to start.

jobs.title: Postdoctoral Position in Multiphysics Modelling of Bubble Transport and Electrochemical Processes in Alkaline Electrolysers
jobs.description:
The Centre for Industrial Mechanics in Sønderborg, Denmark, part of the Institute of Mechanical and Electrical Engineering, University of Southern Denmark (SDU), invites applications for a 2-year postdoc position in Multiphysics Modelling of Bubble Transport and Electrochemical Processes in Alkaline Electrolysers. The position is open from October 1, 2026, or as soon as possible thereafter, and the specific start date will be agreed with the successful candidates.

 

About the Position

The position is funded through a collaborative research and innovation project involving SDU, DTU, and Stiesdal Hydrogen, and aims to reduce the CAPEX of green hydrogen production by developing a next-generation bipolar electrode cassette for alkaline electrolysers. One focus will be on geometry-driven bubble management.

As a postdoctoral researcher, you will join the SDU Energy Systems Group at the Centre for Industrial Mechanics (CIM) and play a key role in developing advanced simulation tools and validating simulations with experimental results. Your work will combine multiphase CFD modelling, current distribution modelling, and collaboration with experimentalists. The objective is to create predictive models that guide cassette design, identify optimal operating conditions, and reduce the need for extensive physical prototyping.

Working closely with researchers at SDU and DTU, as well as engineers at Stiesdal Hydrogen, you will contribute to the development of next-generation hydrogen production technology with clear industrial impact and support its path towards large-scale implementation.

 

Your Role

  • Develop and apply simulation methods for multiphase transport and current distribution 

    in electrolyzers

  • Investigate bubble-buoyancy-driven internal electrolyte circulation

  • Quantify transport processes affecting mass transfer and electrochemical performance

  • Integrate computational and experimental results to advance mechanistic understanding and predictive modelling

  • Collaborate with academic and industrial partners

  • Mentor and supervise students (PhD, MSc, BSc) on related research questions

  • Publish research results in peer-reviewed journals and present at international conferences

  • Contribute to research funding applications and assist with teaching activities as relevant

 

Your Profile

  • PhD in engineering, computational science, physics or related discipline

  • Background in computational fluid dynamics (CFD)

  • Experience in multiphase flow and/or electrochemical transport modelling

  • Experience with numerical simulation software such as ANSYS, COMSOL, or OpenFOAM 

  • Programming skills in Python, C++, or equivalent languages

  • Strong teamwork, communication, and independent research skills

  • Proficient in English (spoken and written)

 

Why Join SDU Sønderborg?

The SDU Energy Systems Group at CIM is a dynamic, recently established research group within the Institute of Mechanical and Electrical Engineering (IME). As part of a young and growing team and institute, you will help shaping research, education, and innovation in engineering science. 

You will have access to state-of-the-art computing and lab facilities, and benefit from strong academic and industrial networks across Denmark and Europe. CIM is based at SDU’s scenic Sønderborg campus in the Alsion building directly at the waterfront. All study programs are taught in English, and more than half of our students and staff are international, creating an inspiring environment.

SDU maintains close ties to industry in Sønderborg, Southern Denmark, and Northern Germany, offering direct exposure to real-world challenges and opportunities for cross-sectoral research collaborations. This position offers you the chance to develop your own research ideas, contribute to the growth of the group and institute, and advance your career in a supportive, international setting.

In short, you will benefit from:

  • Access to state-of-the-art computing and lab facilities

  • A dynamic, international research environment in a scenic campus setting

  • Close ties to industry and opportunities for cross-sectoral collaboration

  • Support for developing your own research ideas and career

 

Contact information

For further information, please contact Associate Professor Martin Lautenschläger 
(mlaut@sdu.dk; phone: + 45 65 50 79 86) or Associate Professor Lars Duggen (duggen@sdu.dk) and visit www.sdu.dk/en/ime.

If you experience technical problems, please contact our email support.

 

Application

Applicants are advised to read the SDU information on how to apply.

Assessment of the candidates is based on the application material, and the application must include: 

  • Motivated application.

  • Curriculum Vitae. 

  • Master’s and PhD degree certificates or equivalent (original and an official English translation).  

  • Complete list of publications.

  • Publications most relevant to the position.

  • Summary and documentation of experience in teaching, if relevant to the position. 

  • A research statement may be included.

  • References/reference letters may also be included.

  • A statement/documentation of other qualifications relevant to the position may also be included.

All documents must be in English and PDF format. CPR number (civil registration number) must be crossed out. All PDF-files must be unlocked, allow binding and may not be password protected. 

SUBMISSION GUIDE: Motivated application must be uploaded under ‘Cover letter’ (max. 5 MB), Curriculum Vitae must be uploaded under ‘Resume’ (max 5 MB). All other documents must be uploaded under ‘Miscellaneous documents’ (max 10 files with a maximum 50 MB per file). 

 

The application deadline is September 15, 2026, at 11:59 PM/23:59 (CET/CEST) 

 

Assessment and selection process

Applications will be assessed by an expert or assessment committee. Shortlisting may be applied, and only shortlisted candidates will receive a written assessment. Read about shortlisting at SDU.  Interviews and tests may be part of the overall evaluation.

Read about the Assessment and selection process.  

 

Employment terms

Appointment as a postdoc is temporary for an initial 2-year period, and the preferred start date is from October 2026. The start date may be adjusted to comply with processing times for any work- and residence permits.  Extension may be possible depending on available funding.

Employment as a postdoc requires academic qualifications at PhD level at the time of employment. Employment will be in accordance with the collective agreement between the Ministry of Finance and the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations for academics in the state including the associated circular on the protocol for the job structure for academic staff at Danish universities and the provisions for postdoc as described therein. 

Salary is determined in accordance with the applicable collective agreement and based on objective and gender-neutral criteria, including the content of the position, responsibilities, and qualification requirements. As an applicant, you are entitled to information about the starting salary and salary range for the position. This information will be provided during the recruitment process. SDU does not collect information on applicants’ previous salary. Further information on salary and taxation. 

Persons employed in the position may, based on a specific individual managerial assessment, be exempted from time registration, also known as a “self-organizer”.

-

The University of Southern Denmark wishes its staff to reflect the surrounding community and therefore encourages everyone, regardless of personal background, to apply for the position. SDU conducts research in critical technologies, which, due to the risk of unwanted knowledge transfer, is subject to a number of security measures. Therefore, based on information from open sources, background checks may be conducted on candidates for the position(s).

Further information for international applicants about entering and working in Denmark. You may also visit WorkinDenmark for additional information.

Further information about The Faculty of Engineering.

jobs.title: PhD Position in High Performance Organic Photovoltaics
jobs.description:
The Centre for Advanced Photovoltaics and Thin-Film Energy Devices (SDU CAPE), Mads Clausen Institute, University of Southern Denmark (SDU), invites applications for a 3-year PhD position within the DFF funded project LuminOPV. The position is open from Dec. 1, 2026, and the specific start date will be agreed with the successful candidates. 

 

What we offer 

The PhD position is a part of the SDU CAPE research center at the Mads Clausen Institute, SDU, where we focus on designing, developing, and bringing forward new sustainable solar energy conversion and storage technologies, in particular new thin film solar cells and modules. The DFF LuminOPV project will explore aggregation-induced emission (AIE)-active molecular materials to control photophysical processes, molecular organization, and energy losses in organic photovoltaics. Complementary interface engineering and passivation strategies will be employed to optimize charge extraction, suppress interfacial defects, enhance operational stability, and facilitate scalable organic solar cells and modules. 

This PhD project focuses specifically on the design and development of AIE-active molecular materials for next-generation organic photovoltaics. The project will be part of the DFF1 project, and research stays abroad is part of the position. Most of your working time is devoted to your own research studies. As a PhD student you are expected to develop your own ideas and communicate scientific results in English. We offer a fully funded PhD position for the duration of three years. 

The successful applicant will be enrolled as a PhD student at the PhD School at the Faculty of Engineering.

 

What we expect 

Candidates who hold a master’s degree in a relevant field (chemistry, material science, physics, electrical engineering and similar). Preferred candidates have experience with some of the following: Organic synthesis, molecular photophysics, organic and/or hybrid semiconductors, thin films and interfaces, and organic photovoltaics. Due to the high cross-disciplinary nature of the work, the candidate is expected to have excellent collaboration skills. A very good capability of communicating scientific results in English, both orally and in writing is required.

 

Workplace description 

We are an international research center working in the field of green energy technologies (CAPE), and we are looking for a highly motivated PhD candidate to join our CAPE research center at University of Southern Denmark (SDU), campus Sønderborg, for developing next-generation sustainable and high-performance photovoltaics. We offer a modern, inclusive, international and interdisciplinary working environment with state-of-the-art facilities as well as a strong tradition of international collaboration. Our ambition is, to recruit, develop, and retain talented scholars committed to both academic excellence and departmental development.

Having a focus on green energy technologies - improving performance, device stability and up-scaling, the center has full access to an ISOS5 cleanroom and surface science laboratory facility for the preparation and characterization of thin films and photovoltaic devices, as well as a fully equipped Roll-to-Roll (R2R) facility for upscaling flexible devices. Our research center CAPE is a partner in various national and international research projects and networks that include collaboration partners from both academia and industry. 

 

Further information 

For information about the CAPE research center, please see https://www.sdu.dk/en/forskning/cape 

For information about the Mads Clausen Institute, please see www.sdu.dk/en/mci

Further information about this position is available from Associate Professor Vida Engmann, e-mail: engmann@mci.sdu.dk.

If you experience technical problems, please contact our email support.

 

Application

Before applying the candidates are advised to read the Faculty information for prospective PhD students and the SDU information on how to apply.

Assessment of candidates is based on the application material, and the application must include: 

  • Motivated application. 

  • Curriculum Vitae.

  • Master’s and Bachelor’s degree certificates or equivalent, including transcripts of grades (original and an official English translation). 

  • Completed TEK PhD application form for 5+3 applicants. Find the form at the Faculty website.

  • Completed TEK PhD form for calculation grade point average. Find the form at the Faculty website. 

  • An official document describing the grading scheme of the awarding universities (if not Danish). 

  • Only for applicants from programmes that evaluate thesis/examination project by approved/not approved: An official written assessment of the thesis or dissertation project from the grade giving institution. The statement must clearly state that the candidate has been among the top 30 pct. in the graduation class for the study programme.

  • List of publications and maximum 2 examples of relevant publications (in case you have any publications).

  • References may be included, you're welcome to use the form for reference letter at the Faculty website.

  • A statement/documentation of other qualifications relevant to the position may also be included.

All documents must be in English and PDF format. CPR number (civil registration number) must be crossed out. All PDF-files must be unlocked, allow binding and may not be password protected. 

SUBMISSION GUIDE: Motivated application must be uploaded under ‘Cover letter’ (max. 5 MB), Curriculum Vitae must be uploaded under ‘Resume’ (max 5 MB). All other documents must be uploaded under ‘Miscellaneous documents’ (max 10 files with a maximum 50 MB per file). 

 

The application deadline is October 15, 2026, at 11:59 PM/23:59 (CET/CEST) 

 

Assessment and selection process

Applications will be assessed by an expert. Shortlisting may be applied, and only shortlisted candidates will receive a written assessment. Read about shortlisting at SDU.  Interviews and tests may be part of the overall evaluation. Read about the Assessment and selection process.  

 

Enrollment and employment terms

Appointment as a PhD fellow is a 3-year salaried position, and the monthly gross salary incl. pension is 37.075 DKK. If you have relevant postgraduate experience, you may be placed on a higher salary step. 

Applicants must hold a master’s degree (equivalent to a Danish master's degree) at the time of enrollment and employment. Employment is contingent on enrollment approved by the PhD School. Enrollment will be in accordance with Faculty regulations and the Danish Ministerial Order on the PhD Programme at the Universities (PhD order). Employment will be in accordance with the collective agreement between the Ministry of Finance and the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations for academics in the state including the associated circular on the job structure for academic staff at Danish universities and the provisions for PhD fellows as described therein as well as the Protocol on PhD fellows signed by the Danish Ministry of Finance and the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations (AC). 

Salary is determined in accordance with the applicable collective agreement and based on objective and gender-neutral criteria, including the content of the position, responsibilities, and qualification requirements. As an applicant, you are entitled to information about the starting salary and salary range for the position. This information will be provided during the recruitment process. jobs.title: Senior lecturers in Electrical Engineering
jobs.description:
We are looking for up to two senior lecturers in Electrical Engineering for permanent employment at the School of Science and Technology.

Subject area

The subject area for this position is Electrical Engineering.

Background

We are looking for up to two new colleagues to strengthen our teaching and research related to electrical engineering, at the intersection of electrical engineering, robotics, and autonomous systems. Topics of interest include control theory, signal processing, sensors, electronics and mechatronics; potentially extending towards robot manipulation, robot perception and machine learning. If you are passionate about advancing knowledge in these fields and enjoy working in an internationally connected research and educational environment, we would love to hear from you.

The positions are based at the school’s unit for computer science, which conducts education in both computer science and electrical engineering, and is home to the research environment AASS (applied autonomous sensor systems) which is a dynamic and multi-disciplinary constellation at the intersection of computer science, robotics, artificial intelligence, computer vision, and cybersecurity. The successful candidate is also expected to interact with the university-wide centre for AI, Robotics and Cybersecurity (ARC). See also: https://www.oru.se/english/our-profile/arc-ai-robotics-and-cybersecurity-center/

Duties and responsibilities

As a senior lecturer, you will divide your time between teaching at all levels, research, and any associated public engagement activities.

On the teaching side, you will contribute to courses spanning the breadth of electrical engineering, from foundational to advanced level. This includes courses in electrical circuits and electronics, digital electronics, control theory, digital signal conditioning and processing, and electrical machines. Over time you will be expected to develop your own courses. Teaching encompasses supervision, examination, course development and administration, planning and evaluation. Teaching can be done in Swedish and English. On the research side, you are expected to publish in relevant international venues and attract external research funding. You will be integrated into the research environment with possibilities to establish an independent research agenda connected to the unit's general topics.

There are also opportunities to take on leadership roles in research and education (for example, shaping degree programmes or leading a research team) and to contribute more broadly to the development of the unit's activities.

Qualifications

Those qualified for appointment as a senior lecturer are applicants who have demonstrated teaching expertise and been awarded a doctoral degree in a subject matter relevant for the position, or has the corresponding research competence or some other professional expertise that is of value in view of the subject matter of the position and the duties that it will involve.

A general eligibility criterion for teaching staff at Örebro University is to have completed courses on teaching and learning in higher education corresponding to 10 weeks. Knowledge and skills equivalent to such courses may also be assessed to establish whether these provide eligibility. A teacher who at the time of appointment lacks such training or the equivalent competence, must complete the required courses no later than within two years of taking up the position.

Assessment criteria

To see the job advertisement and the assessment criteria in its entirety, visit: https://www.oru.se/english/career/available-positions/job/?jid=20260201

Information

This is a permanent full-time position. At Örebro University, salary depends on the successful candidate’s qualifications and experience, and positions announced are, where appropriate, subject to a trial period.

For more information about the position, contact head of unit Martin Magnusson, +46 19 30 38 70, email: martin.magnusson@oru.se, or head of school Henrik Olsson, +46 19 30 12 36, email: henrik.olsson@oru.se.

At Örebro University, we expect each member of staff to be open to development and change; take responsibility for their work and performance; demonstrate a keen interest in collaboration and contribute to development; as well as to show respect for others by adopting a constructive and professional approach.

Örebro University actively pursues equal opportunities and gender equality as well as a work environment characterised by openness, trust and respect. We value the qualities that diversity adds to our operations.

Application

The application is made online. Click the button “Apply” to begin the application procedure.

For the application to be complete, the following electronic documents must be included:

    Covering letter, outlining how you believe you can contribute to the continued development of Örebro University
    CV with a relevant description of your overall qualifications and experience
    Teaching portfolio (as instructed in Örebro University's guidelines:  https://www.oru.se/globalassets/inforum-en/key_documents/human-resources/template-for-teaching-portfolio.pdf)
    Research portfolio
    Publication list
    Relevant scientific publications (maximum of five and in full-text format)
    Copies of relevant course/degree certificates and references verifying eligibility and criteria met

Only documents written in Swedish, English, Norwegian and Danish can be reviewed.

More information for applicants will be found on our career site: https://www.oru.se/english/career/available-positions/applicants-and-external-experts/

The application deadline is 2026-08-17. We look forward to receiving your application!

After the application deadline, no supplements can be made electronically. If you have scientific publications that cannot be attached electronically to the application, please cite them in your application and contact mailto:hr@oru.se.

As we have already made our choices in terms of external collaboration partners and marketing efforts for this recruitment process, we decline any contact with recruitment agencies and advertisers.

As directed by the National Archives of Sweden (Riksarkivet), we are required to deposit one file copy of the application documents, excluding publications, for a period of two years after the appointment decision has gained legal force.

jobs.title: Full Stack Developer
jobs.description:
What if your next role would let you shape user experiences at the core of Finlands financial infrastructure?

Were looking for a Full Stack Developer to join our New Business -team in Euroclear Finlands IT department for a permanent position.

This position suits a developer who values engineering excellence, meaningful impact, and professional autonomy, and who enjoys solving complex problems in a stable but continuously evolving environment contributing to systems that are critical to the Finnish and Nordic financial markets.

Your responsibilities

In this role, youll build and operate modern, long-lived systems where quality, reliability, and security are critical. Working closely with other developers, architects, product owners, and UX designers, youll deliver secure and scalable full-stack solutions, from user interfaces to backend services and deployment pipelines. Your work will support business-critical systems used daily by key market participants in a highly regulated financial environment.

In this role you will

Design and build modern user interfaces with focus on usability, accessibility, performance

Design and develop full stack software that fulfils functional and non-functional requirements.

Implement necessary APIs, integrations, data flows.

Take ownership of end-to-end delivery (design -> build -> test -> deploy -> operate)

Develop and maintain automated tests

Ensure performance, security, and reliability of solutions

Work with container platforms and Linux-based runtime environments both on-premises and in cloud.

Apply engineering best practices (maintainable code, reviews, CI/CD, documentation)

Collaborate with product, UX, architecture and development teams

What We Are Looking For

We are looking for a generalist software developer with a strong front-end mindset, who combines technical skills with a genuine interest in user experience and quality delivery.

- At least 5 years of hands-on experience in front-end development (React, TypeScript)
- Proven ability to build high-quality, user-centric interfaces in collaboration with UX/service designer
- Solid backend development skills (Java / Spring Boot)
- Knowledge of secure software development practices
- Experience with APIs and integrations
- Experience with test automation tools such as Playwright (or similar)
- Understanding of testing strategies and quality engineering
- Experience with containers and Linux runtime environments
- Strong problem-solving skills and an ownership-driven approach
- Good communication skills and fluency in English. Our working language is English. Fluency in Finnish is considered an advantage.
- Ability to collaborate in cross-functional teams.

Nice to have

- Experience in financial or regulated environment
- Experience with CI/CD pipelines and cloud platforms (e.g. Azure)

We are open to different experience levels and value both strong hands-on expertise and a growth mindset. While this role offers support and collaboration, it requires enough practical experience to work independently and take ownership for your own deliverables from an early stage.

Why join us

Join Euroclear and play a key role at the very heart of the global, Nordic, and Finnish financial markets. As a trusted backbone connecting over 2,000 financial institutions worldwide, Euroclear safeguards the stability of the worlds capital markets, while our Helsinki office anchors critical infrastructure for Finlands financial system.

Despite our global reach, Euroclear Finland is a close-knit, local team where everyone quickly gets to know each other. Here, your ideas matter and your initiatives are valued by supportive leadership. We take pride in running the financial world safely and reliably, but above all, we are people working for people, valuing care, collaboration, and integrity every day.

What We Offer

Meaningful work with real impact

Build secure, reliable, and high-performance solutions that support critical market infrastructure.

Stability and modernisation

Work on business-critical systems while contributing to modern technologies and continuous development.

Strong tech community

Collaborate with experienced architects, developers, and domain experts who value quality and continuous improvement.

Modern ways of working

Enjoy a well-equipped Ruoholahti office, a hybrid model (3 days on-site, 2 remote), and a culture that supports learning and collaboration.

Wellbeing and benefits

We offer regular office breakfasts, a paid volunteering day, comprehensive occupational healthcare, and flexible wellbeing benefits covering sports, culture, transport, massage, dental care, and lunch.

How to apply

Ready to take the next step in your career?

Please submit your application, CV, and salary request directly to our Careers database by 14 September 2026. You may also include a link to your GitHub profile. We encourage you to apply as soon as possible, as we review applications on a rolling basis.

For further inquiries, please contact our recruitment partner Arja Martikainen, Barona arja.martikainen(at)barona.fi.

Start date is negotiable but preferably in October 2026.

About Euroclear Finland

Euroclear group is a global provider of Financial Market Infrastructure (FMI) services.At the core, the group provides settlement, safe-keeping and servicing of domestic and cross-border securities for bonds, equities and derivatives to investment funds. The Euroclear group has multi-lingual, highly trained teams of professionals based in Europe, Asia, the Middle East and the Americas. The Euroclear group has +2 400 clients globally, settled the equivalent of EUR 1 072 trillion in securities transactions in 2023, representing 299 million domestic and cross-border transactions and held an average of EUR 37.7 trillion in assets for clients.

For more information about Euroclear Finland, please visit www.euroclear.fi or visit our group site www.euroclear.com
