jobs.title: Salgs- og rekrutteringskonsulent til JWC Staffing Agency
jobs.description:
Salgs- og rekrutteringskonsulent til JWC Staffing Agency

30 timer om ugen – med mulighed for fuldtid

Har du et skarpt salgsgen, trives med en travl hverdag og motiveres af at skabe resultater gennem stærke relationer?

Hos JWC Staffing Agency søger vi en engageret salgs- og rekrutteringskonsulent, der vil være med til at udvikle vores forretning og sikre de bedste medarbejdere til byggebranchen.

Du bliver en nøglespiller i vores fortsatte vækst, hvor du får ansvaret for både at udvikle vores kundeportefølje og sikre en professionel rekrutteringsproces fra første kontakt til medarbejderen er godt i gang hos kunden.

Dine arbejdsopgaver

Du får en alsidig hverdag, hvor salg, rekruttering og koordinering går hånd i hånd.

Dine primære opgaver bliver at:

· Opsøge og udvikle nye kunder inden for bygge- og anlægsbranchen.

· Vedligeholde og udvikle eksisterende kunderelationer.

· Planlægge og koordinere rekrutteringsforløb fra start til slut.

· Udarbejde og publicere stillingsopslag.

· Aktivt søge efter kandidater via jobportaler, sociale medier, og netværk.

· Gennemføre telefoninterviews, jobsamtaler og kandidatvurderinger.

· Koordinere ansættelser, onboarding og opfølgning.

· Arbejde målrettet med salgsbudgetter, pipeline og KPI'er.

Vi forestiller os, at du

· Har erfaring med salg – gerne inden for byggebranchen eller bemandingsbranchen.

· Trives i en hverdag med højt tempo og mange forskellige opgaver.

· Er en dygtig relationsskaber og kommunikerer naturligt med både kunder og kandidater.

· Arbejder struktureret og bevarer overblikket – også når tempoet er højt.

· Er selvstændig, initiativrig og tager ansvar for dine opgaver.

· Motiveres af at skabe resultater og nå dine mål.

· Taler - forstår og skriver dansk og kan begå dig på engelsk.

Det er en fordel, men ikke et krav, hvis du har erfaring fra byggebranchen eller selv har en håndværksmæssig baggrund.

Vi tilbyder

Hos os får du ikke bare et job – du bliver en del af en virksomhed i udvikling, hvor der er kort fra idé til handling.

Vi tilbyder blandt andet:

· En spændende og alsidig stilling med stor indflydelse på din egen hverdag.

· Mulighed for at præge virksomhedens fortsatte vækst.

· Et uformelt arbejdsmiljø med dygtige og hjælpsomme kolleger.

· Gode muligheder for både faglig og personlig udvikling.

· Attraktiv lønpakke med pension og bonusordning.

· Computer, telefon og de nødvendige arbejdsredskaber.

· Mulighed for hjemmearbejde efter aftale.

· Frihed under ansvar og fleksibilitet i hverdagen.

Hvem er vi?

JWC Staffing Agency leverer vikar- og rekrutteringsløsninger til bygge- og anlægsbranchen i hele Danmark.

Vi er en ung virksomhed med store ambitioner. Selvom JWC Staffing Agency er en relativt ny virksomhed, består vores team af medarbejdere med mange års erfaring inden for bemandings- og byggebranchen. Derfor bygger vores samarbejde på værdier som ordentlighed, troværdighed og professionalisme.

Hos os bliver du en del af et mindre team med højt humør, en uformel omgangstone og stor respekt for hinandens kompetencer. Vi tror på, at de bedste resultater skabes gennem samarbejde, og derfor arbejder vi ud fra filosofien: "Vi løfter i flok."

Hos os er kolleger ikke konkurrenter. Vi deler viden, hjælper hinanden og fejrer succeserne sammen. Den kultur afspejler sig både i vores daglige samarbejde og i vores bonusstruktur.

Vi har kontorer i Kolding og Odense, og denne stilling har primær arbejdsplads i Odense.

Ansøgning

Kan du se dig selv som en del af JWC Staffing Agency, og har du lyst til at være med på vores vækstrejse? Så send din ansøgning og dit CV hurtigst muligt til jwc@jwc-staffing.com med emnet "Salg".

Vi afholder samtaler løbende og ansætter, så snart vi har fundet den rette kandidat.

Vi glæder os til at høre fra dig.

jobs.title: Customer Finance Business Partner - Solna
jobs.description:
As a Customer Finance Business Partner you will work within the Swedish Sales Finance organisation in Stockholm. You will play a pivotal role within the specific Sales Customer team and also be part of a team of three Customer Finance Business Partners which all report to the Head of Sales Finance. In your role, you will be responsible for Arla's total portfolio of products: Milk, Yoghurt, Cream, Cheese, Butter etc. If you are enthusiastic, driven, analytical, and business oriented and like to work in close cooperation with the business, this could be the right challenge for you.

At Arla Foods we want to create the conditions for our colleagues to have a sustainable work life by offering flexibility and the opportunity to work in the office and remotely; based on the needs of the business and the employees. We call it the “Power of the Mix”.

How you will make an impact

In this position you will be the Finance Business Partner to one of our Customer Sales Directors. Key in your role is to enable your business partners to make sound and data-based decisions. Through solid forecasting, performance tracking and turning data into insights that you com-municate to the team, you will help shaping good business decisions for Arla. Monthly close activities, support in negotiations, and developing new insights are also vital parts of your job. Moreover you will act as a single point of contact (SPOC) for one of our categories supporting the SE commercial business with insights and recommendations how to drive profitable growth together with a close tie with supply chain finance.

Who are you?

•  You hold a Bachelor or Master in Business, Economics or similar •  You combine your degree with at least 3-5 years of proven successful experience from finance controlling, forecasting, planning or similar within a FMCG company

•  You have a good understanding of business and financial analysis, result follow-up and the ability to handle and interpret large quantities of data in Excel

•  You have several years of experience in Powerbi database & report building, SAP R/3, data engineering, Databricks and working with local and global teams. Full proficiency Excel and PowerPoint is a requirement,

•  Fluent in English is a requirement.

•  Experience from working directly towards Sales Customer Teams is a requirement with experience in stake holder management and driving complex projects cross functional.

•  The role is based in Solna and a minimum of three days a week working from the Solna office is a requirement according to Arla flexible working policy

As a person you have the ability to create good relationships across the organization and a gen-uine interest for business and people. You enjoy having a good time at work with colleagues while at the same time performing under pressure and in relation to sometimes tight deadlines. Other important qualities for success in the role are proactiveness, analytical skills, structure and drive.

What do we offer?

Arla Foods has collective agreements, and we always ensure to offer good and competitive working conditions. In addition to that, safety and working environment are our top priorities, which is why we, among other things, conduct random drug and alcohol tests.

Would you like to join us?

We review applications on an ongoing basis and encourage you to apply as soon as possible.

Shape the Future of Dairy

Arla is a global leader in the dairy industry, committed to enabling good food choices that make life better, providing people with natural, sustainable nourishment, while taking care at every step to ensure Arla is a choice they can feel good about. If you are looking to shape the future with an ambitious global cooperative that truly cares about your growth, where everyone feels valued and empowered, and collaboration is the core of culture, Arla is a choice you can feel good about.

jobs.title: Permanent nursing opportunities in Western Norway
jobs.description:
Would you like to combine a meaningful job with proximity to stunning nature?

We are recruiting registered nurses for permanent full-time positions within municipal healthcare services in Western Norway.

The positions are connected to nursing homes and home-based care services, where you will have the opportunity to work closely with patients and contribute to safe, high-quality healthcare services.

The workplace is beautifully located between fjords, high mountains and spectacular scenery. The area offers excellent opportunities for outdoor activities throughout the year, while still providing easy access to a larger town within approximately 40 minutes by car.

Here, you will find a working environment that offers responsibility, professional challenges and good opportunities to develop your experience within municipal healthcare. You will become part of a workplace characterised by cooperation, quality and professional commitment.

Your responsibilities

    Clinical nursing in home care, nursing homes or assisted living facilities
    Observation, assessment, medication management and accurate documentation
    Follow-up of patients with diverse medical conditions and functional levels
    Collaboration with relatives, coordinating units and external partners
    Interdisciplinary cooperation with doctors, therapists and other health professionals
    Contributing to service development, improvement work and quality assurance

We are looking for nurses who:

    Hold a valid nursing authorization from an EU/EEA country
    Previous experience in home care services or nursing homes is preferred
    Be proficient with basic computer skills, necessary for modern healthcare environments
    Speak and write English fluently
    Motivated to learn Norwegian
    Hold a bachelor’s degree in nursing (BSN)
    Hold a category B driving licence

Personal qualities:

    Responsible, structured and solution oriented
    Positive attitude and good teamwork skills
    Flexible and comfortable with varied tasks
    Motivated to contribute to a small but highly competent interdisciplinary team

We offer:

    A full-time permanent position in the Norwegian public healthcare system
    Competitive salary and working conditions
    A supportive work environment that values cooperation and professional confidence
    Opportunities for further development as a nurse
    Free online Norwegian language course with a private teacher
    Relocation assistance and help with housing
    Personal follow-up throughout the recruitment and relocation process

Ready to apply?

Send us your application and we will evaluate candidates on an ongoing basis. Feel free to reach out for more information. We look forward to hearing from you!

jobs.title: Säljare mot Befintliga Kunder!
jobs.description:
Innesäljare mot befintliga kunder

Om rollen

Har du minst ett års erfarenhet av utgående försäljning och trivs med att skapa bra kundrelationer? Då kan det här vara rätt roll för dig. Vi söker en innesäljare som vill arbeta med befintliga kunder och utvecklas vidare inom försäljning. Här får du möjlighet att arbeta med kunder som redan har en relation till företaget, där fokus ligger på att förstå kundens behov, följa upp och hitta rätt lösningar.

Vad innebär jobbet?

I rollen som innesäljare arbetar du främst med befintliga kunder via telefon. Du har löpande kontakt med kunder, följer upp tidigare dialoger och identifierar möjligheter till merförsäljning och nya affärer. Försäljningen sker på ett naturligt och relationsbyggande sätt, där du utgår från kundens behov och presenterar relevanta produkter och tjänster.

Du arbetar strukturerat mot uppsatta mål och blir en viktig del av ett engagerat team där kundrelationer, försäljning och resultat står i fokus. Rollen passar dig som gillar telefonförsäljning men uppskattar att arbeta med befintliga kunder där det redan finns en grundläggande relation.

Vi ser gärna att du har

    Minst ett års erfarenhet av utgående försäljning via telefon
    Erfarenhet av innesälj, telefonförsäljning eller kundservice
    Vana vid att arbeta mot uppsatta mål och försäljningsresultat
    God svenska i tal och skrift
    Grundläggande kunskaper i digitala system

Vem vi tror att du är

    Trygg och bekväm med att arbeta via telefon
    Har ett tydligt säljdriv och motiveras av att skapa resultat
    Relationsskapande och duktig på att bygga förtroende med kunder
    Lyhörd och bra på att identifiera kundens behov
    Strukturerad och trivs med att arbeta mot tydliga mål
    Vill fortsätta utvecklas inom försäljning och innesälj

Vi erbjuder dig:

    En säljande roll med fokus på befintliga kunder
    Möjlighet att arbeta med merförsäljning och utveckla befintliga kundrelationer
    Fast ersättning tillsammans med prestationsbaserade delar
    Introduktion, löpande coaching och stöd
    Ett engagerat team med tydliga mål och gemensamt fokus
    Möjlighet att utvecklas vidare inom försäljning och innesälj

jobs.title: Pienkonekorjaaja
jobs.description:
Etsimme nyt asiakasyrityksemme palvelukseen työntekijää vakituiseen ja kokoaikaiseen työsuhteeseen asennus- ja huoltotehtäviin Turkuun.

Pienkonekorjaajan työtehtäviin kuuluu erilaisten pienkoneiden, kuten piensähkötyökalujen mm. porakoneiden, sirkkelien ja lämmittimien korjaukset ja huollot sekä muut mahdolliset aputehtävät korjaamolla. Huolto- ja korjaustyöt tehdään asennusohjeiden mukaisesti ja saat tarvittaessa opastusta työhösi. Tehtävässä auttaa, jos sinulla on työn, koulutuksen tai harrastusten kautta tuntemusta tai kädentaitoja pienkoneiden tai vastaavanlaisten teknisten laitteiden korjauksesta.

Työssä tarvitset sähkötyöturvallisuuskorttia, suomen kielen taitoa sekä eduksesi katsotaan sähköalan koulutus. Työssä ei tarvitse olla alan ammattilainen, sillä saat kattavan perehdytyksen työtehtäviisi. Tärkeintä on kiinnostus ja ymmärrys koneita ja laitteita kohtaan.

Työaika on arkisin klo 8-16.

Tuleva työpaikkasi tarjoaa monipuoliset ja mielekkäät työtehtävät osaavassa työporukassa sekä ammattitaidon mukaisen palkkauksen! Tulet työllistymään vakituiseen työsuhteeseen suoraan asiakkaamme palvelukseen.

Kiinnostuitko työtehtävästä? Täytä työnhakulomake osoitteessa alrekry.fi!

Asiakkaamme käyttävät palveluamme työtehtävissä suorittavista tehtävistä ammattitaitoa vaativiin tehtäviin kuin myös suunnitteluun ja johtotehtäviin. Asiakkaamme ovat aktiivisia toimijoita monilta eri aloilta vahvimmin edustettuna teollisuus-, logistiikka-, tuotanto-, palvelu- ja kuljetusaloilla.

Kiinnostuitko! Jos haluat tietää enemmän, soita rohkeasti minulle ja kysy lisää. Tavoitat minut parhaiten ma - pe klo 9-14.00 välillä p.09 4542 7744 / Gia. Voit myös lähettää viestin sähköpostilla osoitteeseen hr.alrekry@alrekry.fi.

Olemme luotettava ja vakavarainen työnantaja vuodesta 2004. Toimintatapamme on tehdä parhaamme, että asiakkaamme onnistuvat tavoitteissaan. Pitkä kokemuksemme on osoittanut, että voit luottaa meihin.

Job Description:

Airbus Commercial Aircraft is looking for an Engineer in Certification and airworthiness (f/m) to join our Design and Repair certification department based in Toulouse, France.

You will be part of a team providing airworthiness approval to In-Service repair solutions . As part of the Certification team , you will be involved with Customer Care Center matters to give the best repair solution to the customers for them to bring back their aircraft in an airworthy condition after an event.

Your working environment:

Global capital of aeronautics and European capital for space research, Toulouse is a dynamic city in the southwest of France served by an international airport. Ideally located between the Mediterranean sea and the Atlantic ocean and close to the Pyrenees mountains, it offers plenty of options for outdoor activities!

How we care for you:

Financial rewards: Attractive salary, agreements on success and profit sharing schemes, employee savings plan abounded by Airbus and employee stock purchase plan on a voluntary basis.
Work / Life Balance:   Extra days-off for special occasions, holiday transfer option, a Staff council offering many social, cultural and sport activities and other services.
Wellbeing / Health: Complementary health insurance coverage (disability, invalidity, death). Depending on the site: health services center, concierge services, gym, carpooling application.
Individual development: Great upskilling opportunities and development prospects  with unlimited access to +10.000 e-learning courses to develop your employability, certifications, expert career path, accelerated development programmes, national and international mobility.


At Airbus, we support you to work, connect and collaborate more easily and flexibly.    

Wherever possible, we foster flexible working arrangements to stimulate innovative thinking.

Your challenges:

We are in close collaboration with all Airbus design offices worldwide.

We are working together with two other off-shore teams, in a follow the sun approach :
one based in Mobile (USA)
one based in Bangalore (India)


The work will be performed 7 days a week (monday to sunday) in shifts on day time hours by rotation.

Your main tasks and responsibilities are:

Provide Airworthiness approval of in-service repair solutions supported by the Repair and Design Approval Form (RDAF), and Flight Condition Documents (FCD).  

Interface with Airbus customer services, design offices, chief engineer teams and the other airworthiness departments.  

Act on request as airworthiness specialists in a multifunctional team to solve Aircraft on Ground situations (AOG).

This position is an opportunity to work for all Airbus civil programs, on all ATA chapters and develop multi-skills.

Being part of a very dynamic team, you will acquire a high level of overall aircraft knowledge, and enlarge your network within the company.

After the initial training period, the work will be performed seven days a week (Monday to Sunday) in shifts on daytime hours by rotation.

Your boarding pass:

You have an advanced level in English.

You are educated to degree level (or equivalent) in Engineering or a related discipline.

You have structure or systems skills.

You have a good general knowledge in aeronautics.

You have experience in the design office and/or in airworthiness. Knowledge in configuration management is a plus.

You are a real collaborative team player, reactive and curious.

This position requires a security clearance or will require being eligible for clearance by the recognized authorities.

Not a 100% match? No worries! Airbus supports your personal growth with customized development solutions.

Take your career to a new level and apply online now!

-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Airbus Commercial Aircraft recherche un Ingénieur en certification et navigabilité   (f/h) pour rejoindre notre Service de certification des réparations basé à Toulouse, France .

Vous ferez partie d'une équipe qui approuve les solutions de réparations proposées par le bureau d'études du Service Client, suite à un événement en service . Au sein de l'équipe certification et navigabilité, vous aurez la responsabilité de vérifier et attester que la solution technique ainsi appliquée restaure la navigabilité de l'avion. Cette étape est indispensable pour la remise en service de l'avion.

Votre environnement de travail :

Capitale mondiale de l'aéronautique et capitale européenne de la recherche dans le spatial, Toulouse est une ville dynamique du sud-ouest de la France desservie par un aéroport international. Idéalement située entre la mer Méditerranée et l'océan Atlantique et à proximité des Pyrénées, elle offre de nombreuses possibilités d'activités de plein air !

Located in Santa Claus Village, Snowman World invites the whole family to winter fun at a snowy playground made of snow and ice. In Santa Claus Village also locates charming gingerbread houses of Piparina and a cozy restaurant where customers can savor authentic Lapland flavors and relax in private gingerbread cottages throughout the day.

Snowman World is the most fun playground in Santa Claus Village, where the day is filled with exciting winter activities. The area features snow and ice slides, an ice rink, a snow maze, a snow restaurant, and an ice bar. The snow restaurant, ice bar, and café restaurant offer a wide variety of food, drinks, and café products daily.

We are now looking for a Snowman for the busy winter season of 2026–2027! As a Snowman, you will delight customers of all ages, from babies to grandparents, with your playful presence dressed in a snowman costume. In this job, having fun is essential; as a Snowman, you are always ready to dance, bounce down the slides, or take photos with customers. As a lively character, you are active and prepared to greet customers at various points in Snowman World. Your silent communication style includes cheerful waving, and you wont be startled by the unexpected hugs that a Snowman is sure to receive. The role of a Snowman requires a genuine desire to entertain the guests of Snowman World. Since the job involves being active while wearing the costume, good physical fitness is also required.

Work is available either full- or part-time according to your availability for the entire winter season. The job begins in late November and lasts until March 2027. The job requires readiness to work on weekdays, weekends, and public holidays. We follow the collective agreement for the adventure services, and the salary is based on skills and experience. The employment relationship will be established between Bondata and the employee, with accommodation in Rovaniemi arranged if needed.



We offer you:

jobs.title: Hoivanantaja
jobs.description:
Tule tekemään työtä, jolla on merkitystä!

"Vuonna 2008 perustetun Kotona Asuen Seniorihoivan visiona on muuttaa ikääntymisen kasvot tarjoamalla yksilöllisiä ja kiireettömiä koti- ja hoivapalveluita, jotka mahdollistavat ikäihmisen turvallisen kotona asumisen mahdollisimman pitkään. Palvelussamme korostuvat yksilöllisyys, luottamuksellisuus ja kumppanuus. Kotona Asuen Seniorihoiva toimii Uudellamaalla sekä Päijät-Hämeen, Pirkanmaan, Turun, Hämeenlinnan ja Oulun alueilla. Lisätietoa: www.KotonaAsuen.fi"

Kiinnostaisiko sinua kiireetön ja joustava osa-aikatyö, mukavien senioreiden kanssa? Etsimme nyt hoivanantajia pääkaupunkiseudulle!

Työ hoiva-alalla ikäihmisten parissa vaatii tekijältään aitoa välittämistä ja läsnäoloa. Haemme joukkoomme myötätuntoisia ja oikean arvomaailman omaavia henkilöitä.

Olet etsimämme henkilö, mikäli sinulla on intoa ja valmiuksia huolehtia senioreista heidän omissa kodeissaan. Etsimme myötätuntoisia, luotettavia ja sosiaalisia henkilöitä vahvistamaan hoivanantaja tiimiämme. Tutkintoja tai kokemusta tärkeämpänä arvostamme aitoa kykyä huolehtia toisista ihmisistä.

Hoivanantajana parannat seniorin elämänlaatua ja avustat häntä toimimaan itsenäisesti. Työtehtäväsi ovat monipuolisia. Olet apuna senioreiden päivittäisessä elämässä mahdollistaen arjen sujuvuuden. Tehtäviisi voi kuulua seuranpidon ohella kodinhoidollisissa tehtävissä avustamista, kuten siivousta, ruoanlaittoa, pyykkihuoltoa. Asiakkaat tarvitsevat monesti myös ulkoilu, kauppa- ja asiointiavustusta, joissa pääset olemaan mukana. Asiakkaan henkilökohtainen hoiva kuten aamu- ja iltatoimissa avustaminen voi olla osa hoivanantajan työtä.

Edellytämme:

\- Soveltuvuutta ja halua hoivatyöhön.

\- Luotettavuutta ja joustavuutta.

\- Myönteistä elämänasennetta ja sosiaalisuutta.

- Hyvää suomen kielen suullista ja kirjallista taitoa.

\- Tarkistamme työntekijän luottotiedot

\- Lain sosiaali-ja terveydenhuollon valvonnasta 741/2023 §28 mukaisesti tehtävään otettavan henkilön on esitettävä nähtäväksi rikosrekisterilain 6 §:n 2 momentissa tarkoitettu rikosrekisteriote.

\- Ilmoitathan suosittelijat työtehtävään.

Tarjoamme:

\- Joustavat mahdollisuudet tehdä työtä haluamillasi työtunneilla.

\- Itsenäisen, mielenkiintoisen ja erittäin palkitsevan työn.

\- Kattavan perehdytyksen vaadittuun tehtävään.

\- Tutut, vakituiset ja sinulle valikoidut asiakkaat.

\- Toimiston henkilökunnan tuen ja työnohjauksen.

\- Tarvittavat suojavälineet kuten käsineet, kasvomaskit ja käsihuuhde.

\- Yksityisen sosiaalialan työehtosopimuksen mukaisen palkan

\- Mahdollisuuden osallistua yrityksen järjestämiin sisäisiin koulutuksiin

\- Mahdollisuuden osallistua yrityksen järjestämiin tiimitapaamisiin.

Työnhakeminen on helppoa, täytä pikahakemus osoitteessa: www.kotonaasuen.fi/tule-hoivanantajaksi niin olemme sinuun pian yhteydessä!

Haastattelut aloitetaan jo hakuajan aikana ja paikat täyttyvät nopeasti, joten jätäthän hakemuksesi jo tänään!

jobs.description:
Hemfrid söker hemstädare till Linköping VästVill du arbeta med service och skapa trivsamma hem för våra kunder?

Hemfrid är Sveriges största företag inom hemstädning. Varje dag hjälper vi våra kunder med hemstädning, fönsterputs och andra hushållsnära tjänster – alltid med kvalitet, omtanke och hög service.

Nu söker vi engagerade hemstädare till Linköping Väst. Du kommer att arbeta hos våra kunder i olika delar av området, bland annat i Ljungsbro, Malmslätt och Vikingstad. Hos oss blir du en del av ett internationellt team där vi stöttar varandra, utvecklas tillsammans och alltid strävar efter att ge våra kunder den bästa servicen.

Det här erbjuder vi

    

En tjänst på 75 %

    

Kollektivavtal och trygga anställningsvillkor

    

Fast månadslön – samma lön varje månad

    

Milersättning när du använder egen bil mellan kunder

    

Betald restid under arbetsdagen

    

Försäkringar (sjukdom, ansvar och tjänstepension)

    

Friskvårdsbidrag på 2 400 kr per år

    

Gratis mobilabonnemang

    

Kostnadsfri introduktionsutbildning samt möjlighet till vidareutbildning inom service och städning

    

Stöd från en Field Lead/Buddy som hjälper dig att lyckas i din roll

    

Teamträffar och gemensamma aktiviteter

Hos Hemfrid får du en trygg start och goda möjligheter att utvecklas tillsammans med oss.

Din profil

Vi tror att du:

    

Trivs med att arbeta både självständigt och tillsammans med andra

    

Är noggrann, ansvarstagande och serviceinriktad

    

Vill utvecklas och lära dig nya saker

    

Talar svenska eller engelska

    

Kan arbeta vardagar mellan kl. 08.00 och 17.00

    

Trivs med att arbeta hos olika kunder

Meriterande

    

B-körkort och egen bil

    

Erfarenhet av hemstädning, lokalvård eller andra serviceyrken

HEMFRID IS LOOKING FOR HOME CLEANERS IN LINKÖPING WESTWould you like to work in a service-oriented role where you make a difference every day?

jobs.title: Brand Manager Chocolate - Maternity cover contract (9 - 12 months)
jobs.description:
Are You Ready to Make It Happen at Mondelēz International?

Join our Mission to Lead the Future of Snacking. Make It With Pride.

Exciting opening within the choclate category - the greatest tasting category in the world if you ask us! And even better this opportunity is to work with the strong brands Marabou, Daim and Japp.

We have a Brand Manager role available for someone who wants to join a fun and ambitious team working to make a difference. We are looking for someone with a hunger for snacks — and an equal appetite for growing the business, the brand, and themselves.  

Collaboration with cross-functional regional and local teams, implement brand strategy aligned with our brand vision to drive sustainable growth and to deliver business objectives. You also support profit and loss management and future business development plans and objectives, including new product development and platform opportunities.  

The responsibility is for Sweden, but the position has a key role in the Nordic team.  

How you will contribute

In your day-to-day activities you will work with others to build and execute the segment strategy and plans, develop product and packaging initiatives, implement pricing strategies, and execute integrated marketing communication and media plans.  

You will also provide recommendations for integrated commercial plans and provide input and support to ensure marketing plans meet revenue, profit targets and monitoring performance. Based on your strong understanding of consumer insights, brand strategy and positioning, you will help develop integrated marketing communication campaigns. 

Main responsibility

    Category strategy & business plans
    Consumer curious — You will dig into research, data, and cultural trends to uncover what moves our consumers — and turn those insights into opportunities that keep your category and brands relevant and irresistible.
    Trend spotter — You will keep your finger on the pulse of what's happening in culture, in the category, and among competitors — so we always stay one step ahead.
    Driving right Portfolio choices by optimizing core and creating clear innovation plans to growth the category and brand
    Activating — reinforcing your brands and segments through integrated campaigns across channels — the kind that make people stop, smile, and reach out for your brands. You will implement media plan, ensuring consistency in communication with focus on driving digital first.
    Performance — You will manage daily business tracking performance KPIs (market share, volume, revenue and profit) as well as keeping a close eye on brand KPIs (awareness, consideration, penetration) and turn the numbers into clear next steps.
    A&C (Market Spend) understanding and tracking  
    Team player — You will collaborate close with other functions and markets, sharing ideas and raising the bar together.  

What you will bring 

A love of snacking, a desire to drive your future and accelerate your career. Beyond that:

    Passion for brands and business with a clear understanding of our consumers
    Data-driven mindset with the ability to translate insights into actions
    Drive to delivering results, you're energized by ambitious targets and always looking for the next level
    Excellent project management and stakeholder communication skills
    Passion for digital communication
    You know how to influence others - not by pushing, but by making them genuinely excited about the idea
    5+ years in brand management or marketing, ideally in FMCG  
    A business/marketing related degree

Education / Certifications: 

University degree in economics or business administration is preferred. 

Languages:  

Fluency in Swedish and English is required.

Work schedule and location: Upplands-Väsby (Sweden). Temporary, start date: as soon as possible.

Travel requirements: not required

We offer:

    Health & Benefits: Friskvårdsbidrag (Wellness allowance), on-site gym, health check-ups at age intervals, and subsidized on-site massage and chiropractor.
    Food & Shopping: Subsidized lunch in our canteen and favorable discounts in our staff shop.
    Easy Everyday Life: Fenced parking for all on-site employees and comprehensive employee support for health, work, and private life.
    Security: Collective agreement, contractual insurance, occupational health care, and extra compensation for parental leave.
    Community: art association and social activities.

jobs.description:
Pokud je pro tebe kolo víc než jen dopravní prostředek, čti dál.
Kola nejsou jen dopravní prostředek.
Jsou to emoce, rychlost, bláto, asfalt, hory, lesy a radost z jízdy.
Dokážeš zákazníkovi poradit s výběrem kola a výbavy tak, aby odjížděl nadšený?
Pak hledáme právě tebe!
U nás nebudeš jen stát za pultem. Budeš člověk, který zákazníkům pomůže vybrat jejich nové kolo, poradí s výbavou a postará se o to, aby odjížděli s pocitem, že přišli na správné místo.

Práce u nás má svůj rytmus – v hlavní cyklo sezóně je provoz živější, takže počítej s větší dynamikou, občas i delší pracovní dobou, včetně sobot a směn do 19:00. Mimo sezónu je naopak více prostoru na klidnější tempo a další rozvoj.

Co tě u nás čeká
•    Aktivní prodej kol, doplňků a cyklo vybavení na prodejně v Olomouci
•    Pomoc zákazníkům s výběrem – od prvního dotazu až po spokojený odjezd
•    Péče o objednávky zákazníků (úpravy, doplnění, komunikace)
•    Evidence objednávek v interním systému – od zadání až po expedici
•    Základní servis, montáž a seřízení kol
•    Spolupráce s kolegy napříč firmou

Koho hledáme
•    Máš pro-zákaznický přístup a baví tě komunikace s lidmi
•    Umíš poradit a prodat tak, aby se zákazník rád vracel
•    Máš zkušenost s koly – ideálně i s jejich montáží nebo seřízením
•    Ovládáš práce s MS Office (Word, Excel, Outlook)
•    Není ti cizí práce s účetním nebo evidenčním systémem
•    Jsi spolehlivý, samostatný a máš chuť pracovat
•    Víš, že úsměv a dobrý přístup dělají polovinu obchodu

Co ti nabízíme?

•    zaměstnanecké ceny na více než 80 000 produktů
•    Výhodné mobilní tarify i internet a TV pro tebe i rodinu
•    Stravenkový paušál přímo ve mzdě
•    Odměny za dobré nápady a zlepšení
•    Pohodlné parkování a bezpečná kolárna

Máš kola v krvi? Pošli nám pár slov o sobě a pojď jezdit v našem týmu.

jobs.title: [Contract] Language Training Specialist - Japanese
jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE

Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion.



Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work.




ABOUT THE ROLE

We’re looking for an experienced Localization Project Manager — Japan Training Quality to support localization for Customer Education, helping ensure Notion training content feels accurate, clear, culturally relevant, and ready to use for learners across the globe.



You’ll work at the intersection of localization quality, training implementation, and program management, collaborating with Localization, Partner Enablement, Customer Education, vendors, and language specialists. You’ll help turn translation feedback, learner experience issues, and regional quality needs into practical improvements across training content, quizzes, LMS setup, and repeatable localization workflows.



The ideal candidate combines native-level Japanese language expertise with a deep understanding of what effective education looks like in the Japanese market.




WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE

 - Own and apply Japanese localization QA standards across training content, including checking for accuracy, clarity, tone, terminology, and cultural nuance

 - Support development of glossaries, style guides, QA checklists, review processes, and localization assets

 - Become a go-to partner for translation questions related to Notion-specific concepts, product terminology, and training context

 - Support QA of technical implementation in eLearning authoring tools and LMS environments (course files, quizzes, answer selections)

 - Coordinate across Customer Education, Partner Enablement, Localization, and vendors to align on priorities, timelines, translation progress, and quality expectations

 - Identify workflow risks and recommend improvements that improve translation quality and reduce time-to-launch

 - Document repeatable processes that make training and help center localization easier to manage over time




SKILLS YOU'LL NEED TO BRING

 - Strong understanding of localization workflows, including vendor collaboration, review cycles, glossaries, style guides, QA rubrics, and linguistic QA

 - Experience with Japanese localization QA, ideally for SaaS, technical training, customer education, or partner enablement content

 - Ability to review translated content for quality, clarity, terminology accuracy, cultural nuance, and learner comprehension

 - Familiarity with eLearning or LMS tools; experience with platforms like Skilljar or Parta authoring tools is a plus

 - Comfort working with technical or product-specific terminology that may not translate directly

 - Strong attention to detail, especially in learner-facing content, quizzes, course setup, formatting, and implementation QA

 - Strong project management skills and ability to bring structure into ambiguous areas




WHY THIS ROLE MATTERS

We want all of our learners should feel like Notion training content was made for them — not simply translated for them. High-quality localization has a direct impact on learner trust, comprehension, launch readiness, and regional enablement outcomes.



This role will help Customer Education and Partner Enablement move faster while raising the quality bar: reducing rework, catching issues before launch, improving vendor feedback loops, and creating a clearer, more repeatable operating model for training localization



This is a 6-month, part-time role with option to extend. Preferred location is Tokyo, but we're open to remote applicants with strong Japanese market expertise and timezone overlap with Japan and Notion's International Experience team.



Availability: 20 hours/week



#LI-Onsite




A NOTE ON AI

You don’t need deep AI expertise for every role, but we do expect every Notino to be intellectually curious, drawn to tinkering and discovery, and excited to use AI as a real collaborator in their work. For some roles, AI fluency is a core requirement — when that’s the case, we'll say so explicitly in the qualifications. People who thrive here don’t treat AI as a novelty. They use it to think better, and make their work easier for others to build on.




EQUAL OPPORTUNITY & ACCOMMODATIONS

We hire talented people from a wide range of backgrounds. If you’re excited about this role but don’t meet every bullet, we still encourage you to apply. Notion is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of any legally protected characteristic. Consistent with applicable law, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records. Notion provides reasonable accommodations during the application process; if you need one, please let your recruiter know.



Notion is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate in hiring or any employment decision based on race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), marital status, ancestry, physical or mental disability, genetic information, veteran status, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, or other applicable legally protected characteristic. Notion considers qualified applicants with criminal histories, consistent with applicable federal, state and local law. Notion is also committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities and disabled veterans in our job application procedures. If you need assistance or an accommodation due to a disability, please let your recruiter know.

jobs.title: MONTER/KA III (821306) U ODJELU ELEKTRO ODRŽAVANJA
jobs.description:
Uvjeti (potrebna znanja i kvalifikacije) koje kandidati moraju zadovoljiti za navedeno radno mjesto su:

• SSS/KV – elektro smjera • poznavanje čitanja električnih shema • vozačka dozvola B kategorije

Opis poslova radnog mjesta:

• obavlja složene poslove na održavanju elektro opreme i uređaja energetike na crpnim, precrpnim stanicama i vodospremama • obavlja popravak elemenata električnih instalacija niskog napona, sklopne tehnike, rasvjete, grijanja i snage • sudjeluje pri remontu agregata, demontaže i montaže elektro motora, mekih upuštača, frekventnih pretvarača i ispravljača • obavlja izradu električnih instalacija jake i slabe struje • izrađuje i montira sustave za kompenzaciju jalove energije na svim pogonima vodoopskrbe • održava elektroinstalacije u poslovnim prostorima • popravlja i održava vanjsku i unutarnju rasvjetu, gromobransku instalaciju, uzemljenja, izjednačavanje potencijala i kabelskog razvoda • rad u smjenama

Izabrani kandidati obavljat će poslove radnog mjesta MONTER III (821306) u Odjelu elektro održavanja, temeljem ugovora o radu na neodređeno vrijeme s probnim radom u trajanju od 6 (šest) mjeseci. Mjesto rada je u Zagrebu.

Uz predaju ponude koja sadrži kontakt podatke (broj telefona ili mobitela, e-mail adresa) kandidati trebaju obvezno priložiti dokaze o ispunjavanju uvjeta, kako slijedi:

• životopis s opisom dosadašnjeg rada • dokaz o odgovarajućem stupnju obrazovanja u skladu s uvjetima iz javnog natječaja (presliku svjedodžbe, odnosno rješenje o priznavanju inozemne stručne kvalifikacije koju je izdalo nadležno tijelo) • uvjerenje da se ne vodi kazneni postupak (ne starije od 3 mjeseca od dana objave natječaja) • presliku važeće vozačke dozvole

Ponude na javni natječaj podnose se elektroničkim putem. Rok za dostavu tražene dokumentacije je 14 dana od dana objave, na adresu elektroničke pošte:

vio.karijera@zgh.hr

S naznakom „Za javni natječaj za radno mjesto MONTER III (821306) u Odjelu elektro održavanja“.

Urednom ponudom smatra se ponuda koja sadrži sve podatke i priloge navedene u javnom natječaju. Nepotpune i nepravodobno pristigle ponude neće se razmatrati. Kandidati koji zadovoljavaju tražene uvjete iz natječaja, bit će upućeni na daljnji selekcijski postupak koji uključuje, prema potrebi, pisano testiranje (testovi općeg znanja, stručnih znanja, opće pismenosti, informatičke pismenosti i sl., psihologijsko testiranje i dr.) i/ili intervju.

Kandidati koji ostvaruju pravo prednosti pri zapošljavanju prema posebnim propisima dužni su u prijavi na javni natječaj pozvati se na to pravo i priložiti svu propisanu dokumentaciju prema posebnom zakonu te imaju prednost u odnosu na ostale kandidate pod jednakim uvjetima. Kandidati koji se pozovu na pravo prednosti pri zapošljavanju u skladu s člankom 102. Zakona o hrvatskim braniteljima iz Domovinskoga rata i članovima njihovih obitelji (Narodne novine, br. 121/17, 98/19, 84/21, 156/23), a u trenutku podnošenja prijave ispunjavaju uvjete za ostvarivanje toga prava dužni su uz prijavu na javni natječaj priložiti sve dokaze o ispunjavanju traženih uvjeta iz javnog natječaja i dokaze o ispunjavanju uvjeta za ostvarivanje prava prednosti pri zapošljavanju.

Popis dokaza potrebnih za ostvarivanje prava prednosti pri zapošljavanju nalazi se na internetskoj stranici Ministarstva hrvatskih branitelja:

https://branitelji.gov.hr/UserDocsImages//dokumenti/Nikola//popis%20dokaza%20za%20ostvarivanje%20prava%20prednosti%20pri%20zapo%C5%A1ljavanju-%20ZOHBDR%202021.pdf

Kandidati koji se pozovu na pravo prednosti pri zapošljavanju u skladu s člankom 48. Zakona o civilnim stradalnicima iz Domovinskog rata (Narodne novine, broj 84/21 i 13/26) a u trenutku podnošenja prijave ispunjavaju uvjete za ostvarivanje toga prava dužni su uz prijavu na javni natječaj priložiti i sve dokaze o ispunjavanju traženih uvjeta iz javnog natječaja i dokaze o ispunjavanju uvjeta za ostvarivanje prava prednosti pri zapošljavanju. Popis dokaza potrebnih za ostvarivanje prava prednosti pri zapošljavanju nalazi se na internetskoj stranici Ministarstva hrvatskih branitelja:

https://branitelji.gov.hr/UserDocsImages//dokumenti/Nikola//popis%20dokaza%20za%20ostvarivanje%20prava%20prednosti%20pri%20zapo%C5%A1ljavanju-%20Zakon%20o%20civilnim%20stradalnicima%20iz%20DR.pdf

Kandidati koji se pozovu na pravo prednosti pri zapošljavanju u skladu s člankom 48. Zakona o zaštiti vojnih i civilnih invalida rata (Narodne novine, br. 33/92, 57/92, 77/92, 27/93, 58/93, 2/94, 76/94, 108/95, 108/96, 82/01, 103/03, 148/13 i 98/19), uz prijavu na javni natječaj dužni su, uz dokaze o ispunjavanju traženih uvjeta iz javnog natječaja, priložiti rješenje ili potvrdu o priznatom statusu, izjavu da do sada nisu koristili pravo prednosti pri zapošljavanju po toj osnovi te dokaz iz kojeg se vidi na koji je način prestao radni odnos kod posljednjeg poslodavca (rješenje, ugovor, sporazum i sl.).

Kandidati koji se pozovu na pravo prednosti pri zapošljavanju u skladu s člankom 9. Zakona o profesionalnoj rehabilitaciji i zapošljavanju osoba s invaliditetom (Narodne novine, br. 157/13, 152/14, 39/18 i 32/20), uz prijavu na javni natječaj dužni su, uz dokaze o ispunjavanju traženih uvjeta iz javnog natječaja, priložiti i rješenje o utvrđenom invaliditetu, odnosno drugu javnu ispravu o invaliditetu na temelju koje se osoba može upisati u očevidnik zaposlenih osoba s invaliditetom te dokaz iz kojeg se vidi na koji je način prestao radni odnos kod posljednjeg poslodavca (rješenje, ugovor, sporazum i sl.).

jobs.title: ISPITIVAČ/ISPITIVAČICA ZA POSLOVE ISPITIVANJA BEZ RAZARANJA (NDT)
jobs.description:
Inženjer strojarstva za rad na poslovima ispitivanja bez razaranja. Posao uključuje provedbu ispitivanja bez razaranja, te pisanje izvještaja provedenim ispitivanjima na Hrvatskom i / ili Engleskom jeziku s odgovarajućim zaključcima. Ispitivanja se vrše na različitim strojarskim elementima i dijelovima parnih turbina i pumpe te slične energetske opreme u pogonima TTK u Karlovcu i na terenu (razna postrojenja). Ispitivanja koja se provode su: - VT – vizualni pregled (povremeno videoskopija i dimenzionalna kontrola)* - UT – ispitivanja ultrazvukom* - PT – ispitivanja penetrantima* - MT – ispitivanja magnetnim česticama* - HT – mjerenja tvrdoće - PMI – analiza sastava materijala *potrebna formalna certifikacije prema HRN EN ISO 9712:2022, minimalno level 2 Rad je samostalan ili u timu, uz podršku inženjeringa TTK. Poželjno je prethodno radno iskustvo na sličnim poslovima, te formalna certifikacija. Ukoliko postoji interes a nemate formalnu certifikaciju ista će se provesti od strane TTK uz interno i vanjsko školovanje. Od kandidata se očekuju tehnička stručnost, analitičnost, ozbiljnost u izvršavanju posla te završnim izvještajima te spremnost na terenski rad koji može uključivati i rad vikendom. Uvjeti:
  • VŠS / VSS (strojarstvo)
  • Poželjno prethodno radno iskustvo na sličnim poslovima
  • Vozačka dozvola B kategorije
  • Spremnost na terenski rad
  • Analitičnost i tehnička stručnost
  • Znanje engleskog jezika
Nudimo:
  • Mogućnost stručnog usavršavanja i dodatnih edukacija (rad sa specijaliziranom opremom)
  • Rad na zanimljivim i tehnički zahtjevnim projektima u strojarstvu i energetici
  • Profesionalni razvoj i stjecanje specijalističkih znanja

Grossunternehmen und Unternehmensgruppen werden bei der Abwicklung von HR\-Prozessen und im betrieblichen Gesundheitsmanagement durch die im Hause entwickelten Softwarelösungen und Dienstleistungen unterstützt. Als Marktleader in ihrem Bereich steht das Unternehmen auf stabilen und finanziell gesunden Beinen. Dies ermöglicht die gezielte Investition in die wegweisende Weiterentwicklung ihrer Produkte. Auf dich warten flexible Arbeitszeitmodelle, grosszügige Home\-Office\-Regelungen, sehr gute Sozialleistungen sowie moderne Arbeitsbedingungen. Mit der spürbar gelebten Wertekultur «Gemeinsam», «Mutig», «Begeistert» und «Respektvoll» bietet man dir ein attraktives Umfeld.  
Die IT von HRM Systems entwickelt sich stetig weiter. Komplexe Produkte, gewachsene Infrastrukturen und moderne SaaS\-Architekturen bringen spannende technische Herausforderungen mit sich. Um den Bereich DevOps über alle Produkte hinweg gezielt zu stärken, wird ein neues, kleines DevOps\-Team aufgebaut. Dieses Team bildet künftig die Brücke zwischen dem Produktbereich, interner Infrastruktur, Betriebsinfrastruktur und dem Entwicklungsbereich. Damit entsteht eine vielseitige Rolle mit Gestaltungsspielraum und technischer Verantwortung. Im Rahmen eines Exklusivmandats suchen wir eine:n erfahrene:n DevOps Engineer.  
Deine Herausforderung  
Du unterstützt übergreifend die Produktentwicklungsteams rund um die drei Produkte UKA Solutions, CAREMA und UKA Connect bei DevOps\-Themen und betreust die bestehende Infrastruktur.  
Du stellst den stabilen Betrieb von Produktions\- und Entwicklungsumgebungen auf Infrastruktur\-Ebene sicher.  
Du analysierst und behebst Störungen in enger Zusammenarbeit mit den Entwicklungsteams, IT\-Services und dem externen Infrastruktur\-Provider.  
Du optimierst die Automatisierung rund um Builds, Deployments, Testing, Monitoring und Alerting.  
Du bringst technische Konzepte voran und schaffst die Grundlage für eine stabile, sichere und wartungsarme Infrastruktur.  
Du arbeitest mit Technologien und Werkzeugen wie GitLab, OpenShift, Docker, Kubernetes, PostgreSQL, ELK, Grafana und Nagios.  
Du übernimmst übergreifende Themen wie die Verwaltung von Lizenzen und Zugriffsberechtigungen für Entwickler.  
Du entwickelst ein neu entstehendes DevOps Team aktiv mit und bringst deine Ideen für langfristig tragfähige Lösungen ein.  
Deine Qualitäten und Begabungen  
Mindestens 3 Jahre Berufserfahrung im DevOps oder DevOps\-nahen Umfeld  
Abgeschlossenes Studium im Bereich Informatik, Wirtschaftsinformatik oder entsprechende Berufserfahrung (du kommst entweder aus der Softwareentwicklung und hast dich in Richtung DevOps entwickelt oder du bringst einen Infrastruktur\-Background mit starkem DevOps\-Engineering Verständnis mit)  
Von Vorteil sind Kenntnisse von mehreren Technologien, welche sich mit denen bei HRM decken: OpenShift, Kubernetes, Docker, PostgreSQL, CI/CD, GitLab  
Du gestaltest gerne mit und bringst deine Ideen ein  
Du fühlst dich in einem Umfeld wohl, in dem noch nicht alles abschliessend definiert ist, und gehst Themen proaktiv, analytisch und lösungsorientiert an.  
In Deutsch bist du verhandlungssicher

jobs.description:
Staff Frontend Engineer (f\|m\|d) \| (80\-100%) \| Hybrid working model \| Zurich  
Company Description  
Welcome to SMG Swiss Marketplace Group!  
SMG is a pioneering network of online marketplaces and a leading European digital company that simplifies people’s lives with forward\-looking products.  
We operate leading marketplaces across real estate, automotive, general classifieds, and finance \& insurance. We’re driven by our values: Better Together, Aim High, and Act Responsibly.  
Job Description  
As a Staff Frontend Engineer, you'll be a hands\-on technical leader with company\-level impact across our Real Estate vertical. You’ll shape and evolve the frontend architecture powering our portals, create shared frontend solutions adopted by multiple teams, and orchestrate complex initiatives.  
Meet the team!  
At SMG, our strength lies in our people. Meet the Manager with whom you could work:  
Yuliya Zvolskaya \- Engineering Manager \- LinkedIn  
At a high level, you will:  
Set technical direction for frontend across multiple teams, building alignment among engineers, product managers, designers and senior stakeholders.  
Influence roadmaps, investment decisions, and engineering priorities by connecting frontend strategy to business outcomes, delivery risk and customer impact.  
Defining and driving the culture of engineering excellence, while leading the evolution of our Real Estate frontend architecture to support future requirements, setting and improving SLAs/SLOs and anticipating ripple effects across systems together with other engineers and principals.  
Act as a trusted technical leader across teams and locations for frontend topics, shaping how web experiences are built across our organisation and influencing decisions at both team and leadership levels.  
Represent frontend engineering in cross\-functional and leadership discussions, helping the organisation make better long\-term technical trade\-offs.  
Design and create shared frontend libraries, components and tooling (e.g. design system, performance monitoring) that are widely used by internal teams, focusing on pragmatic, reusable solutions and driving their adoption.  
Orchestrate multi\-system refactors and migrations like framework upgrades, cross\-product harmonisation.  
Mentor and coach other engineers through structured mentorship, pairing, and feedback, helping them grow their skills and closing skill gaps you observe in the organisation by organising structured trainings for our people.  
Model a healthy feedback culture, helping people navigate tough conversations and conflicts in a constructive, blameless way.  
Challenge and improve team and cross\-team processes, suggesting changes that improve focus, quality, and speed when needed.  
You’ll still write plenty of code, but your impact will be measured just as much by how you multiply the effectiveness of others as by your individual output.  
Your day\-to\-day  
You'll be part of a product team, splitting time about half and half between product delivery and staff responsibilities, depending on the current needs and priorities  
Innovate, design, implement, and deploy frontend\-focused engineering solutions for our products, from discovery to production.  
Build alignment across teams with different goals and constraints, and unblock progress on ambiguous, cross\-cutting initiatives. Step in to create clarity, momentum, and shared ownership when needed.  
Own the end\-to\-end technical vision for key user journeys like Homegate and Immoscout24 and more, with a strong focus on performance, accessibility, UX quality, and reliability  
Lead cross\-team frontend initiatives (for example: shared design system improvements, cross\-brand UI harmonisation, performance budgets, or observability patterns).  
Identify and surface cross\-cutting technical bottlenecks, such as performance drags in the core user journey or build\-time inefficiencies, and advocate for their resolution at the leadership level.  
Collaborate closely with Product, Design, and other engineering teams to shape technical strategy and trade\-offs for new features and platform work  
Partner with DevX to co\-develop engineering 'blueprints' and health scorecards, setting the gold standard for what 'good' looks like in our frontend repositories  
Evaluate, prototype, and introduce new frontend technologies and approaches (frameworks, tooling, patterns), document your findings, and drive adoption where they make sense  
Own and evolve the Frontend ADR process, ensuring technical decisions are documented, socialised, and consistently implemented across our organisation  
Guide and review the work of other engineers through design reviews, code reviews, guild, and informal coaching.  
Help the team embrace and leverage AI \& large language models in our engineering workflows and products  
Contribute to and facilitate the frontend guild, tech chats, and other cross\-team knowledge\-sharing formats  
Promote a culture of high\-quality engineering: testing, monitoring with Datadog, observability, security, and operational excellence  
Our Tech Stack  
You’ll work primarily on the frontend, while collaborating with fullstack engineers:  
Frontend: mainly and some React, both with TypeScript as the language of choice. We run a mix of client\-side, server\-side, pre\-rendered, and hybrid web apps  
Backend: and TypeScript, serverless and microservices architecture in a cloud\-based environment using AWS (Lambda, DynamoDB, SQS, SNS, S3, and more)  
Monitoring \& Observability: Mainly Datadog plus logging/alerting best practices  
AI \& Tooling: We actively adopt the latest developments in AI technology and expect you to embrace innovation offered by large language models in your daily work  
Qualifications  
8\+ years of professional experience with the or similar frameworks  
Proven track record of implementing and maintaining automated frontend testing, using tools such as Jest, Vitest, and/or Cypress  
Experience collaborating with designers using Figma ()  
Strong experience building and evolving large\-scale frontend applications in modern JavaScript/TypeScript  
Proven track record of senior technical leadership in a Staff, Lead, or equivalent role: leading complex cross\-team initiatives, aligning diverse stakeholders, influencing decisions without direct authority, and taking responsibility from strategy through rollout and iteration.  
Deep understanding of modern CI/CD for frontend, including automated release strategies and feature flagging in a microfrontend environment.  
Demonstrated experience creating and driving adoption of shared frontend solutions (e.g. design system components, shared libraries, cross\-cutting tooling)  
Demonstrated experience influencing multiple teams or an entire product area, including driving alignment, adoption, and durable technical change across various teams.  
Experience mentoring senior engineers or tech leads, and raising the technical bar through coaching, feedback, and role modelling.  
Strong stakeholder management skills, with the ability to communicate effectively with Engineering\- and Product leadership, as well as non\-technical partners.  
Evidence of defining a technical strategy and turning it into execution across teams.  
Excellent English communication skills, spoken and written.  
You can explain complex topics clearly to different audiences in an international team setting  
We value engineers who:  
Thrive in collaborative environments and are true team players  
Have a growth mindset and are curious, we love growing together  
Are passionate about frontend architecture and building \& scaling cloud\-based solutions  
Are open to change and able to propose pragmatic solutions, not just point out problems  
Feel free to challenge the status quo when it improves outcomes for users or the organisation.  
Are creative, adaptable, and enjoy solving complex, ambiguous problems  
You will stand out if you have:  
Significant professional experience in software development (including time in senior/lead roles)  
Deep experience with JavaScript/TypeScript and modern frontend frameworks (, React, or similar)  
Solid hands\-on experience building production applications with Vue 3  
Strong understanding of web performance, accessibility, and SEO considerations for large user\-facing sites  
Prior working experience with APIs and microservices and how frontend apps best integrate with them  
Prior working experience with cloud service providers like AWS, Microsoft Azure, or Google Cloud experience with server\-side rendering / hybrid rendering patterns and edge / CDN optimisation  
Experience integrating frontends with AWS Lambda  
Additional Information

Médecins Sans Frontières is an independent, international medical and humanitarian organization that provides care to people in need, people affected by natural or man\-made disasters, and victims of armed conflict, without discrimination and without regard to race, religion, creed or political affiliation (MSF Charter).

Senior Mechanical Engineer – Equipment \& Package Systems  
Company Description  
Welcome to Kanadevia Inova, a global innovation leader in the waste infrastructure space, where we believe in creating a sustainable future through technology and innovation.  
Transforming Waste into Value  
At Kanadevia Inova, we pride ourselves on being at the forefront of waste\-to\-X technology. We are not just waste managers; we are creators of value from what communities discard. Your role at Kanadevia Inova directly contributes to turning something once considered useless \- waste \- into something invaluable: energy, heat, hydrogen, fertilizer, and beyond.  
Job Description  
Manage the engineering and execution of assigned equipment and package systems, including heat exchangers, silos, stacks, chemical supply systems and other process plant equipment.  
Prepare technical specifications and RFQ documentation, evaluate supplier bids, conduct clarification meetings and support supplier selection.  
Coordinate concept and basic engineering activities, ensuring project requirements, interfaces and plant integration are adequately addressed.  
Lead multidisciplinary interface management with Process, Layout, Civil, Structural, Electrical, I\&C, Construction, Commissioning and external suppliers.  
Supervise supplier engineering activities, monitor procurement and documentation progress, and drive the resolution of technical issues.  
Review and approve supplier documentation, ensuring compliance with project, contractual and regulatory requirements.  
Support factory acceptance tests (FATs), installation and commissioning activities, including the resolution of supplier non\-conformities and site\-related technical issues.  
Maintain effective stakeholder communication throughout project execution and provide international project support through supplier visits, FATs and site activities (10\-20% travel).  
Qualifications  
Degree in Mechanical Engineering or a comparable discipline from a technical college or university (FH/ETH or equivalent).  
At least 5 years of relevant experience, preferably in international plant engineering, EPC projects, power generation or the process industry.  
Proven experience in the engineering, procurement and execution of complex mechanical equipment and package systems.  
Experience with industrial heat exchangers; knowledge of stacks, silos, chemical supply systems or similar process equipment is an advantage.  
Solid understanding of industrial plant processes and mechanical systems, with the ability to read and interpret P\&IDs.  
Strong coordination, negotiation and communication skills when working with suppliers, Procurement, site teams and other stakeholders.  
Structured, precise and proactive working style, with a high level of ownership and responsibility.  
Proficient in MS Office and fluent in English; knowledge of COMOS, AutoCAD, KKS or German is an advantage.

jobs.description:
Aquaphor International OÜ is looking for an experienced Toolmaker / Mold Maintenance Technician (Injection Molding) to join our team.

Repair, service, and maintain injection molds. Perform preventive maintenance and keep molds production-ready. Diagnose mold and tooling issues and carry out necessary repairs. jobs.title: Danish-speaking Assistance Coordinator in Spain
jobs.description:
Viking Travel Care is looking for Danish-speaking Assistance Coordinators to join our travel insurance assistance centre in Spain.

At Viking Travel Care, you will assist Nordic travellers around the world when they experience illness, accidents or other unexpected situations while travelling. You will provide important support to customers who need reassurance, information and practical assistance.

This could be an exciting opportunity for you if you already live in Spain or are considering moving here.

What does the role involve?

As an Assistance Coordinator, you will often be the first person a customer speaks to when something has happened.

Your responsibilities will include:

    Answering telephone calls and emails
    Listening to customers and understanding their situation
    Opening and following up on cases
    Providing information about insurance coverage
    Assisting with arrangements involving doctors, clinics, transport, hotels or repatriation when required
    Working with insurance companies, doctors, clinics and other partners

Our assistance centre operates 24/7, and working hours are organised across daytime, evening, night and weekend shifts.

Who are we looking for?

You do not need a particular educational background to apply. What matters most is that you enjoy helping people, communicate well and are comfortable working in a busy environment.

Experience in customer service, travel, healthcare, insurance, hospitality or other people-focused roles may be relevant, but it is not a requirement.

A background in areas such as languages, travel and tourism, healthcare, law, insurance or international studies may also be relevant, but is not required.

We are looking for someone who:

    Speaks and writes Danish fluently
    Speaks and writes English confidently
    Is comfortable communicating by telephone and in writing
    Is organised and accurate
    Enjoys finding solutions
    Works well both as part of a team and independently
    Learns new systems quickly
    Is flexible and positive

Additional languages are an advantage.

To proceed in the recruitment process, you must be able to provide a clean criminal record certificate.

What we offer

    A full-time position in accordance with Spanish employment law
    Thorough and structured training
    A competitive salary and good employment conditions
    A social and inclusive working environment
    Varied working days where you can make a genuine difference
    Opportunities for personal and professional development
    Attractive offices in Torrevieja or Fuengirola

How to apply

Please submit your application and CV. Applications will be reviewed and interviews conducted on an ongoing basis.

Interviews will be held on an ongoing basis.

We look forward to hearing from you!

About Viking

Viking Travel Care assists travelers and expatriate employees around the world on behalf of travel insurance companies. We coordinate assistance for Nordic travelers and, through our global network of medical providers and partners, provide support in situations ranging from minor travel-related incidents to complex medical emergencies.

Viking Travel Care is part of Viking Assistance Group, a leading Nordic provider of roadside assistance, vehicle-related services and assistance solutions. Viking has offices in Oslo, Stockholm, Copenhagen, Helsinki, Torrevieja and Fuengirola, Spain.

jobs.title: Kok til The Food Company - fri hver aften og weekender
jobs.description:
Forestil dig et kokkejob, hvor du har fri hver aften og alle weekender

Faste dagsvagter • Fri hver aften • Fri alle weekender • 37 timer

Du elsker at lave god mad.

Men måske er du blevet træt af sene aftener, weekendarbejde og at skulle vælge mellem dit arbejde og dit privatliv.

Hos The Food Company behøver du ikke vælge. Vi søger en fagligt dygtig kok, der stadig brænder for håndværket – men som også sætter pris på at kunne spise aftensmad med familien, have fri i weekenderne og vide, hvornår arbejdsdagen slutter.

Her får du et køkken med høj faglighed, gode kolleger og ordnede forhold - uden de klassiske arbejdstider, som mange kokke gerne vil væk fra.

Det får du hos os

✔ Fast arbejde på daghold

✔ Fri hver aften

✔ Fri alle weekender

✔ 37 timers fuldtidsstilling

✔ Eget parti med ansvar og indflydelse

✔ Et stærkt køkkenteam, der hjælper hinanden

✔ Mulighed for at udvikle dig fagligt

Kort sagt: Du får mulighed for at arbejde med det, du elsker, samtidig med at du får mere tid til livet uden for køkkenet.

 

Et køkken, hvor kvalitet og fællesskab går hånd i hånd

Hos The Food Company laver vi mad med stolthed.

Vi tror på godt håndværk, gode råvarer og kolleger, der spiller hinanden gode.

Du får ansvar for dit eget parti og følger produktionen hele vejen fra planlægning til den færdige ret. Vi giver dig frihed til at tage ansvar, fordi vi tror på, at de bedste resultater skabes af dygtige mennesker, der får lov til at bruge deres faglighed.

Samtidig står du aldrig alene. Vi arbejder som ét hold og hjælper hinanden, når der er travlt. Det skaber både høj kvalitet og en arbejdsplads, hvor man har lyst til at møde ind.

 

Vi tror på, at de bedste kokke...

...har faglig stolthed.

...kan lide at tage ansvar.

...nyder at samarbejde.

...har øje for kvalitet.

...og altid ønsker at levere et godt resultat.

Hvis du kan genkende dig selv i det, vil vi meget gerne høre fra dig.

 

Hvem er du?

Du er uddannet kok, eller har solid erfaring fra et professionelt køkken.

Du arbejder struktureret, bevarer overblikket og sætter en ære i, at det, der forlader dit parti, altid lever op til en høj standard.

Du kommer med en positiv indstilling og bidrager til et godt samarbejde, fordi du ved, at den bedste mad bliver skabt af et godt team.

 

Vi hjælper hinanden

Hos os er ingen opgaver vigtigere end fællesskabet.

Når der er travlt, giver vi en hånd med, hvor der er brug for det. Vi tror ikke på "det er ikke mit bord" – vi tror på holdånd.

Det er en vigtig del af vores kultur, og det er også derfor, vi kalder vores måde at arbejde på Service by Feeling.

 

Praktisk

Arbejdstid

37 timer om ugen, mandag til fredag i dagtimerne.

Mødetid typisk omkring kl. 06.00

Arbejdssted

Ny Banegårdsgade 48

8000 Aarhus C

Tiltrædelse

Hurtigst muligt eller efter aftale.

 

Kunne det være dig?

Så send din ansøgning og dit CV via vores rekrutteringssystem.

Vi holder samtaler løbende og ansætter, så snart vi har fundet den rette kollega.

Måske er du allerede godt tilfreds med dit nuværende job.

Men hvis du savner mere balance i hverdagen, uden at gå på kompromis med dit fag – så synes vi, du skal tage en snak med os.

jobs.title: Workplace Technology Operation (Contractor), Dublin
jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE

Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion.



Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work.




ABOUT THE ROLE:

Notion is seeking a Workplace Technology Operation contractor for our Dublin office. As part of our growing Workplace Technology Operations team, you'll be a resourceful, security-focused, and people-centered professional who will help us continue scaling and establish best-in-class support for our end users. The ideal candidate is expected to provide exceptional technical support, contribute to automation opportunities, and make a meaningful impact on our day-to-day workplace operations. This is a 12–18 month fixed-term role, with longer-term opportunities possible depending on business needs and performance. 



In-person collaboration is essential to Notion's culture. We require all team members to work from our offices on Mondays, Tuesdays, and Thursdays, our designated Anchor Days. Certain teams or positions may require additional in-office workdays.




WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE:

 - End User & AV Support: Provide reliable onsite and remote technical support for Dublin/EMEA employees across hardware, software, connectivity, SaaS tools, conference room AV, and internal events, with clear communication and practical judgment.

 - Employee & Device Lifecycle Operations: Keep employee lifecycle and asset workflows running smoothly day to day, including account provisioning, device preparation, inventory hygiene, procurement coordination, returns, repairs, and deprovisioning.

 - Operational Excellence: Leave EMEA IT Operations stronger than you found it by improving SOPs, Notion resource library content, handoffs, self-service resources, and support practices that scale beyond one person.

 - Workflow Improvement & Automation: Identify and improve at least one recurring support workflow — such as onboarding, offboarding, provisioning, device setup, or self-service — using AI or lightweight automation to reduce manual work and repeat requests.

 - Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner effectively with Workplace, People, Security, DART, and global IT teams on access, endpoint, and security-adjacent workflows, knowing when to escalate and how to keep employees moving without compromising controls.




SKILLS YOU'LL NEED TO BRING: 

 - Professional fluency in English, with the communication skills to support Dublin employees directly and partner clearly with global teams across time zones.

 - Flexibility to travel occasionally to support distributed EMEA office team members, onsite events, office launches, or hands-on IT needs across the region.

 - Hands-on workplace IT support experience across macOS and Windows laptops, iOS and Android devices, conference room AV, peripherals, and core networking concepts such as TCP/IP, DHCP, DNS, Wi-Fi, and VPN.

 - Experience supporting SaaS, identity, collaboration, and endpoint management tools such as Okta, Google Workspace, Slack, Microsoft 365, Intune, Fleet, and other similar systems.

 - Understands ITSM principles and has familiarity with ticketing tools such as ServiceNow, Atlassian, Zendesk, or Notion.

 - Strong operational judgment around access, endpoint hygiene, documentation, IT compliance, and security-minded escalation with Corp Security, DART, or global IT partners.

 - A service-oriented, low-ego, and self-directed approach; you communicate clearly, follow through reliably, and turn repeated requests into better documentation or cleaner workflows.

 - Comfort using AI-assisted resources or lightweight automation to improve support quality, reduce manual work, and keep knowledge current.




NICE TO HAVES:

 - Experience at a fast-growing tech or AI company where the security program had to outpace headcount.

 - Experience building internal tooling or automation workflows that improved employee experience.

 - Experience with Git or GitHub and an interest in learning to code.

 - Experience working in an Infrastructure as Code team environment.

 - Additional European language fluency or experience supporting distributed EMEA teams.

#LI-Onsite




A NOTE ON AI

You don’t need deep AI expertise for every role, but we do expect every Notino to be intellectually curious, drawn to tinkering and discovery, and excited to use AI as a real collaborator in their work. For some roles, AI fluency is a core requirement — when that’s the case, we'll say so explicitly in the qualifications. People who thrive here don’t treat AI as a novelty. They use it to think better, and make their work easier for others to build on.




EQUAL OPPORTUNITY & ACCOMMODATIONS

We hire talented people from a wide range of backgrounds. If you’re excited about this role but don’t meet every bullet, we still encourage you to apply. Notion is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of any legally protected characteristic. Consistent with applicable law, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records. Notion provides reasonable accommodations during the application process; if you need one, please let your recruiter know.



Notion is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate in hiring or any employment decision based on race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), marital status, ancestry, physical or mental disability, genetic information, veteran status, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, or other applicable legally protected characteristic. Notion considers qualified applicants with criminal histories, consistent with applicable federal, state and local law. Notion is also committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities and disabled veterans in our job application procedures. If you need assistance or an accommodation due to a disability, please let your recruiter know.

jobs.title: Autonasentaja / Ajoneuvoasentaja monipuolisiin huolto- ja korjaustehtäviin, Kuopion Yritysautohuolto, Kuopio
jobs.description:
Autonasentaja – Kuopion Yritysautohuolto

Työn kuvaus

Haemme **kokenutta autonasentajaa Kuopion Yritysautohuoltoon** vahvistamaan ja kehittämään yritysautojen huolto- ja korjauspalveluamme.

Kuopion Yritysautohuolto keskittyy yritysten **henkilö- ja pakettiautojen huoltoon, korjaukseen ja vianetsintään**. Asiakkaidemme ajoneuvot ovat pääasiassa päivittäisessä ammattikäytössä, joten meille on tärkeää saada autot huollettua ja korjattua laadukkaasti ja sujuvasti takaisin liikenteeseen.

Etsimme asentajaa, jolla on **3–5 vuoden tai pidempi käytännön kokemus autonasentajan työstä** ja joka pystyy työskentelemään itsenäisesti erilaisten huolto-, korjaus- ja vianetsintätehtävien parissa.

Työtehtäviisi kuuluu muun muassa

- henkilö- ja pakettiautojen määräaikaishuollot

- jarru- ja alustakorjaukset

- moottori- ja voimansiirtoon liittyvät korjaukset

- vianetsintä ja diagnostiikka

- ajoneuvojen sähkövikojen selvittäminen

- lisälaitteiden ja varusteiden asennukset

- muut monipuoliset autokorjaamon huolto- ja korjaustyöt


Mitä odotamme sinulta?

Toivomme sinulta:

- **3–5 vuoden tai pidempää kokemusta autonasentajan työstä**

- monipuolista käytännön osaamista henkilö- ja pakettiautojen huolto- ja korjaustöistä

- kokemusta vianetsinnästä ja diagnostiikasta

- kykyä itsenäiseen työskentelyyn

- huolellista ja vastuullista työotetta

- B-ajokorttia


Kokemus pakettiautoista, hyötyajoneuvoista ja ajoneuvosähköstä katsotaan eduksi.

Mitä tarjoamme?

Tarjoamme **monipuolisen työn ja mahdollisuuden tulla mukaan kehittämään Kuopion Yritysautohuollon toimintaa**.

Taustalla on toimiva korjaamo, valmis yritysasiakaskunta ja pitkä kokemus yritysten kaluston huolto- ja korjaustöistä. Yritysautohuoltoa kehitämme omana palvelukokonaisuutenaan, ja haemme siihen nyt osaavaa autonasentajaa.

Työssä pääset tekemään monipuolisesti huolto-, korjaus-, diagnostiikka- ja vianetsintätöitä eri automerkkien parissa.

Korjaamossamme huolletaan ja korjataan myös muuta yritysasiakkaiden kalustoa, joten toimintaympäristö on tavallista autokorjaamoa monipuolisempi.

Työtä on mahdollista tehdä **kokoaikaisessa tai osa-aikaisessa palkkatyösuhteessa**. Myös työskentelystä kevyt- tai sopimusyrittäjänä voidaan sopia erikseen.

**Palkkaus sovitaan kokemuksen ja osaamisen perusteella.**

Hakeminen

Lähetä hakemus ja kerro lyhyesti aikaisemmasta työkokemuksestasi, osaamisestasi sekä siitä, millaisten autojen ja korjaustöiden parissa olet työskennellyt.

Voit myös soittaa ja kysyä tehtävästä lisää.

**Jos olet kokenut autonasentaja ja etsit monipuolista työtä yritysasiakkaiden kaluston parissa, ota yhteyttä.**

ABOUT THE ROLE:

We’re looking for a Marketing Strategy & Operations Manager based in San Francisco or New York. This person will be the operational backbone of Marketing builds, launches, and measures campaigns, and how leads/accounts are routed, and managed. You'll own the end-to-end of campaign services across templates, QA, deliverability, and execution. You’ll also play a role in the monitoring, debugging and managing any MQL/MQA issues (from creation to handoff to Sales) as they arise. You'll work across many teams across multiple regions (EMEA, AMER), partnering closely with Marketing, SDR leadership, and our agency partners to build scalable processes and tooling that increase pipeline throughput and campaign quality. If you thrive on building systems that bring order to complexity and love bridging the gap between Marketing and Sales, this role is for you.
