jobs.title: Tier III Service Desk Engineer
jobs.description:
Unió Digital is an Arizona-based managed service provider (MSP) delivering Managed IT Services, Low Voltage Cabling, Access Control, Video Surveillance, and Intrusion Services. We believe technology should be intuitive, not intimidating.

 

We are looking for an experienced Tier 3 Service Desk Technician with exceptional problem-solving skills. You will serve as the escalation point within the team, resolving complex technical issues while also leading client onboarding and project initiatives. You are expected to be involved in direct end-user support when required. If you have a passion for ensuring top-quality user support and thrive in a collaborative environment, this role is for you.

 

Duties

 

·       Lead and support our helpdesk environment for managed service clients

 

·       Coordinate and manage client projects, acting as a bridge between the technical team and the client to ensure project success

 

·       Provide above and beyond support to our clients and respond to queries for technical assistance in person, via phone, or electronically as required

 

·       Provide training and support to clients during the onboarding process to ensure they understand how to effectively use their new IT systems and services.

 

·       Develop project plans for client onboarding and standardization projects, outlining tasks, resources required, and estimated timelines

 

·       Install, configure, diagnose, test and resolve technical hardware and software issues

 

·       Maintain and update written client and process documentation to ensure effective knowledge management

 

·       Provide mentorship and guidance to Tier I and Tier II service desk technicians, fostering a collaborative and knowledgeable team environment

 

·       Contribute to the development and improvement of IT service management processes and practices

 

·       Evaluate and anticipate IT trends and recommend strategies and implement improvement initiatives

 

Our Technology Stack

 

·       Helpdesk / Ticketing – HaloPSA

 

·       Documentation – Hudu

 

·       RMM – Intune / Immybot

 

·       Networking – Meraki

 

·       Email/Calendar/Voice/AD – Microsoft 365

 

·       Security Cameras – Rhombus / Avigilon

 

·       Door Access – Avigilon

 

Qualification

 

·       6+ years of experience providing IT services and end-user support

 

·       Prior experience at a managed service provider is critical to understand the fast-paced nature of the industry

 

·       Client-oriented approach with a passion for delivering high-quality customer service

 

·       Proven experience leading IT projects

 

·       A self-starter who is eager to expand their qualifications

 

·       Background in providing direct end-user support

 

·       High level of attention to detail

 

·       Excellent verbal and written communication skills

 

·       IT-related degree and/or certifications (Cisco, A+, Network+, Microsoft, or equivalent)

 

·       Advanced technical knowledge, including experience with Azure AD, Active Directory, Intune, or other RMM agents

 

Our Core Values

 

Dream Big, Then Make it Real

 

We flex our imagination and challenge ourselves to a higher standard.  Do, rather than talk and tell.

 

Client Driven Results

 

Clients trust us to find solutions that deliver exceptional results.  When they succeed, we succeed.

 

Own Your Progress

 

We continuously improve through rapid innovation and embracing our mistakes.  Own it means a relentless pursuit of the solution.

 

We Do It Right…even when no one’s watching. Period.

jobs.title: Store Manager - dubbu
jobs.description:
About the job

dubbu is expanding in Copenhagen, and we are looking for a Store Manager (37 hours/week) to lead our upcoming store — a new version of a familiar location, now including a small serving area inspired by Korean café culture.

As Store Manager, you will be responsible for the daily operations, the team, and ensuring that both the retail space and the serving area run smoothly every day.

You will work closely with the founder team and have significant influence on how the store develops in the coming years.

Your responsibilities

Leadership & team

  • Daily leadership of the team (scheduling, onboarding, training, and feedback)

  • Ensuring a high standard of customer service and sales

  • Coaching the team to improve performance on the sales floor

Store operations

  • Overseeing daily operations (opening/closing, stock deliveries, inventory, routines)

  • Ensuring the store always appears well-organized and ready for customers

  • Working with simple KPIs (sales, conversion rate, AOV)

Serving area

  • Responsible for the operation of the store’s small café area

  • Ensuring consistent quality and service speed

  • Daily cleaning, hygiene, and maintenance of equipment

  • Training staff in workflow and standards

  • Contributing to the development of new drinks inspired by Korean café culture

We are looking for someone who

  • Has 2–3 years of experience in retail or café environments, preferably with operational responsibility

  • Is structured and comfortable working with routines, checklists, and clear standards

  • Can lead a team and maintain calm and overview in a busy environment

  • Is hands-on and takes ownership of both people and operations

  • Has an eye for detail and understands the importance of a well-executed customer experience

It is a plus if you

  • Have experience with barista work, matcha, or espresso

  • Have worked with food hygiene or basic food safety procedures

  • Have experience with merchandising or retail visuals

  • Have an interest in Korean culture, cafés, or beauty

What we offer

  • A central role in a growing company

  • Close collaboration with the founder team

  • Significant influence on the store’s development

  • A strong team and an ambitious brand universe

  • Staff discount across our entire product range

Application

Start date: as soon as possible

jobs.description:
Description de tâches:


Date:  31 Jul 2026
Location:  Luxembourg, LU
Company:  Deloitte Luxembourg
Job Function:  Technology & Cyber Security
Seniority:  Senior levels
Contract Type:  Open-term
On site
Full time


Your future team:

Join our Digital Factory at Deloitte Luxembourg — a multidisciplinary team of ~85 technology professionals and financial domain experts working together to build high-impact digital solutions for the financial sector. We develop modern, data-driven products serving clients in banking, investment funds, and asset management, in a collaborative Agile environment with a strong focus on engineering quality and continuous improvement.

As a Senior Engineer, you will be a key technical pillar of the team – owning solutions end-to-end, shaping our engineering practices, and helping grow the people around you.



Your advantages of joining us:


Work that has real impact

Build and architect data-intensive applications used by major financial institutions, leveraging modern engineering standards and AI-enabled tooling. Your decisions will directly influence product quality and client outcomes.


Technical leadership & career growth

Take ownership of architectural decisions and technical direction, with a clear path toward Lead Engineer and Architect roles. Benefit from a dedicated learning budget, internal tech talks, and access to Deloitte's global knowledge network.


Global reach, local roots

Contribute to international projects and collaborate with diverse teams across Deloitte's global network, all while being anchored in Luxembourg – one of Europe's leading financial centers.


Flexible, inclusive culture

We trust our people. Enjoy flexible hybrid working arrangements, a culture where your voice genuinely shapes how we work, and a team that values both performance and wellbeing.


A team that builds together

Work side by side with financial experts, product owners, and fellow engineers in a startup-minded environment within a globally recognized firm.



How you'll contribute to our success:


Engineering & Architecture:

•    Architect, develop, and own robust full-stack applications from concept to production, with a strong focus on scalability, resilience, and maintainability in a financial services context
•    Design and implement high-performance, data-intensive APIs, processing workflows, and integrations using C#/.NET and SQL Server
•    Define and apply sound architectural patterns (e.g., clean architecture, CQRS, event-driven design) appropriate to the problem at hand
•    Build scalable, performant user interfaces with React, applying strong component architecture and state management best practices


Quality & Engineering Standards:

•    Define, promote, and enforce engineering standards across the team: code reviews, testing strategies (unit, integration, E2E), and CI/CD pipeline ownership
•    Own non-functional requirements including performance, security, and observability
•    Proactively identify technical debt and drive pragmatic remediation plans


Leadership & Collaboration:

•    Act as a technical mentor for junior and mid-level engineers, supporting their growth through pairing, feedback, and knowledge sharing
•    Lead technical discussions and drive consensus across engineers and business stakeholders
•    Translate complex business requirements into clear, actionable technical designs
•    Contribute to hiring by participating in technical interviews and candidate assessments
•    Communicate delivery risks, scope, and progress transparently to the team and project leads


Agile & Continuous Improvement:

•    Champion Agile best practices within the team, contributing to sprint ceremonies with a focus on sustainable delivery and continuous improvement
•    Propose and implement improvements to team processes, tooling, and ways of working


Your skills:

University degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or another relevant field.
Fluent English is required. French is considered an asset.
5 to 10 years of hands-on experience in software development, with a proven track record of delivering complex, production-grade full-stack applications. Experience in the financial sector is a plus.
Technical skills : C#/.NET (Core), SQL/relational databases, React development, API design, CI/CD definition.Nice-to-have: Cloud platforms, Containerization, Event-driven architecture, AI integration.
Technical leadership: Ability to lead design discussions, make well-reasoned decisions under ambiguity, and bring others along
Mentorship mindset: Genuine interest in growing the people around you through coaching, feedback, and knowledge sharing
Ownership: You drive delivery, raise risks early, unblock your team, and take pride in what you ship


Interested? Please submit your resume in English

With more than 2,600 employees and 98 nationalities, Deloitte Luxembourg is one of the Grand Duchy's largest, strongest and oldest professional services firms. For more than 75 years, our talented teams have been serving clients in various industries delivering high added-value offerings to national and international clients in audit and assurance, consulting, financial advisory, risk advisory, tax, and related services. Deloitte Luxembourg is part of the global Deloitte network.

jobs.title: JUNIOR ENGINEER IN FUNGAL BIOINFORMATICS (m/f)
jobs.employer: Luxembourg Institute of Science and Technology - LIST
jobs.description:
Fixed term contract | Hautcharage | 24 Months

Are you passionate about research? So are we! Come and join us

The Luxembourg Institute of Science and Technology (LIST) is a leading Research and Technology Organisation (RTO) that drives innovation for the economy and society in Luxembourg and beyond. With cutting-edge expertise in Natural, Built, Industrial environments, Space, AI, Security and defence technologies. LIST bridges scientific excellence and applied research to design solutions that address real-world challenges and create positive impact.

Do you want to know more about LIST? Check our website: https://www.list.lu/

How will you contribute?

As a Junior R&T Engineer at LIST, you will work under close supervision, performing tasks according to plans and directions. You will contribute to RDI projects, manage laboratory equipment, and develop your skills in RDI methodologies and technical instruments.

Among other responsibilities, you will:
·                  In coordination with the Head of R&T Group, you will perform RDI engineering duties.
·                  Under the supervision of scientific staff, you will organise the group's laboratories and equipment, order chemicals and other materials, and introduce new group members to the team and institute's way of working
·                  Develop the ability to generate RDI results under supervision
·                  Manage the group's strain, enzyme and plasmid collection
·                  Independently perform short subprojects under general supervision of the group leader or group scientists.
·                  Document test or experiment proceedings and ensure the traceability and quality of results.
·                  Support the group in experimental tasks, especially in more routine experiments.
·                  Perform R&T tasks, under supervision when required: evaluate, select, and applytechnical methods; make critical analysis, evaluation, and synthesis of data obtained from tests/experiments; propose improvements to methods, techniques, or practices; evaluate the feasibility and effectiveness of solutions provided; explain methods, practices and procedures related to their work; explain the functioning, usage, and maintenance of specialised tools/equipment
·                  Provide support to on-going funding efforts.
·                  Assit in the dissemination, valorisation, and transfer of RDI results. Presents work results in team meetings and workshops.
·                  Organise own work, defining timelines, and interacting collaboratively with team members.
·                  Learn to use specialized tools/equipment and advanced analytical techniques or methods.
·                  Respect and apply LIST-HSE rules. Alert potential dangers or risks. Take care of their own safety and that of others.


Is Your profile described below? Are you our future colleague? Apply now!

Education

•                   MSc (or equivalent) in molecular biology or biotechnology
•                   First experience (eg during studies) with molecular methodologies, such as cloning, RNA/gDNA isolation, PCR, etc.
•                   Strong organizational skills and attention to detail
•                   Experience with enzymes assays and/or HPLC analysis is an asset
•                   Experience with fungi is an asset
•                   Ability and willingness to work both independently and collaboratively in a team environment
•                   Strong interpersonal and communication skills

Language skills

•                   Strong knowledge of English (both spoken and written) is required.

Your LIST benefits

·        An organization with a passion for impact and strong RDI partnerships in Luxembourg and Europe that works on responsible and independent research projects
·        Sustainable by design, empowering our belief that we play an essential role in paving the way to a green society
·        Innovative infrastructures and exceptional labs occupying more than 5,000 square metres, including innovations in all that we do
·        An environment encouraging curiosity, innovation and entrepreneurship in all areas
·        Personalized learning programme to foster our staff's soft and technical skills
·        Multicultural and international work environment with more than 60 nationalities represented in our workforce
·        Diverse and inclusive work environment empowering our people to fulfil their personal and professional ambitions
·        Gender-friendly environment with multiple actions to attract, develop and retain women in science
·        32 days' paid annual leave, 11 public holidays, 13-month salary, statutory health insurance
·        Flexible working hours, home working policy (not remote) and access to Digital lunch vouchers

Apply online

Your application must include:
·        A motivation letter oriented towards the position and detailing your experience
·        A scientific CV with contact details
·        List of publications (and patents, if applicable)
·        Contact details of 2 references
Please apply ONLINE formally through the HR system. Applications by email will not be considered.

Application procedure and conditions

We kindly request applicants to provide their nationality for statistical purposes only, as part of our commitment to promoting diversity and ensuring equal opportunities in our workforce. This information will be kept confidential and will not be used for any discriminatory purposes.
LIST is dedicated to maintaining an inclusive work environment and is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to attracting, hiring, and retaining a diverse workforce. All applicants will be considered for employment without discrimination based on national origin, race, ethnicity, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital status, religion, age, or disability.
Applications will be continuously reviewed until the position is filled. An assessment committee will thoroughly evaluate applications, adhering to guidelines designed to ensure equal opportunities. The primary criteria for selection will be the alignment of the applicant's existing skills and expertise with the requirements mentioned above.
As part of our recruitment process, the selected candidate might be subject to a background check in accordance with applicable laws and institutional policies. Further checks and restrictions might apply to candidates in compliance with export controls requirements
This position offers a gross monthly salary between €5043 and €6132, paid over 13 months (€65559–€79716 annually) based on full time employment. The final salary offer within this range will be determined based on the candidate's overall profile, qualifications and professional experience.
For part time employment, the salary is adjusted pro rata.

ABOUT THE ROLE:

Replit is the fastest way to turn ideas into software. With our powerful AI-powered Agent and Assistant, anyone can create and launch apps from natural language in just one click. Build and deploy full-stack applications directly from your browser—no setup required. Never written a line of code in your life? No problem. Replit makes software creation accessible, collaborative, and lightning-fast. Join us in our mission to empower the next generation of builders.

We are seeking a Strategic Finance professional to join Replit's growing team in Foster City, CA. In this critical role, you'll work in a lean team supporting high-impact strategic and operational initiatives across the business to drive data-driven decision making. You’ll partner directly with executive leadership and the Board to align financial strategies with our ambitious growth objectives. This role reports to the Head of Finance.




ROLES & RESPONSIBILITIES:

You'll contribute to critical projects across three main core areas:

Internal Strategic & Operational Initiatives

 - Cross-Functional Partnership: Partner with Sales, Marketing, Support, Product, and Engineering teams to build financial models and analyses that drive organizational decision-making

 - New product launches: Build and present financial models, business cases, and investment analyses for new product launches

 - GTM Finance: Partner with go-to-market leadership to drive growth through sales capacity planning, funnel and pipeline analytics, pricing strategy and resource allocation

 - Pricing & Packaging: Analyze pricing and packaging strategies using quantitative and qualitative frameworks to recommend optimal approaches

 - Unit Economics: Recommend strategies that balance growth investments with operational efficiency to achieve long-term margin targets

 - International Growth: Analyze global expansion opportunities including localization, regional pricing strategies, go-to-market approaches, and commercial partnerships

 - Enterprise Sales: Partner with sales leadership to scale enterprise sales operations and strategy

Corporate Strategy & Planning

 - Long-Range Planning: Collaborate with FP&A team on forecasting, financial planning, long-range planning, growth headcount planning, and overall financial strategy

 - Board Reporting: Assist in preparing quarterly board materials and presentations

 - Market Insights: Conduct competitive analysis and industry research to inform strategic planning

Corporate Development & Investor Relations

 - Corporate Development: Support corporate development initiatives including M&A, joint ventures, and strategic partnerships from initial sourcing through execution and integration

 - Investor Relations & Fundraising: Support investor relations activities including fundraising, investor communications, and preparation of materials for investors



REQUIRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:

 - 3-6 years in investment banking, private equity, consulting, business operations, and/or strategic finance

 - Experience with SQL, Python, or other data analysis tools

 - An entrepreneurial mindset with the ability to operate in ambiguous, fast-moving environments

 - Self-directed with a strong work ethic and ability to manage multiple projects under tight deadlines

 - Expert-level financial modeling skills and proficiency with business intelligence tools

 - Strong presence and communication skills

 - Exceptional business judgment with the ability to synthesize complex data into actionable strategic insights

Join Replit and help shape the financial future of a platform that's revolutionizing how people learn, build, and deploy software with AI.




BONUS POINTS: 

 - Experience in strategic finance or related field at a scaling technology company

 - Current Replit user

 - Background in AI or enterprise technology companies

 - Understanding of compute and infrastructure costs in tech environments


This is a full-time role that can be held from our Foster City, CA office. The role has an in-office requirement of Monday, Wednesday, and Friday.



Full-Time Employee Benefits Include:

💰 Competitive Salary & Equity

💹 401(k) Program with a 4% match (US Only)

⚕️ Health, Dental, Vision and Life Insurance

jobs.title: ASISTENT/ICA U PRODAJI I PRETPRODAJI
jobs.description:
Opis posla:
  • istraživati tržište i pronalaziti građevinske tvrtke koje odgovaraju našoj ciljanoj skupini
  • sastavljati i redovito ažurirati popise potencijalnih korisnika
  • pronalaziti vlasnike, direktore i druge osobe odgovorne za donošenje odluka
  • istraživati osnovne podatke o tvrtki prije prvog kontakta
  • kontaktirati potencijalne korisnike putem e-maila i telefona
  • predstaviti razlog javljanja i provjeriti postoji li interes za razgovor
  • voditi komunikaciju od prvog kontakta do dogovaranja prodajne prezentacije
  • zakazivati termine i pripremati prodaji informacije o potencijalnom korisniku
  • voditi urednu evidenciju svih kontakata i aktivnosti u HubSpotu
  • pratiti dogovorene rokove i planirati ponovne kontakte
  • pripremati i slati ponude, ugovore i fakture prema postojećim predlošcima
  • surađivati s prodajom i osobom zaduženom za odnose s korisnicima
  • na početku ćete upoznati Insidico, postojeće korisnike i probleme koje aplikacija rješava
  • proći ćete naš način pronalaska potencijalnih korisnika, primjere dosadašnjih e-mailova i poziva, pravila rada u hubspotu te način na koji se dogovorena prezentacija predaje prodaji
  • prve popise kontakata, e-mailove i pozive prolazit ćemo zajedno. Cilj je da nakon razdoblja uhodavanja možete samostalno organizirati svoj rad i voditi pretprodajne aktivnosti
  • opseg aktivnosti i očekivani rezultati prilagođavat će se dogovorenom broju radnih sati
Poslodavac traži:
  • tražimo osobu koja zna jasno komunicirati, dobro organizirati svoj rad i samostalno doći do potrebnih informacija
  • važno nam je da nemate problem nazvati osobu s kojom prethodno niste razgovarali.U ovom poslu bit će neodgovorenih e-mailova, odbijenih poziva i odgovora da tvrtka trenutačno nije zainteresirana. Očekujemo da takve situacije prihvatite kao normalan dio prodajnog procesa i nastavite raditi bez nepotrebnog pritiska na potencijalnog korisnika.
  • prethodno iskustvo u prodaji nije uvjet. Spremni smo raditi i s osobom koja tek ulazi u prodaju, ali očekujemo interes za učenje, samostalnost i odgovornost prema dogovorenim zadacima.
Uvjeti:
  • najmanje završena srednja škola
  • razvijene usmene i pisane komunikacijske vještine
  • organiziranost i sposobnost određivanja prioriteta
  • samostalnost, upornost i snalažljivost
  • urednost u vođenju podataka i praćenju rokova
  • dobro poznavanje rada na računalu
  • korištenje programa Microsoft Office i Outlook
  • spremnost na rad u HubSpotu, Google kalendaru, Google Meetu i internim alatima
  • aktivno znanje hrvatskog jezika
  • B2B prodaji ili telefonskom kontaktiranju potencijalnih korisnika
  • istraživanju tržišta i izradi baza kontakata
  • radu u CRM sustavu, posebno HubSpotu
  • građevinskoj industriji
  • prodaji softvera ili drugih poslovnih usluga
Poslodavac nudi:
  • rad na nepuno radno vrijeme uz mogućnost kasnijeg prelaska na puno radno vrijeme
  • mogućnost rada putem ugovora o radu ili studentskog ugovora
  • fleksibilan raspored unutar unaprijed dogovorenog broja sati
  • rad iz našeg ureda u Osijeku
  • mogućnost djelomičnog rada od kuće nakon razdoblja uhodavanja
  • dogovoreni sustav nagrađivanja prema rezultatima
  • rad u malom timu u kojem ćete izravno surađivati s prodajom i Customer Successom
  • detaljan onboarding i podršku tijekom prvih mjeseci
  • mogućnost napredovanja prema samostalnom vođenju prodajnih prezentacija i prodajnih procesa
Postupak odabira: Kandidati koji uđu u uži izbor bit će pozvani na razgovor i praktično testiranje. Testiranje će uključivati zadatke povezane s istraživanjem potencijalnih korisnika, pisanom komunikacijom, organizacijom rada i kratkom simulacijom telefonskog razgovora. Ne očekujemo da prije razgovora poznajete sve funkcionalnosti Insidica. Zanima nas kako razmišljate, pronalazite informacije, komunicirate i organizirate zadatke. Prijava Pošaljite životopis na matej@insidico.com najkasnije do 01. rujna 2026. Planirani početak rada je tijekom rujna 2026., prema dogovoru s odabranim kandidatom.

jobs.title: Seasonal Chef Opportunities in LEGOLAND® Billund, Denmark (Koch/Köchin)
jobs.description:
Seasonal Chef Opportunities in LEGOLAND® Billund, Denmark

Are you an experienced chef looking for an exciting opportunity in Denmark?

LEGOLAND® Billund is one of Denmark’s most iconic destinations, home to the original LEGOLAND® Park and three unique accommodation facilities: Hotel LEGOLAND®, Castle Hotel LEGOLAND®, and LEGOLAND® Village.

We are currently recruiting chefs for the 2026 high season. Every day, we welcome thousands of holiday guests from around the world as well as conference and business visitors. If you enjoy working in a professional, fast-paced kitchen environment and take pride in delivering high-quality food experiences, we would love to hear from you.

What We Offer

• A unique opportunity to work in one of Denmark’s most popular tourist destinations

• A diverse workplace serving both international leisure guests and conference visitors

• A friendly, supportive, and multicultural team environment

• A fixed work schedule with the possibility of additional hours

• Employment under Danish collective agreements, ensuring fair working conditions and security

• Competitive salary: 29000 DKK -31000 DKK per month, depending on qualifications and experience

• Start date: 1 July 2026, or as soon as possible

• Employment until 30 September 2026, with the possibility of extension

• Assistance with practical arrangements, including accommodation, registration, and settling into life in Denmark

We Are Looking For

• Qualified chefs, or candidates with a minimum of 3 years’ experience in a professional kitchen

• Team players who are positive, reliable, and service-oriented

• Individuals who can work independently and take responsibility for their tasks

• Professionals who thrive in a busy, dynamic environment

• Candidates who can communicate in English or Danish

• Applicants who can start no later than 1 July 2026

Work Eligibility

To be eligible for this position, you must have the legal right to work in Denmark. This means you are either:

• A citizen of an EU/EEA country, or

• In possession of a valid Danish residence and work permit

Interested?

Please send us your CV as soon as possible.

For questions about the position, please contact Niels Switzer, Senoir head chef på

niels.switzer@legoland.dk.

If you have any general questions about your stay, please contact People Partner, Marie-Louise

Bredvig, at llb-hrsupport@legoland.dk

Applications are reviewed on an ongoing basis, and positions will be filled as soon as we find the right

candidates.

Join us for an exciting summer season in Denmark and become part of a team that creates

memorable experiences for guests from all over the world.

jobs.title: Software Engineer, Infrastructure
jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE

Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion.



Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work.




ABOUT THE ROLE

The Hyderabad Infra team builds and maintains Notion's internal async task runner and configuration management platform. The async task runner plays a critical role in ensuring our millions of users have a fast, reliable, and secure experience. The configuration management platform enables safe, explicit configuration management for Notion's product and infrastructure engineers.



As part of the Hyderabad Infra Team, you’ll have a unique opportunity to shape how Notion manages and scales its async task runner and configuration management platform, enabling innovation across the company.




WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE

 - You will contribute to the evolution and maintenance of our async task runner to meet the needs of over 100 million global users and support the rapid growth of our product and business. 

 - With guidance from senior team members, you'll help ensure our systems remain reliable, efficient, and scalable. You'll evaluate and integrate new technologies to keep us ahead of emerging challenges. 

 - Your work will empower our engineering team to build features confidently while you grow your skills in distributed systems and infrastructure.

 - You will develop the skills and confidence to debug live production systems with minimal disruption, whether replacing components or managing failovers. You will participate in an on-call rotation, responding to incidents to uphold service reliability and quickly restore normal operations.

 - You will partner with product engineers and other infra teams to ensure our platforms align with evolving business needs and product goals.




SKILLS YOU'LL NEED TO BRING

 - A software developer with at least 4 years of experience and the ability to perform well in a fast-paced environment.

 - Systems thinker: You understand distributed systems and can design solutions that account for tradeoffs like consistency, latency, and scalability.

 - Pragmatic problem-solver: You prioritize business impact and understand the balance between craft, speed, and long-term maintainability. You’re opinionated but not ideological, and you learn new technologies as you go.

 - Ownership and initiative: You thrive in a fast-moving, unstructured environment and are comfortable taking ownership of ambiguous problems. You act with a bias toward action and focus on results.

 - Customer Empathy: You excel at collaborating across teams, offering guidance and solutions to unblock engineers and support them in building reliable systems. With empathy at the core of your approach, you focus on addressing the needs of those who depend on the async task runner.

 - You don’t need to be an AI expert, but you’re curious and willing to adopt AI tools to work smarter and deliver better results.



By clicking “Submit Application”, I understand and agree that Notion and its affiliates and subsidiaries will collect and process my information in accordance with Notion’s Global Recruiting Privacy Policy https://notion.notion.site/Notion-Global-Recruiting-Privacy-Policy-fc3eb4e829354a26a2bb6fd5e289b550. https://dev.notion.so/a3ce416456924276a59de91bca740028?pvs=21



#LI-Onsite




A NOTE ON AI

You don’t need deep AI expertise for every role, but we do expect every Notino to be intellectually curious, drawn to tinkering and discovery, and excited to use AI as a real collaborator in their work. For some roles, AI fluency is a core requirement — when that’s the case, we'll say so explicitly in the qualifications. People who thrive here don’t treat AI as a novelty. They use it to think better, and make their work easier for others to build on.




EQUAL OPPORTUNITY & ACCOMMODATIONS

We hire talented people from a wide range of backgrounds. If you’re excited about this role but don’t meet every bullet, we still encourage you to apply. Notion is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of any legally protected characteristic. Consistent with applicable law, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records. Notion provides reasonable accommodations during the application process; if you need one, please let your recruiter know.



Notion is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate in hiring or any employment decision based on race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), marital status, ancestry, physical or mental disability, genetic information, veteran status, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, or other applicable legally protected characteristic. Notion considers qualified applicants with criminal histories, consistent with applicable federal, state and local law. Notion is also committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities and disabled veterans in our job application procedures. If you need assistance or an accommodation due to a disability, please let your recruiter know.

jobs.title: Production Designer
jobs.description:
At Linear, we're building the product development system for teams and agents. AI is fundamentally changing how software gets built, and we’re shaping the tools this new era requires.

Founded in 2019, Linear has become the platform of choice for more than 40,000 companies (including OpenAI, Coinbase, and Ramp) to plan, build, and ship their products. Today, our team is distributed across North America, Europe, and Australia, and we’re continuing to grow internationally. What unites us is relentless focus, fast execution, and a deep care for software craftsmanship.

We’re looking for a Designer with strong visual taste to help scale Linear’s creative work across web, brand, and marketing. You’ll create polished, high-quality designs across a wide range of surfaces — from landing pages and ad campaigns to sales decks and launch materials — helping bring Linear’s visual language to life everywhere people experience our brand.

When it comes to design, we’re looking to work with people who can pick up any problem and solve it. For us, it’s both how it works and how it looks. At its core, Linear is a developer tool where speed, interactions, and small details matter. We expect a broad set of design skills and the ability to create high-quality designs, interactions, and prototypes.

In this role, you will help communicate Linear's story (what we're building and why it matters) as part of our internal creative agency: the Magic Team.

Location & work mode

Linear is a remote-first company. This role is open to candidates based in North American or European time zones. You can work from anywhere within those regions. We value deep focus and async collaboration, with intentional moments to connect in person through team off-sites, optional co-working, and occasional travel.

What you'll do

 - Work with Marketing to design landing pages, ad campaigns, sales decks, and launch materials

 - Partner with the Magic Team to extend and scale Linear’s visual language across new campaigns and creative surfaces

 - Collaborate with designers, developers, and copywriters to create cohesive marketing experiences across web, social, and brand

What we're looking for

 - Around 2+ years of experience designing for web, marketing, or brand.

 - Excellent visual, UI, motion and interactive design skills

 - Eye for good design, attention to detail, and a genuine love for the craft

What we offer

We're a small, focused team that cares deeply about the quality of our work and the people we do it with. Here's what you can expect:

 - Competitive salary and equity

 - Employee-friendly equity terms including early exercise in the US and extended exercise windows

 - Daily meal and coffee stipend on every workday

 - Paid co-working space or desk

 - Health coverage (based on country requirements)

 - 5 weeks paid vacation, plus local statutory holidays

 - 4 months paid parental leave

 - Paid month off after 4 years & every 2 years thereafter

 - Regular team events and off-sites

 - Remote-first with no required commute

Learn how we think and work

 - Part I https://linear.app/blog/a-design-reset and Part II https://linear.app/blog/how-we-redesigned-the-linear-ui of how we redesigned the Linear UI

 - Read me https://linear.app/readme a story about our mission

 - Our hiring process: How we hire at Linear https://linear.app/now/how-we-hire-at-linear

 - How we work: Designing remote work at Linear https://linear.app/now/designing-remote-work-at-linear

 - Why and how we do work trials https://linear.app/blog/why-and-how-we-do-work-trials-at-linear Linear blog post

 - How we use AI in design https://designerfund.substack.com/p/ai-design-linear feature of Linear's design team

 - Crafting quality that endures https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=pCil7YNhNCU Config keynote by our Co-founder & CEO, Karri Saarinen

 - Building for quality: Our Investment in Linear https://accel.com/noteworthy/our-investment-in-linear Accel Series B blog post

 - Read about our recent Series C Fundraise https://linear.app/now/building-our-way and Giving our team liquidity https://linear.app/now/giving-our-team-liquidity-through-linear-s-first-tender-offer

Linear is an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate based on race, color, religion, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic under applicable law.

jobs.description:

“Anti Aging Institute” | SIA “Veselības centrs 4” filiāle

Mēs – Anti Aging Institute komanda – meklējam smaidīgu, atsaucīgu un uzticamu kolēģi.

  • darbinieku atlaides SIA “Veselības centrs 4” un grupas uzņēmumu medicīnas un skaistumkopšanas pakalpojumiem;
  • citus uzņēmuma bonusus;
  • sociālās garantijas un konkurētspējīgu atalgojumu - pārbaudes laikā 8.00 EUR/h, pēc veiksmīgi izturēta pārbaudes laika, sākot no 8.50 EUR/h (bruto).

jobs.description:

You enjoy working independently, are comfortable working with numbers and reports, and can keep deadlines even when several tasks need attention at the same time. We expect you to have: - Fluency in English - Good Excel skills - Previous experience with accounting and VAT-related tasks - Good understanding of VAT declarations, reconciliations and corrections - Experience working with accounting or ERP systems - Strong attention to detail - A responsible and organised working style - Willingness to learn and understand specific business processes Experience with international VAT reporting and knowledge of Microsoft Dynamics 365 would be an advantage. Previous experience with international VAT reporting and knowledge of Microsoft Dynamics 365 would be an advantage.

We offer: We offer modern working conditions in an office building near Ülemiste Centre, a friendly team, interesting work-related challenges, flexible working arrangements, the possibility to work from home up to two days per week, employee benefits related to the aviation industry, stability and a competitive motivation package.

Other requirements: This role could be a good fit for you if you are accurate, responsible and detail-oriented. You enjoy working independently, are comfortable working with numbers and reports, and can keep deadlines even when several tasks need attention at the same time.
We understand that this is a specific business area, and the necessary training will be provided. What matters most is that you are accurate, willing to learn and able to take responsibility for your work. To apply, please send your CV in English and include a few lines about your relevant experience and why you are interested in this role.

jobs.title: Brand Designer
jobs.description:
Replit is the agentic software creation platform that enables anyone to build applications using natural language. With millions of users worldwide, Replit is democratizing software development by removing traditional barriers to application creation.



TEAM

Brand & Creative defines how Replit shows up in the world and leads the creative work that brings it to market. On the Brand side, the function sets company-level direction: defining the brand, shaping the narrative, and establishing how Replit is understood and expressed in the market. On the Creative side, the function leads the planning, development, and execution of creative work across campaigns, launches, events, and major company initiatives; translating strategy into high-quality outputs across every touchpoint. Brand & Creative ensures that what Replit is and what Replit makes remain aligned. Resulting in a clear, consistent, and differentiated brand experience across the company.




ROLE

The Brand Designer is responsible for defining, developing, and maintaining the Replit brand system. The role focuses on core brand foundations and their application across key surfaces, including product and marketing. In partnership with internal and external partners, this role ensures the brand is clear, consistent, and scalable across all touchpoints. This role reports to the Brand & Creative Lead.




RESPONSIBILITIES

 - Define and evolve the Replit visual brand system

 - Design and maintain core brand assets, guidelines, and documentation

 - Apply the brand system across key surfaces including product, web, and primary marketing channels

 - Partner with Product and Design to ensure consistent brand expression within the product experience

 - Provide guidance and feedback to internal teams and external partners on brand usage

 - Partner with external design studios and agencies to develop and extend the brand system

 - Review and direct external work to ensure alignment with brand standards

 - Ensure consistency and quality across all brand-critical touchpoints

 - Develop scalable design frameworks that support long-term brand growth

 - Contribute hands-on design work on high-visibility and foundational projects




REQUIREMENTS

 - 5-7+ years of experience in brand design, visual systems, or identity design

 - Strong portfolio demonstrating brand systems, identity work, and application across multiple touchpoints

 - Expertise in typography, layout, and visual systems

 - Experience building and maintaining design systems at scale

 - Proficiency in Figma and Adobe Creative Suite

 - Ability to balance conceptual thinking with executional rigor

 - Experience working with external agencies or design partners

 - Strong attention to detail and consistency

 - Experience collaborating with Product and cross-functional teams



This is a full-time role that can be held from our Foster City, CA office. The role has an in-office requirement of Monday, Wednesday, and Friday.

jobs.title: GD Machine Technician
jobs.description:

•    Strong mechanical and/or electrical troubleshooting skills
•    Experience in a manufacturing/production environment, ideally food, pharma, or consumer goods
•    Ability to read technical manuals and machine documentation
•    Willingness to work shifts as required by production schedule
•    Working proficiency in English (spoken and written)
-       Valid driving license B

•    Competitive salary in line with Icelandic industry standards according to collective agreements with Efling union.
•    Role in a fast-growing, internationally ambitious company
•    Direct impact on production quality and output

jobs.title: Associate Development Director and Advisor
jobs.description:
About Contradictum Advisory ehf.

Contradictum Advisory ehf. is a startup dedicated to advising international intellectual property holders in the management and licensing their assets with the objective to steer part of that revenue stream into underfunded projects in Iceland.  Particular emphasis is placed on projects that both serve an immediate domestic need in Iceland and that would meet eligibility requirements under the European Union Green Bond Standard and qualify for the Nordic Swan ecolabel.
Associate Development Director and Advisor.

This is a client-facing position comprised of two primary areas of competence.  The first is in providing advisory and consulting services to intellectual property owners in the North American Market with respect to the use, management, and monetization of their IP portfolios.  The second is in facilitating the investment of IP derived revenue into Iceland-based projects.  Our customer base is comprised of individuals, privately held companies, and family offices who are open diversifying their holdings in EEA and EFTA jurisdictions.  Your role will be to effectively assist clients with maximizing IP derived revenue and presenting opportunities to invest that revenue into target projects in Iceland.  A solid understanding of intellectual property, contracts, procurement processes is essential.  

Main tasks and Responsibilities:
•    Provide strategic direction to clients with respect to intellectual property licensing within the relevant jurisdictional frameworks of each client portfolio.
•    Prepare and present pitch decks to potential investment partners.  
•    Develop investment-ready Iceland-based project proposals.
•    Manage and develop local network of interested counterpart stakeholder and professional service providers related to each project proposal.
•    Identify and liaise with potential new high-net-worth individual investors and small-midsized family office clients in North, Central, and South American markets.
•    Demonstrate extraordinary discretion in all interactions with clients, maintaining the utmost in confidentiality and candor.

Education and licensing:
•    Advanced university-level business or legal education required.  Doctorate of Jurisprudence or Masters of Business Administration with coursework in contracts or international transactions from a top university strongly preferred.
•    Educational coursework in environmental or natural resources usage from an Icelandic University preferred.
•    Admittance to practice before to any US Federal Court.
•    Membership in any North America-based First Nation or Tribal Bar Association strongly preferred.

Qualification Requirements:
•    Minimum 3 years of experience in intellectual property licensing.
•    Minimum 3 years of experience in real property development or prime-contractor representation is highly desirable
•    Minimum 3years of experience in international transactions is highly desirable.
•    Solid Understanding of USPTO and EUIPO standards and procedures.
•    Knowledge of securities and BizOp regulatory standards and requirements is highly desirable.
•    Ability to operate effectively in a multi-time-zone framework convenient to international client domestic work hours.

Language Skills:  Exceptional written, verbal, and presentation English skills are essential.  Additional languages are beneficial.
English [Required] Expert Level

jobs.title: Part-time Veterinary Nurse
jobs.description:
Veterinary Nurse (Part-Time) - MyPeterinarian, Copenhagen

Are you an Authorised Veterinary Nurse with strong anaesthesia and surgical nursing experience?

MyPeterinarian is looking for an experienced Veterinary Nurse to join our Copenhagen team in a part-time role with a strong focus on anaesthesia, surgical nursing and high-quality patient care.

Founded in 2017, MyPeterinarian is an established independent veterinary clinic, grooming salon and pet-sitting company. We are a close-knit team focused on excellent patient care, strong client relationships and creating a positive working environment.

About the Role

The core responsibility of this role is independently managing anaesthesia monitoring - from patient preparation and induction through to recovery. You will play an important role in ensuring safe, calm and well-managed surgical procedures while working closely with the veterinary team.

This role is ideal for a nurse who enjoys surgical nursing, values careful patient monitoring and is confident taking responsibility within their area of expertise.

Please note: MyPeterinarian is planning to relocate to a new Copenhagen location between now and the end of September 2026 -the exact address will be shared during the interview process 

Schedule

Approximately 21 hours per week

  • Tuesday and Wednesday: 09:00-15:00

  • Monday, Thursday and Friday: 10:00-13:00

  • Exact schedule to be agreed with the successful candidate

This is a weekday-only position, with no evenings, weekends or night shifts scheduled as standard, supporting a healthy work-life balance.

Expected start date: 15 September 2026

Key Responsibilities

  • Independently monitoring anaesthesia, including induction and recovery

  • Preparing patients for surgery and providing surgical assistance

  • Supporting blood sample collection and other clinical procedures

  • Providing routine patient care, including nail clipping

  • Handling and supporting patients throughout their visit

  • Maintaining clinical hygiene standards and sterilising equipment

  • Supporting reception and administrative tasks when required

  • Assisting with stock checks and inventory management

Qualifications

We are looking for someone who:

  • Is an Authorised Veterinary Nurse

  • Has proven experience of independently monitoring anaesthesia

  • Is comfortable working independently during surgical procedures

  • Has excellent patient handling skills and a calm, professional approach

  • Has a good standard of spoken and written English (Danish is an advantage but not essential)

  • Enjoys being part of a small, collaborative team

What We Offer

  • A friendly and professional team environment

  • A varied clinical role with genuine responsibility

  • No evenings, weekends or night shifts scheduled as standard 

  • Salary: 200dkk/hr

  • Regular team gatherings and a supportive workplace culture

  • Opportunity to increase working hours over time, by mutual agreement

  • Staff discounts on MyPeterinarian veterinary, grooming and pet-sitting services for your own pets

Application Process

Application deadline: 15 August 2026

To apply, please send your CV to: jobs@mypeterinarian.com

Please note that applicants must already have the right to work in Denmark. We are unable to provide visa sponsorship for this position.

If you have any questions, please contact us at: hej@mypeterinarian.com

By submitting your application, you consent to MyPeterinarian processing your personal data for the purpose of recruitment. Your information will be handled confidentially and in accordance with applicable data protection legislation.

ABOUT THE ROLE:

The Solutions Consultant Manager is the person who makes our GTM motion real on the ground. As an in-region leader directly managing a team of Solutions Consultants, you'll own your team's full commercial output—new logo, expansion, and renewals—and be accountable for both the results and the quality of execution that produces them.



This isn't a traditional pipeline-management role. The best SC Managers are coaches first: they know what a great first meeting looks like, can watch a live build and tell a rep exactly what to change, and build the operating rhythm and inspection cadence that makes consistent execution possible across the team. If you're a builder who loves developing people as much as winning deals—and you want to lead a regional team in a go-to-market model that's genuinely new—this is the role.



This role will be based in Munich, Germany. We work from our offices on Mondays, Tuesdays and Thursdays (our Anchor Days) because we do our best thinking and building together in person. We’re looking for someone who’s excited to work alongside the team during those days. 




WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE:

 - Own the commercial performance of your team across new logo ARR, expansion ARR, and UBP outcomes—accountable for both the headline numbers and the quality of execution that drives them

 - Coach SCs on the GTM builder motion: what great looks like in a first meeting (workflow diagnosis, current → future architecture), a second meeting (live build in Notion + value narrative), and through the full cycle to adoption hand-off

 - Contribute to and participate in the regional operating cadence: weekly pipeline reviews, deal support sessions, call reviews against the motion quality rubric, and forecast calls with senior leadership

 - Hire, onboard, and certify new SCs to the GTM builder motion—driving readiness from ramp through consistent execution, and managing performance with clarity when expectations aren't met

 - Partner with the regional BDR manager on pipeline strategy, outbound targeting, and qualification standards to ensure the team's book of business is healthy and growing

 - Partner with Outcomes leadership on adoption hand-offs, at-risk account management, and renewal strategy—owning the overall commercial arc for the region while collaborating on the execution that follows close

 - Represent your team or region in leadership forums with clear signal on what's working, what needs investment, and where execution is breaking down




SKILLS YOU'LL NEED TO BRING: 

 - Track record as a quota-carrying B2B seller with direct experience in workflow design, live demos, or technical sales—you can coach the builder motion because you've run it yourself

 - Frontline sales management experience: built an operating cadence, ran performance management, and developed talent from onboarding through consistent overperformance

 - Strong coaching orientation: you can watch a demo or deal review and identify specifically what to change—not just whether the outcome was good, but why, and what the rep should do differently next time

 - Commercial instincts at the team level: able to read pipeline health, identify risk early, and drive urgency across a team without micromanaging individual deals

 - You don't need to be an AI expert, but you're curious and willing to adopt AI tools to work smarter and deliver better results.

 - Fluency in English and German.




NICE TO HAVES:

 - Experience selling or managing in a consumption or usage-based business where adoption signals matter as much as closed ARR

 - Track record building high-performing regional teams from an early stage: hiring to profile, structured onboarding, certification, and performance management

 - Experience in a shared account ownership model—able to navigate the SC/CSA hand-offs and hold the commercial arc across the full customer lifecycle

jobs.title: Our Generation Youth Worker - Louth
jobs.description:
In order to work in Ireland a non-EEA National, unless they are exempted, must hold a valid employment permit. Please review the Eligibility and requirements for an employment permit if you are unsure of your eligibility to apply for this vacancy.
Youth Work Ireland is seeking a passionate and motivated Our Generation Youth Worker to join the Our Generation Project in County Louth. This full-time hybrid role offers the opportunity to make a meaningful impact by supporting the mental health, wellbeing, and personal development of young people through innovative youth work programmes. As an Our Generation Youth Worker, you will recruit and engage young people, build strong relationships with schools, youth clubs, and community organisations, and deliver structured programmes including Mind Matters, CHOICE, Stand UPP, and Rise Up. These programmes focus on emotional resilience, leadership, healthy relationships, wellbeing, and peace-building across communities. In this role, you will deliver evidence based youth programmes that promote mental health, emotional resilience, leadership, and wellbeing for young people. You will work across schools, youth clubs, and community organisations throughout County Louth, building strong partnerships and creating engaging opportunities that empower young people and support positive outcomes. You will also collaborate with colleagues and partner organisations to deliver high-quality programmes that strengthen communities and encourage cross-community and cross-border engagement. Key Requirements * Level 7 qualification (or higher) in Youth & Community Work, Social Work, Social Care, or a related Social Science discipline. * Experience delivering structured programmes or workshops with young people. * Excellent communication, organisational, and teamwork skills. * Ability to engage young people in a variety of educational and community settings. * Full, clean driving licence and access to a car (essential). * Willingness to travel regularly throughout County Louth. This is a 35-hour per week hybrid position, a fixed-term contract from September 2026 to September 2027, with a starting salary of €41,500.49. If you are committed to empowering young people and creating positive change in your community, we would love to hear from you.

What you'll bring to the team
Lead the Future of Beluga Whale Conservation
Imagine waking up each day knowing your work is helping shape the future of one of the world's most unique marine conservation projects.

At the SEA LIFE TRUST Beluga Whale Sanctuary, you'll lead an experienced team dedicated to providing world-class care for Little Grey and Little White, our resident belugas, while also overseeing the welfare of rescued puffins and our aquarium collection.


This is far more than an animal care management role. It's an opportunity to combine exceptional leadership, animal welfare expertise and conservation passion at the world's first open-water beluga whale sanctuary.

If you're an inspiring leader with extensive experience working with cetaceans or large marine mammals, we'd love to hear from you.


As our Animal Care Manager (Curator), you'll lead all aspects of animal care, welfare and husbandry across the sanctuary.

Working closely with the General Manager and the wider SEA LIFE TRUST and Merlin Entertainments teams, you'll ensure our animals receive exceptional care while supporting scientific research, conservation, education and unforgettable guest experiences.


You'll lead, coach and develop a passionate team of animal care professionals whilst ensuring the highest standards of welfare, safety and operational excellence.

What You'll Be Doing
Leading World-Class Animal Care
Lead the care, health and welfare of our resident beluga whales, puffins and aquarium animals.
Oversee animal husbandry, enrichment, operant conditioning and behavioural management.
Ensure excellent standards across all animal habitats and life support systems.
Drive continual improvements in animal welfare and husbandry practices.
Leading and Developing People
Inspire, coach and develop a highly skilled animal care team.
Create a culture of collaboration, continuous learning and professional development.
Provide leadership during day-to-day operations and emergency response situations.
Ensure clear performance expectations and high professional standards.
Conservation & Collaboration
Work alongside veterinarians, conservation partners, researchers and animal welfare specialists.
Provide expert advice to the SEA LIFE TRUST, Merlin Entertainments and external stakeholders on cetacean care.
Support ongoing conservation programmes and future sanctuary developments.
Operational Excellence
Manage departmental budgets, veterinary services and critical animal care resources.
Ensure compliance with animal welfare legislation, licensing requirements and health & safety standards.
Oversee record keeping, husbandry documentation and life support operations.
Participate in the animal care call-out rota.
Inspiring Others
Help bring conservation to life by engaging with guests, media and local communities.
Support educational programmes and public awareness initiatives.
Act as an ambassador for the SEA LIFE TRUST and our conservation mission.
Qualifications & Experience
We're looking for someone who combines exceptional technical expertise with outstanding leadership.

You'll ideally have:

Essential
At least 10 years' experience working within a cetacean, aquarium or zoological environment, including significant leadership experience.
Extensive knowledge of marine mammal behaviour, training and welfare.
Proven experience leading and developing professional animal care teams.
Strong understanding of operant conditioning, enrichment and husbandry.
Excellent communication and decision-making skills.
Strong swimming ability and confidence working in open water.
Ability to work from boats and in challenging marine environments.
Fluent English.
Ability to obtain the legal right to live and work in Iceland.
Desirable
Degree in Zoology, Biology or a related discipline.
Experience with Life Support Systems (LSS).
Drysuit or cold-water diving qualifications.
PADI Rescue Diver (or higher).
Veterinary technical experience.
Bird rehabilitation experience.
First Aid qualification.
Experience handling cetaceans in open-water environments.
Benefits
This isn't just another animal care leadership role.

You'll be joining one of the world's most recognised marine conservation charities and helping shape the future of marine mammal welfare.

You'll have the opportunity to:

Lead the world's first open-water beluga whale sanctuary.
Work with internationally respected animal welfare experts.
Influence global conservation and welfare standards.
Develop and mentor an exceptional animal care team.
Make a genuine difference to the lives of marine animals every single day.
Live and work in the stunning natural surroundings of Iceland.
About the SEA LIFE TRUST
The SEA LIFE TRUST is a global marine conservation charity dedicated to protecting the world's oceans and marine wildlife through conservation, education and campaigning.

Our Beluga Whale Sanctuary in Iceland provides a safe, natural environment for formerly captive beluga whales while inspiring millions of people to care for our oceans.

Together, we're creating a future where marine life can thrive.

If you're an experienced animal care leader who shares our passion for conservation, welfare and exceptional animal care, we'd love to hear from you.

Apply today and help shape the future of marine conservation.

jobs.description:
Are you passionate about hands-on electrical work in the offshore and maritime industry? Do you thrive on a diverse range of tasks and enjoy travelling as part of your job? If so, this exciting opportunity could be perfect for you!

Your Position
In our Rig & Marine division, we are seeking an Electrical Technician who takes pride in quality craftsmanship and in getting the job done safely. This role offers numerous intriguing challenges, including yard stays and modification projects that contribute to the green transition within drilling rigs and special vessels. Depending on your experience, you may also act as Working Supervisor /
Foreman on selected projects, leading a small team of electricians and cable pullers.

At Semco Maritime safety is a core value, and in this role, you will contribute to maintaining and promoting a strong safety culture while delivering innovative solutions. Above all, your work will make a real change for the global energy sector.

You will join a team of 5 colleagues working both locally and globally on projects within our division. The Rig & Marine division is comprised of 450 colleagues worldwide. This full-time position is based at our headquarters in Esbjerg, Denmark. You should expect between 100-150 travel days per year, with occasional work at our yard or locally in Esbjerg.

“I'm looking for an Electrical Technician who takes pride in the craft. This job is hands-on – pulling cables, terminating, testing and troubleshooting on rigs and special vessels around the world – always with safety first. If you enjoy varied work and being part of a tight-knit team – and perhaps have the ambition to step up as Working Supervisor on our projects – we'd love to hear from you.” - Manager, Electrical Engineering, Frederik Vester Pedersen

Your tasks and responsibilities
You will carry out electrical installation and maintenance work on our projects and report progress to your Supervisor or Project Manager. Quality, safety, and good order in tools and materials are essential in this role.
  • Perform electrical installation work such as cable pulling, glanding, termination, and mounting of equipment according to drawings and specifications.
  • Carry out testing, troubleshooting, and commissioning support on electrical systems on drilling rigs and special vessels.
  • Work in accordance with the permit-to-work system and all HSE rules and regulations, contributing to a strong safety culture on site.
  • Register your hours daily and help keep track of materials, tools, and equipment.
  • Cooperate with colleagues and other contractors on site and report progress and any deviations to your Supervisor.
  • When acting as Working Supervisor / Foreman: lead and coordinate the workforce on site, ensure quality and adherence to deadlines, and approve daily timesheets before handover to the Project Manager.

Your qualifications and Skills
We imagine that you are very independent and thrive when things change rapidly – sometimes by the hour. You are passionate about what you do, and you are eager to get things done in the right way while collaborating with various stakeholders.

To succeed in this position, we expect that you have:
  • A background as an electrician, with a minimum of 5 years of experience in the offshore or marine industry is preferred.
  • Experience reading and working from electrical drawings and technical documentation.
  • Proficiency in English, both oral and written, is essential.
  • Experience with fibre optic splicing is an additional advantage.
  • Experience as a Working Supervisor or Foreman – or the ambition to take on that responsibility – is a strong advantage.

We conduct interviews on an ongoing basis, so we encourage you to submit your application promptly via the link provided on the page.
For any inquiries, please feel free to contact Manager, Electrical Engineering, Frederik Vester Pedersen, +45 7916 6420

A role where you will have the trust as well as the responsibilities to play a key role in shaping the way we work? Within a team that is the pillar for all developmental work within our division, driving innovation and setting the standard for all upcoming projects? Then this is your chance to not just show what you’re made of, but also to join a world leader within renewables energy that have no intention to slow down the green energy transition.

Your position
We offer you an interesting and challenging job in an international organization, where we strive to provide innovative and creative solutions. You will get the unique opportunity to work in an environment characterized by dedication, passion, and ambition.

At Semco Maritime you will be joining our dedicated Product Line Team in our Renewables Division whose mission is to develop solutions for Offshore Substations engineered and constructed together with our close partners. Our goal is to standardize solutions while maintaining flexibility to align client needs with supplier capabilities. Offshore substation industrialisation is the key enabler for the green transition worldwide, and as such, your product solutions will need to reflect that. We have the largest project portfolio within offshore substations worldwide, so you will join a well-established company in growth and work with a team of changers.

“We are world-leading within offshore substations, and we have a strong focus on both AC and DC connections, as well as advanced floating technologies. Our Offshore Wind markets include Europe, Asia, and the USA, which means that you can expect to be involved in projects worldwide!” - Director, Product Line Management, Jannick Elmbæk Olsen.

Your tasks & responsibilities
As our new Electrical Engineer for High Voltage, you will be responsible for development, implementation, and maintenance of the products and solutions offerings for our offshore substation product line.

Your tasks will include but are not limited to:
  • HV/MV product and solutions development and maintenance in line with future market requirements
  • Proposal development based on the architecture framework and the client’s requirements
  • Working closely with our Tender team focusing on our customers Employer Requirements and Semco Maritimes own modular architecture
  • Maintain knowledge on market demand and implement product improvements and requirements for product line to fit future projects
  • Coordinate and secure strategic supply chain together with Procurement, including cost-out activities
  • Develop and maintain the product roadmap with input on new technologies from the supply chain, organization, and the market
  • Provide supervision and guidance to the development and execution teams

The successful candidate will be expected to form strong working relationships with the other existing teams e.g., in sales, tender, project management, construction, and most importantly, our in-house engineering organisation.

Your profile & qualifications
You are an experienced HV professional with a product development mindset, preferably coming from either an OEM or from an engineering organisation. Your collaborative spirit and commercial acumen will thrive in our international setting. In addition, you are a proactive team player with a continuous improvement mindset, analytical prowess, and a solution-oriented approach.

To succeed in this position, we expect that you:
  • Have experience with design, procurement and construction of the high voltage and medium voltage systems, such as electrical distribution, power transformers and GIS switchgear.
  • Are familiar with industrial layout design, routing, 3D modelling, structural and weight estimation of high voltage components, preferably on Offshore Substations
  • Have experience with interface management across systems
  • Possess excellent communication skills in English

As a person you are a natural team player and collaborator who enjoy working across many business areas. You have a strong drive and desire to continually develop high quality solutions in a dynamic environment. Furthermore, you have strong analytical and problem-solving skills to come up with efficient ways to solve obstacles.

You are born curious and have a positive mindset.

The position is full time and your work location can be either at our office in Copenhagen, Esbjerg or Gdynia. You should expect up to 10-30 travel days annually.

We are looking for an experienced specialist or an ambitious individual aiming to become an expert in High Voltage Equipment for offshore use. You will collaborate with highly skilled colleagues and can play a crucial role in designing offshore substations, from the tender phase through to commissioning.

Here, you will work with some of the brightest and most skilled engineers in developing technical solutions to our customers all over the world. You will have the exciting chance to bring your knowledge into work in the core area of high voltage systems. Above all, your work will make a real change for the global energy sector.
